local camera_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/CameraController')

local battle_test_node = newclass('BattleTestNode', node_base)

function battle_test_node:init(_, desc, data)
	self.desc = desc
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.duration = data.duration
end

function battle_test_node:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed < self.duration then
		return node_status.running
	end
	
	logger_util.error(self.desc .. ' : DONE ! ')
	return node_status.succeed
end

function battle_test_node:dispose()
end

local camera_move_node = newclass('CameraMoveNode', node_base)

	local dest_pos = type_util.is_string(data.dest)
				and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.dest)
				or vector(data.dest[1], data.dest[2], data.dest[3])
				
	self.move_request = {
		target_pos = dest_pos,
		duration = data.duration
	}
end

function camera_move_node:late_init()

end

		return node_status.succeed

		self.result = node_status.running 
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true

	return node_status.succeed
end

function camera_move_node:dispose()

local camera_focus_to_node = newclass('CameraFocusToNode', node_base)

function camera_focus_to_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.duration = data.duration
	self.cam_focus_time_passed = 0
	self.cam_focus_duration = data.cam_focus_duration
	self.cam_focus_fov = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.cam_focus_fov, camera_controller.default_fov)

	self.target_pos = type_util.is_string(data.target_pos)
		and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.target_pos)
		or vector(data.target_pos[1], data.target_pos[2], data.target_pos[3])
end

function camera_focus_to_node:late_init()
	local cam_transform = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform
	local cam_to_target_vec = self.target_pos - cam_transform.position

	local rotate_request = {
		target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(cam_to_target_vec),
		duration = self.duration
	}
	camera_controller:request_to_rotate(rotate_request)


	local zoom_request = {
		target_fov = self.cam_focus_fov,
		duration = self.duration
	}

	camera_controller:request_to_zoom(zoom_request)
end

function camera_focus_to_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	--
	
	if camera_controller:is_camera_zooming() or camera_controller:is_camera_rotating() then
		self.result = node_status.running
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

function camera_focus_to_node:dispose()
end

	local move_request = {
		target_pos = camera_controller.default_pos,
		duration = self.duration
	}

	local rotate_request = {
		target_rotation = camera_controller.default_rotation,
		duration = self.duration
	}

	local zoom_request = {
		target_fov = camera_controller.default_fov,
		duration = self.duration
	}

	camera_controller:request_to_move(move_request)
	camera_controller:request_to_zoom(zoom_request)
	camera_controller:request_to_rotate(rotate_request)
end

	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	if camera_controller:is_camera_rotating() or

		camera_controller:is_camera_rotating() then
		self.result = node_status.running
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

function camera_reset_node:dispose()

	self.duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.duration, 0)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function wait_for_sec_node:late_init()
	self.is_finished = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

end

function wait_for_sec_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	return node_status.running
end

function door_control_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(_, data)
	
	self.gimmick_handle_name = data.gimmick_handle_name
	self.is_close = data.is_close
	self.sfx = data.sfx
end

function door_control_node:late_init()
	self.is_finished = false
	self.time_passed = 0

	local door = get_field_object(self.gimmick_handle_name)
	if door ~= nil then
		local animator = door.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		if animator ~= nil then
			if self.is_close then
				animator:Play('idle')
			else
				animator:Play('on')
			end
		end
	end

	if self.sfx ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(self.sfx) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sfx)
		else
			for i = 1, #self.sfx do
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sfx[i])
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 자식 노드를 가질 수 있는 노드의 인터페이스
local bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node = newclass('bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node', bt_node)

function bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.sub_nodes = {}
	self.bt_builder = bt_builder
	self.data = data

	self.sub_node_activation_history = {}
end

function bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node:set_up()
	local sub_node_datas = self.data.sub_nodes
	for i = 1, #sub_node_datas do
		local sub_node_data = sub_node_datas[i]
		local node_type = sub_node_data.node_type
		local node_data = sub_node_data.data

		if node_data == nil then
			node_data = {}
		end
		
		if self.data.entity ~= nil then
			node_data.entity = self.data.entity
		end

		if self.data.behavior_data then
			node_data.behavior_data = self.data.behavior_data
		end
		
		local sub_node = self.bt_builder:create_node(node_type, self.bt_builder, node_data)
		
		local behavior_data = self.data.behavior_data
		if behavior_data ~= nil and behavior_data[node_type] ~= nil then
			sub_node:set_data(behavior_data[node_type])
		end
		
		self:add_sub_node(sub_node)
	end
end

function bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node:add_sub_node(sub_node)
	table.insert(self.sub_node_activation_history, false)
	table.insert(self.sub_nodes, sub_node)
end

function bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node:dispose()
	self.sub_node_activation_history = nil
	
	if self.sub_nodes ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.sub_nodes do
			self.sub_nodes[i]:dispose()
		end

		self.sub_nodes = nil
	end
end

local effect_type = require('minigame/VirtualCop/Data/EffectTypes') 
local core = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/BTNode')
local camera_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/CameraController')
local entity_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/EntityManager')
local effect_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/EffectController')
local health_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/HealthController')
local shooting_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/ShootingController')

local node_status = core.node_status
local node_base = core.node_base
local parent_node_base = core.bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node

---@class EntitySequenceNode
local entity_sequence_node = newclass('EntitySequenceNode', parent_node_base)

function entity_sequence_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.entity = data.entity

	self:set_up(data)
end

function entity_sequence_node:late_init()
end

function entity_sequence_node:update(dt)
	if not self.entity:is_alive() then
		return node_status.failed
	end

	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_run_result = sub_node:update(dt)

		if sub_node_run_result ~= node_status.succeed then
			return sub_node_run_result
		end
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

---@class ActivateEntityNode 
local activate_entity_node = newclass('ActivateEntityNode', node_base)

function activate_entity_node:init(_, data)
	self.entity_infos = data.entity_infos
end

function activate_entity_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	if self.entity_infos ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.entity_infos do
			local entity_info = self.entity_infos[i]

			local entity = entity_manager:create_entity(entity_info.type)
	
			if entity ~= nil then
				entity_manager:activate_entity(entity, entity_info)
			end
		end
	end


	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

---@class EntityMoveNode
local entity_move_node = newclass('EntityMoveNode', entity_node)

function entity_move_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)

	self.start_pos = nil
	self.dest_pos = nil
	self.duration = nil
	self.direction = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.look_down_after = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.look_down_after, true)

	self.anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.anim, 'run')
	self.emo = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.emo, 'idle')
	
	self.direction = data.direction
end

function entity_move_node:set_data(data)
	self.start_pos = type_util.is_string(data.start_pos) 
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.start_pos)
			or vector(data.start_pos[1], data.start_pos[2], data.start_pos[3])

	self.dest_pos = type_util.is_string(data.dest_pos)
		and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.dest_pos)
		or vector(data.dest_pos[1], data.dest_pos[2], data.dest_pos[3])
			
	self.duration = data.duration
			
	if data.anim ~= nil then
		self.anim = data.anim
	end

	if data.emo ~= nil then
		self.emo = data.emo
	end

	self.direction = data.direction
end

function entity_move_node:late_init()
	if self.direction == nil then
		self.direction = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dest_pos - self.start_pos)
	end
	
	character_util.set_position(self.entity.instance, self.start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, self.direction)
	character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = self.anim })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.entity.instance, { name = self.emo })
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.entity.instance)
end

function entity_move_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = self.dest_pos
		self.is_finished = true
		if self.look_down_after then
			character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, 'down')
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = 'unique/fps_shoot_idle'})
		character_util.remove_anim(self.entity.instance)
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.dest_pos, progress)
	self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = next_pos

	return node_status.running
end

function entity_move_node:dispose()
end

local entity_rotate_node = newclass('EntityRotateNode', node_base)

function entity_rotate_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.original_rotation = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self:set_data(data)
end

function entity_rotate_node:set_data(data)
	self.target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(data.target_rotation[1], data.target_rotation[2], data.target_rotation[3])
	self.duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.duration, 0)
	self.entity_info = data.entity_info
end

function entity_rotate_node:late_init()
	self.entity = entity_manager:create_entity(self.entity_info.type)
	self.entity.instance.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.original_rotation = self.entity.instance.transform.localRotation
end

function entity_rotate_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end
	
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed < self.duration then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed, self.duration)
		local next_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(self.start_rotation, self.target_rotation, progress)
		self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation = next_rotation

		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	self.entity.instance.transform.localRotation = self.target_rotation
	return node_status.succeed
end


---@class EntityBezierMoveNode
local entity_bezier_move_node = newclass('EntityBezierMoveNode', node_base)

function entity_bezier_move_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.waypoints = data.waypoints
	self.duration = data.duration
	self.entity_info = data.entity_info
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.calculator = nil
end

function entity_bezier_move_node:set_data(data)
	self.waypoints = data.waypoints
	self.duration = data.duration
	self.entity_info = data.entity_info
end

function entity_bezier_move_node:late_init()
	self.entity = entity_manager:create_entity(self.entity_info.type)
	self.entity.instance.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()

	local num_waypoints = #self.waypoints
	local curve_type = nil
	local list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 1, #self.waypoints do
		local waypoint = self.waypoints[i]

		if num_waypoints >= 2 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Linear
		end

		if num_waypoints >= 3 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
		end
		if num_waypoints >= 4 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
		end

		if type_util.is_string(waypoint) then
			list:Add(field_util.get_marker_pos(waypoint))
		else
			list:Add(vector(waypoint[1], waypoint[2], waypoint[3]))
		end
	end
	
	self.calculator:Add(list, self.duration, curve_type);
end

function entity_bezier_move_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end
	
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	self.entity.instance.transform.position = self.calculator.CurrentPosition

	if self.time_passed < self.duration then
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

function entity_bezier_move_node:dispose()
end

---@class EntityMoveTwiceNode
-- 빠른 개발을 위해서 이렇게 구현함.
local entity_move_twice_node = newclass('EntityMoveTwiceNode', entity_node)

function entity_move_twice_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)
	
	self.positions = {}
	self.each_move_duration = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.initial_dir = nil

	self.current_pos_idx = 1

	self.anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.anim, 'run')
	self.emo = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.emo, 'idle')
end

function entity_move_twice_node:set_data(data)
	self.positions[1] = type_util.is_string(data.start_pos) 
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.start_pos)
			or vector(data.start_pos[1], data.start_pos[2], data.start_pos[3])

	self.positions[2] = type_util.is_string(data.middle_point_pos)
		and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.middle_point_pos)
		or vector(data.middle_point_pos[1], data.middle_point_pos[2], data.middle_point_pos[3])
	
	self.positions[3] = type_util.is_string(data.dest_pos)
		and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.dest_pos)
		or vector(data.dest_pos[1], data.dest_pos[2], data.dest_pos[3])
	
	self.each_move_duration = data.each_move_duration
			
	if data.anim ~= nil then
		self.anim = data.anim
	end

	if data.emo ~= nil then
		self.emo = data.emo
	end

	if data.initial_dir ~= nil then
		self.initial_dir = data.initial_dir
	end
end

function entity_move_twice_node:late_init()
	if self.initial_dir ~= nil then
		character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, self.initial_dir)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.entity.instance, self.positions[1])
	character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = self.anim })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.entity.instance, { name = self.emo })
end

function entity_move_twice_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.each_move_duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then

		if self.current_pos_idx < #self.positions - 1 then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.current_pos_idx = self.current_pos_idx + 1
			return node_status.running
		end

		self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = self.positions[self.current_pos_idx + 1]
		
		character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, 'down')
		character_util.remove_anim(self.entity.instance)
		
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	local start_pos = self.positions[self.current_pos_idx]
	local dest_pos = self.positions[self.current_pos_idx + 1]
	local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, dest_pos, progress)
	self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = next_pos

	return node_status.running
end

function entity_move_twice_node:dispose()
end


---@class EntityStandUpNode
local entity_stand_up_node = newclass('EntityStandUpNode', entity_node)

function entity_stand_up_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)
	self.start_height = nil
	self.target_height = nil
	self.duration = nil
	self.time_passed = 0
	
	self.sfx = data.sfx
	self.anim = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.anim, 'idle')
	self.emo = data.emo
end

function entity_stand_up_node:set_data(data)
	local start_pos = type_util.is_string(data.start_pos) 
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.start_pos)
			or vector(data.start_pos[1], data.start_pos[2], data.start_pos[3])
	
	character_util.set_position(self.entity.instance, start_pos)
	
	self.start_height = self.entity.instance.transform.position.y
	self.target_height = self.entity.instance.transform.position.y + data.height
	self.duration = data.duration
end

function entity_stand_up_node:late_init()
	character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = self.anim })
	if self.emo ~= nil then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.entity.instance, { name = self.emo })
	end

	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.entity.instance)

	if self.sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.sfx)
	end
end

function entity_stand_up_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	if not self.entity:is_alive() then
		return node_status.failed
	end

	self.super:update(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.duration)
	local entity_cur_pos = self.entity.instance.transform.position

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.is_finished = true
		
		self.entity.instance.transform.position = vector(entity_cur_pos.x, self.target_height, entity_cur_pos.z)
		return node_status.succeed
	end
	
	local current_height = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.start_height, self.target_height, progress)
	self.entity.instance.transform.position = vector(entity_cur_pos.x, current_height, entity_cur_pos.z)

	return node_status.running
end

function entity_stand_up_node:dispose()
end

---@class EnemyJumpEntranceNode
local enemy_jump_entrance_node = newclass('EnemyJumpEntranceNode', entity_node)

function enemy_jump_entrance_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)
	
	self.move_interval = nil
	self.jump_interval = nil
	self.stand_interval = nil
	self.waiting_interval = nil

	self.bezier_calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()
	self.entrance_bezier_points = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	self.total_duration = nil
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.move_start_pos = nil
	self.move_dest_po = nil

	self.has_played_jump_sfx = false
end

function enemy_jump_entrance_node:set_data(data)
	self.move_interval = data.move_duration
	self.jump_interval = data.jump_duration + self.move_interval
	self.stand_interval = data.stand_duration + self.jump_interval
	self.waiting_interval = data.waiting_duration + self.stand_interval

	self.total_duration = data.move_duration
						+ data.jump_duration
						+ data.stand_duration
						+ data.waiting_duration

	self.move_start_pos = type_util.is_string(data.move_start_pos)
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.move_start_pos)
			or vector(data.move_start_pos[1], data.move_start_pos[2], data.move_start_pos[3])

	self.move_dest_pos = type_util.is_string(data.move_dest_pos)
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.move_dest_pos)
			or vector(data.move_dest_pos[1], data.move_dest_pos[2], data.move_dest_pos[3])

	local jump_start_pos = type_util.is_string(data.jump_start_pos)
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.jump_start_pos)
			or vector(data.jump_start_pos[1], data.jump_start_pos[2], data.jump_start_pos[3])
			
	local jump_dest_pos = type_util.is_string(data.jump_dest_pos)
			and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.jump_dest_pos)
			or vector(data.dest_pos[1], data.jump_dest_pos[2], data.jump_dest_pos[3])

	self.entrance_bezier_points:Add(self.move_dest_pos)
	self.entrance_bezier_points:Add(jump_start_pos)
	self.entrance_bezier_points:Add(jump_dest_pos)

	self.bezier_calculator:Add(self.entrance_bezier_points, data.jump_duration, CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic)

	character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, data.entity_dir)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.entity.instance, { name = 'attack' })
end

function enemy_jump_entrance_node:late_init()
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.entity.instance)
end

function enemy_jump_entrance_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 구간에 따라 애니메이션 변경
	if self.time_passed < self.move_interval then
		local move_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.move_interval)
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.move_start_pos, self.move_dest_pos, move_progress)
		self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = next_pos
		character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = 'run' })
	
	elseif self.time_passed >= self.move_interval and self.time_passed < self.jump_interval then
		self.bezier_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = self.bezier_calculator.CurrentPosition
		character_util.set_anim(self.entity.instance, { name = 'get'})

		if not self.has_played_jump_sfx then
			self.has_played_jump_sfx = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', 0.6)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01', 0.6)
		end

	elseif self.time_passed >= self.jump_interval and self.time_passed < self.stand_interval then
		character_util.remove_anim(self.entity.instance)

	elseif self.time_passed >= self.stand_interval and self.time_passed < self.total_duration then
		character_util.set_direction(self.entity.instance, 'down')
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.total_duration then
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	return node_status.running
end

function enemy_jump_entrance_node:dispose()
	self.bezier_calculator = nil
	self.entrance_bezier_points = nil
end

local explosive_move_node = newclass('ExplosiveMoveNode', entity_node)

function explosive_move_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.duration = 3

	self.move_start_pos = nil
	self.move_dest_pos = nil

	self.start_rotation = nil
	self.dest_rotattion = nil

	self.move_height = nil
end

function explosive_move_node:late_init()
	self.move_start_pos = self.entity.instance.transform.position
	local move_distance = vector_util.distance(camera_controller.camera_comp.transform.position, self.move_start_pos)
	local move_vec = vector_util.normalized(camera_controller.camera_comp.transform.position - self.move_start_pos)
	self.move_dest_pos = self.move_start_pos + (move_vec * move_distance * 0.7) + vector(0, -0.25, 0)

	self.start_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, -45)
	self.dest_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -70, 0)

	self.entity.instance.transform.localRotation = self.start_rotation

	self.entity.instance.transform.position = self.move_start_pos
	self.entity.instance.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local diff = math.abs(self.move_start_pos.z - self.move_dest_pos.z)
	self.move_height = math.min(diff / 3, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
end

function explosive_move_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = 	self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.duration)

	if progress >= 1 then
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * self.move_height

	local next_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.move_start_pos, self.move_dest_pos, progress)
	self.entity.instance.transform.localPosition = next_pos + vector(0, y, 0)

	local next_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(self.start_rotation, self.dest_rotation, progress)
	self.entity.instance.transform.localRotation = next_rot

	return node_status.running
end

function explosive_move_node:dispose()
end

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		self.entity.hit_point = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 	self.time_passed + dt
	
	self:entity_blink(dt)
	self:play_second_dead_sfx()
	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.is_finished = true
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.entity.instance, 0, 0)

	if self.blink_time_passed < self.waiting_duration then

	end

	local current_blink = unity_class.mathf.Floor(self.blink_time_passed / self.blink_time_interval)
	if current_blink % 2 == 0 then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.entity.instance, 0, 0)

---@class HelicopterDroppingRopeNode
local helicopter_dropping_rope_node = newclass('HelicopterDroppingRopeNode', entity_node)

function helicopter_dropping_rope_node:init(_, data)
	self.super:init(data.entity)
	
	self.rope_data = data.rope_data
	self.entity_info = data.entity_info

	self.total_duration = data.duration
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.hookshots = {}
	self.hookshot_comps = {}

	self.init_positions = {}
	self.dest_positions = {}

	self.layer_name = 'SpecialEvents'
end

function helicopter_dropping_rope_node:late_init()
	if self.rope_data == nil or self.entity_info == nil then
		return
	end

	self.entity = entity_manager:create_entity(self.entity_info.type)

	local heli_transform = self.entity.instance.transform
	local heli_pos = heli_transform.position
	local heli_rot = heli_transform.rotation
	
	local hookshot_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('hookshot')
	
	for i = 1, #self.rope_data do
		local rope_data = self.rope_data[i]
		local adj_pos_data = rope_data.adj_pos
		local adj_pos = type_util.is_string(adj_pos_data) 
					and field_util.get_marker_pos(adj_pos_data)
					or vector(adj_pos_data[1], adj_pos_data[2], adj_pos_data[3])

		local rope = hookshot_pool:Instantiate(heli_pos, heli_rot, heli_transform)
		rope.transform.position = heli_transform.position + adj_pos
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(rope.transform, self.layer_name)
		
		table.insert(self.hookshots, rope)
		table.insert(self.init_positions, rope.transform.position)
		table.insert(self.dest_positions, rope.transform.position - vector(0, rope_data.length, 0))

		CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(rope.transform, 'head').gameObject:SetActive(false)
		table.insert(self.hookshot_comps, rope:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot)))
	end
end

function helicopter_dropping_rope_node:set_data(data)
	self.entity_info = data.entity_info
	self.total_duration = data.duration
end

function helicopter_dropping_rope_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed < self.total_duration then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.total_duration)

		for i = 1, #self.hookshot_comps do
			local next_dest_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.init_positions[i], self.dest_positions[i], progress)
			self.hookshot_comps[i]:SetFromTo(self.init_positions[i], next_dest_pos)
		end

		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

function helicopter_dropping_rope_node:dispose()
	if self.hookshots ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.hookshots do
			self.hookshots[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.hookshots = nil
	end

	self.hookshot_comps = nil
end

function sequence_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
	self:set_up()
end

function sequence_node:late_init()
	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = false
		sub_node.is_finished = false
	end
end

function sequence_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_run_result = sub_node:update(dt)

		if sub_node_run_result ~= node_status.succeed then
			return sub_node_run_result
		end
	end

	self.is_finished = true

	return node_status.succeed
end

	return node_status.succeed
end

function single_battle_node:camera_focus_to_target(target_transform, dt)
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.cam_focus_time_passed / self.cam_focus_duration)
	
	if (progress >= 1) then
		return
	end
	
	local planes = CS.Oak.GeometryUtil.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera_controller.camera_comp)
	
	-- 엔티티가 카메라 범위내에 들어와있는 상태인지 먼저 확인.
	if (CS.Oak.GeometryUtil.TestPlanesAABB(planes, self.target_entity_collider.bounds)) then
		self.cam_focus_time_passed = self.cam_focus_time_passed + dt

		local cam_transform = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform
		local cam_pos = cam_transform.position
		local cam_to_target_vec = target_transform.localPosition - cam_pos
		local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(cam_to_target_vec)

		cam_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(self.inital_cam_rotation, look_rotation, progress)
		
		local cur_fov = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.inital_cam_fov, self.cam_focus_fov, progress)
		camera_controller.camera_comp.fieldOfView = cur_fov
	end
end

---@class DoubleBattleNode
local double_battle_node = newclass('DoubleBattleNode', core.node_base)

function double_battle_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init()
	self.data = data
	self.bt_builder = bt_builder

	self.interval = data.interval
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.cam_focus_time_passed = 0
	self.cam_focus_duration = data.cam_focus_duration
	self.cam_focus_rotation = nil
	self.cam_focus_fov = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.cam_focus_fov, camera_controller.default_fov)

	self.updating_entities = {}
	self.entities = nil

	self.inital_cam_rotation = nil
	self.cam_reset_requested = false
end

function double_battle_node:late_init()
	-- 이번 전투에서 사용되는 적 엔티티 활성화
	self.entities = entity_manager:create_entities(self.data.enemy_info)
	entity_manager:activate_entity(self.entities[1], self.data.enemy_info[1])
	table.insert(self.updating_entities, self.entities[1])

	for i = 1, #self.entities do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.entities[i].instance, 1, 0)
	end

	self.cam_focus_rotation = self:find_focus_rotation()

	self.inital_cam_rotation = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform.localRotation
	self.inital_cam_fov = camera_controller.camera_comp.fieldOfView
end

function double_battle_node:find_focus_rotation()
	local function get_position(v)
		if type_util.is_string(v) then
			return field_util.get_marker_pos(v)
		end

		return vector(v[1], v[2], v[3])
	end

	local focus_point = unity_class.vector3.zero

	if self.data.focus_point ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_array(self.data.focus_point) then
			for i = 1, #self.data.focus_point do
				focus_point = focus_point + get_position(self.data.focus_point[i])
			end

			focus_point = focus_point / 2

		elseif type_util.is_string(self.data.focus_point) then
			focus_point = get_position(self.data.focus_point)
		end
	else
		for i = 1, 2 do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.entities[i].instance, 1, 0)
			focus_point = focus_point + self.entities[i].instance.transform.position
		end

		focus_point = focus_point / 2
	end

	local cam_focus_start = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform.position

	return unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(focus_point - cam_focus_start)
end

function double_battle_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end
	
	-- 적 중간 지점에 에게 카메라 포커스
	self:set_camera_focusing(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local is_any_entity_alive = false

	for i = 1, #self.entities do
		if self.entities[i]:is_alive() then
			is_any_entity_alive = true
		end
	end

	local is_first_entity_dead = not self.entities[1]:is_alive()
	local is_time_passed_over_interval = self.time_passed > self.interval
	local is_num_updating_entities_under_total = #self.updating_entities < #self.entities
	local is_able_to_add_new_entity = is_num_updating_entities_under_total 
									and (is_first_entity_dead or is_time_passed_over_interval)

	if is_able_to_add_new_entity then
		entity_manager:activate_entity(self.entities[2], self.data.enemy_info[2])
		table.insert(self.updating_entities, self.entities[2])
	end
	if is_any_entity_alive then
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

function double_battle_node:set_camera_focusing(dt)
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.cam_focus_time_passed / self.cam_focus_duration)
	
	if (progress >= 1) then
		return
	end
	
	self.cam_focus_time_passed = self.cam_focus_time_passed + dt

	local cam_transform = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform
	cam_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(self.inital_cam_rotation, self.cam_focus_rotation, progress)
	
	local cur_fov = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.inital_cam_fov, self.cam_focus_fov, progress)
	camera_controller.camera_comp.fieldOfView = cur_fov
end

---@class TripleBattleNode
local triple_battle_node = newclass('TrippleBattleNode', core.node_base)

function triple_battle_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init()
	self.data = data
	self.bt_budiler = bt_builder

	-- 카메라 포커싱 과련 파라매터
	self.cam_focus_target_index = 1
	self.cam_focus_time_passed = 0
	self.cam_focus_duration = data.cam_focus_duration
	self.target_cam_fov = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.target_cam_fov, camera_controller.default_fov)
	self.target_cam_rotation = nil

	-- 초기에 설정할 엔티티 좌표
	self.entity_init_pos = type_util.is_string(data.entity_init_pos)
				and field_util.get_marker_pos(data.entity_init_pos)
				or vector(data.entity_init_pos[1], data.entity_init_pos[2], data.entity_init_pos[3])

	-- 카메라 업데이트 경과 시간
	self.cam_rotation_update_time_passed = 0
	self.cam_fov_update_time_passed = 0

	-- 카메라 초기 파라매터
	self.inital_cam_fov = nil
	self.current_cam_fov = nil

	-- 이번 전투에서 사용될 엔티티 리스트
	self.entities = {}

	-- 현재까지 업데이트를 돌리고 있는 엔티티 들
	self.updating_entities = {}

	-- 마지막 엔티티 등장 후 경과한 시간
	self.entity_entrance_time_passed = 0

	-- 각 엔티티 등장 간격
	self.entity_entrance_interval = data.entity_entrance_interval
end

function triple_battle_node:late_init()
	self.inital_cam_fov = camera_controller.camera_comp.fieldOfView

	-- 이번 전투에서 사용되는 적 엔티티 활성화
	self.entities = entity_manager:create_entities(self.data.enemy_info)
	entity_manager:activate_entity(self.entities[1], self.data.enemy_info[1])
	table.insert(self.updating_entities, self.entities[1])

	for i = 1, #self.entities do
		self.entities[i].instance.transform.position = self.entity_init_pos
	end

	-- self.entities = entity_manager:activate_entities(self.data.enemy_info)

	-- 첫 번째 엔티티를 포커스 대상으로 적용
	self.cam_focus_target = self.entities[self.cam_focus_target_index]

	for i = 1, #self.entities do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.entities[i].instance, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 카메라가 포커스할 대상 선택
	self.target_entity_collider = self.cam_focus_target.instance.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
end

function triple_battle_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end
	
	-- 카메라 포커스 대상 업데이트
	local current_focus_target = self.entities[self.cam_focus_target_index]
	local updated_cam_focus_target = self:update_camera_focus_target(current_focus_target)

	-- 적 중간 지점에 에게 카메라 포커스
	local planes = CS.Oak.GeometryUtil.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera_controller.camera_comp)
	
	-- 엔티티가 카메라 범위내에 들어와있는 상태인지 먼저 확인.
	if current_focus_target ~= nil and current_focus_target:is_alive() then
		if (CS.Oak.GeometryUtil.TestPlanesAABB(planes, self.target_entity_collider.bounds)) then
			self:update_camera_rotation(updated_cam_focus_target, dt)
			self:update_camera_fov(updated_cam_focus_target, dt)
		end
	end

	return self:update_entities(dt)
end

function triple_battle_node:update_camera_focus_target(current_target)
	local is_current_target_alive = current_target:is_alive()
	local is_index_inside_of_range = self.cam_focus_target_index < #self.entities
	
	if is_current_target_alive then
		return current_target.instance
	end
	
	if is_index_inside_of_range then
		local next_target = self.entities[self.cam_focus_target_index].instance
		self.cam_fov_update_time_passed = 0
		self.cam_rotation_update_time_passed = 0
		self.inital_cam_fov = self.target_cam_fov
		self.target_cam_fov = self.target_cam_fov - 0.2
		self.cam_focus_target_index = self.cam_focus_target_index + 1
		self.target_entity_collider = next_target.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
		return next_target
	end

	return nil
end

function triple_battle_node:update_camera_rotation(current_target, dt)
	if current_target == nil then
		return
	end

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.cam_rotation_update_time_passed / self.cam_focus_duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		return
	end
	
	self.cam_rotation_update_time_passed = self.cam_rotation_update_time_passed + dt
	
	local cam_transform = camera_controller.camera_comp.transform
	local cam_pos = cam_transform.position
	local cam_to_target_vec = current_target.transform.localPosition - cam_pos
	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(cam_to_target_vec)
	local current_rotation = cam_transform.localRotation
	cam_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, look_rotation, progress)
end

function triple_battle_node:update_camera_fov(updated_cam_focus_target, dt)
	if updated_cam_focus_target == nil then
		return
	end

	local progress =  unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.cam_fov_update_time_passed / self.cam_focus_duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		return
	end
	
	self.cam_fov_update_time_passed = self.cam_fov_update_time_passed + dt
	local cur_fov = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.inital_cam_fov, self.target_cam_fov, progress)
	camera_controller.camera_comp.fieldOfView = cur_fov
end

function triple_battle_node:update_entities(dt)
	-- 엔티티 등장 후 경과한 시간 업데이트
	self.entity_entrance_time_passed = self.entity_entrance_time_passed + dt
	
	local num_dead_entities = 0
	for i = 1, #self.updating_entities do
		if not self.updating_entities[i]:is_alive() then
			num_dead_entities = num_dead_entities + 1
		end
	end


	local is_time_passed_over_interval = self.entity_entrance_time_passed >= self.entity_entrance_interval
	local is_num_updating_entities_under_total = #self.updating_entities < #self.entities
	local is_able_to_add_new_entity = is_time_passed_over_interval and is_num_updating_entities_under_total

	if is_able_to_add_new_entity then
		self.entity_entrance_time_passed = 0
		local current_updating_count = #self.updating_entities
		local next_entity = self.entities[current_updating_count + 1]
		local next_entity_info = self.data.enemy_info[current_updating_count + 1]
		entity_manager:activate_entity(next_entity, next_entity_info)
	
		table.insert(self.updating_entities, self.entities[current_updating_count + 1])
	end

	if num_dead_entities < #self.entities then
		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end

---@class KeepRepeatUntilOtherFinishednode
local keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node = newclass('KeepRepeatUntilOtherFinishednode', core.node_base)

function keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init()
	self.bt_builder = bt_builder

	self.other_node = nil
	self.keep_repeating_nodes = {}
	self.finished_node_indexes = {}
	self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history = {}
	self.is_other_node_activated = false
	
	self:set_up_other_node(data.other_node)
	self:set_up_keep_repeating_nodes(data.keep_repeating_nodes)
end

function keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node:set_up_other_node(other_node)
	self.other_node = self.bt_builder:create_node(other_node.node_type, self.bt_builder, other_node.data)
end

function keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node:set_up_keep_repeating_nodes(keep_repeating_nodes)
	for i = 1, #keep_repeating_nodes do
		local sub_node_data = keep_repeating_nodes[i]
		local node_type = sub_node_data.node_type
		local node_data = sub_node_data.data
		local sub_node = self.bt_builder:create_node(node_type, self.bt_builder, node_data)

		table.insert(self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history, false)
		table.insert(self.keep_repeating_nodes, sub_node)
	end
end


function keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	if not self.is_other_node_activated then
		self.is_other_node_activated = true
		self.other_node:late_init()
	end

	-- 다른 노드 업데이트
	local other_node_result = self.other_node:update(dt)
	local is_other_node_finished = other_node_result == node_status.succeed
	
	-- 완료 된 반복 노드들 수
	local num_finished_node = 0

	-- 계속 반복되어야하는 서브 노드들을 업데이트하고...
    for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.keep_repeating_nodes) do
		if not self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history[idx] then
			self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_result = sub_node:update(dt)
		local is_sub_node_finished = sub_node_result ~= node_status.running

		if is_sub_node_finished then
			num_finished_node = num_finished_node + 1
		end

		if is_sub_node_finished and not is_other_node_finished then
			table.insert(self.finished_node_indexes, idx)
		end
    end

	local is_all_keep_repeating_node_finished = num_finished_node == #self.keep_repeating_nodes
	
	if is_other_node_finished and is_all_keep_repeating_node_finished then
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	for _, idx in ipairs(self.finished_node_indexes) do
		self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history[idx] = false
		self.keep_repeating_nodes[idx].is_finished = false
	end

	self.finished_node_indexes = {}

	return node_status.running
end

function keep_repeat_until_other_finished_node:dispose()
	self.keep_repeating_nodes_activation_history = nil
	
	if self.keep_repeating_nodes ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.keep_repeating_nodes do
			self.keep_repeating_nodes[i]:dispose()
		end

		self.keep_repeating_nodes = nil
	end

	if self.other_node ~= nil then
		self.other_node:dispose()
		self.other_node = nil
	end
end

---@class ParallelNode
-- Runs all child nodes in parallel.
-- Continues to run until a required number of child nodes have eiter failed or succeeded.
local parallel_node = newclass('ParallelNode', bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node)

function parallel_node:init(bt_builder, data)
    self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
    self.num_required_to_success = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.num_required_to_success, 0)
	self.num_required_to_fail = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.num_require_to_fail, 0)
	self.cached_result = node_status.running
	self:set_up()
end

function parallel_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return self.cached_result
	end

	local num_succeed = 0
	local num_failed = 0
    for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_result = sub_node:update(dt)

        if sub_node_result == node_status.succeed then
			num_succeed = num_succeed + 1
		elseif sub_node_result == node_status.failed then
			num_failed = num_failed + 1
		end
    end

	if (self.num_required_to_success > 0) and (num_succeed >= self.num_required_to_success) then
		self.cached_result = node_status.succeed
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	if (self.num_required_to_fail > 0) and (num_failed >= self.num_required_to_fail) then
		self.cached_result = node_status.failed
		self.is_finished = true
		return node_status.failed
	end

    return node_status.running
end


-- Selector Node
local selector_node = newclass('SelectorNode', bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node)

function selector_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
	self:set_up()
end

function selector_node:update(dt)
	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end
		
		local sub_node_run_result = sub_node:update(dt)

        if sub_node_run_result ~= node_status.failed then
            return sub_node_run_result
        end
	end

	return node_status.failed
end

---@class RepeatNode 
local repeat_node = newclass('RepeatNode', bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node)

function repeat_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
	self:set_up()

	self.num_repeated = 0
	self.repeat_count = data.repeat_count
end

function repeat_node:update(dt)
	if self.is_finished then
		return node_status.succeed
	end

	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_run_result = sub_node:update(dt)

		if sub_node_run_result ~= node_status.succeed then
			return sub_node_run_result
		end
	end

	self.num_repeated = self.num_repeated + 1

	if self.num_repeated < self.repeat_count then
		for idx = 1, #self.sub_nodes do
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = false
			self.sub_nodes[idx].is_finished = false
		end

		return node_status.running
	end

	self.is_finished = true
	return node_status.succeed
end


---@class KeepRepeat
local keep_repeat_node = newclass('KeepRepeatNode', bt_parent_behaviour_tree_node)

function keep_repeat_node:init(bt_builder, data)
	self.super:init(bt_builder, data)
	self:set_up()
end

function keep_repeat_node:update(dt)
	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		if not self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] then
			self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = true
			sub_node:late_init()
		end

		local sub_node_run_result = sub_node:update(dt)

		if sub_node_run_result ~= node_status.succeed then
			return sub_node_run_result
		end
	end

	-- 여기까지 왔다는건 모든 서브 노드 다 한번씩 돌아다는 뜻. 강제로 리셋 시켜서 다시 반복 될 수 있게끔 한다.
	for idx, sub_node in ipairs(self.sub_nodes) do
		self.sub_node_activation_history[idx] = false
	end

	return node_status.running
end

local loader_interface = require('minigame/VirtualCop/Resources/ResourceLoader')

end

function civilwar_loader:load_async()
	self:load_virtual_cop_prefab_async()
	self:load_entity_data_async()
	self:load_no_bend_shader_container()
end

function civilwar_loader:load_virtual_cop_prefab_async()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 미니 게임용 프리팹
	self.virtual_cop = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, self.assetbundle_path, 'virtual_cop')
	local camera_inst = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.virtual_cop.transform, 'Main Camera')
	self.camera_red_vignette = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.virtual_cop.transform, 'screen_red_vignette')
	self.camera_hit_effect = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.virtual_cop.transform, 'hit_effect')
	self.camera_comp = camera_inst:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	-- 폭탄 리소스
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'tilesets/gimmick', 'gimmick.tileset', function(prefab)
			self.prefabs['bomb'] = prefab.transform:Find('[GIMMICK]gunpowderpot')
			prefab.transform:Find('Main Camera')
		end)

	-- 헬리콥터 리소스
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/characters/boss_helicopter', 'boss_helicopter', function(prefab)
			self.prefabs['helicopter'] = prefab
		end)

	-- 버추얼캅 UI
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/ui', 'CivilWarMiniGameUI', function(prefab)
			self.prefabs['virtual_cop_ui'] = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			self.virtual_cop_ui = self.prefabs['virtual_cop_ui']:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.CivilWarMiniGameUI)).GetControllerLuaTable
			self.virtual_cop_ui:set_stage_camera(self.camera_comp)
		end)

	-- 미니 게임용 내비게이션 바
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'ui/stage/minigame', 'MiniGameNavigationBar', function(prefab)
			self.prefabs['navigation_ui'] = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			self.navigation_ui = self.prefabs['navigation_ui']:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameNavigationBar)).GetControllerLuaTable
		end)
end

function civilwar_loader:load_entity_data_async()
	self.entity_data = require('minigame/VirtualCop/Data/EntityData')[self.data_key]
end

function civilwar_loader:load_no_bend_shader_container()
	self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, self.assetbundle_path, 'virtual_cop_shader_container')
	self.no_bend_shader = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList[0]
end

function civilwar_loader:get_resources()
	return {
		camera = self.camera_comp,
		camera_red_vignette = self.camera_red_vignette,
		camera_hit_effect = self.camera_hit_effect,
		entity_data = self.entity_data,
		no_bend_shader = self.no_bend_shader,
		virtual_cop_ui = self.virtual_cop_ui,
		navigation_ui = self.navigation_ui,
		prefabs = self.prefabs
	}
end

function civilwar_loader:dispose()
	self.camera_comp = nil
	
	-- Destroy 시켜줘야함
	if not is_unity_null(self.virtual_cop) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.virtual_cop)
		self.virtual_cop = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.shader_container) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.shader_container)
		self.shader_container = nil
	end

	self.camera_red_vignette = nil
	
	self.camera_hit_effect = nil

	self.shader_container = nil

	self.no_bend_shader = nil

	self.prefabs = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

return civilwar_loader

local local_class = newclass('PastureMonsterAdoption')

function local_class:init(cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour

	-- 데이터 세팅
	local data_key = 'default'
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data('OnExecute/Pasture/PastureConstants', data_key)

	-- 몬스터 매니저
	self.monster_manager = CS.Oak.HeavenHoldPastureSystem.Instance.MonsterManager

	self.monster_list = nil
	self.npc_list = nil
	self.npc_guard1 = get_character(self.data.guard1_handle_name)
	self.npc_guard1_init_pos = self.npc_guard1.Position
	self.npc_guard2 = get_character(self.data.guard2_handle_name)
	self.npc_guard2_init_pos = self.npc_guard2.Position
end

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--region Main

function local_class:start()
	self.cs_behaviour.IsExecuting = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_presentation, self))
end

-- 몬스터와 NPC 리스트 받아와서 Lua 테이블로 변경
function local_class:set(param)
	self.monster_list = {}
	self.npc_list = {}

	for i = 0, param.monsterCharacterList.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.monster_list, param.monsterCharacterList[i])
	end

	for i = 0, param.npcControllerList.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.npc_list, param.npcControllerList[i])
	end
end

function local_class:stop()
	self.cs_behaviour.IsExecuting = false
end

function local_class:play_presentation()
	-- 연출 준비
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	-- 플레이어 배치
	local init_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	user_party.Leader.Position = vector(15, 0, 9)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	local min_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	if #self.npc_list >= 3 then
		min_z = min_z - 1
	end
	local max_z = min_z + #self.npc_list - 1

	-- NPC 배치
	for i, npc in ipairs(self.npc_list) do
		npc.ShadowOffsetY = 0
		npc.Transform.localPosition = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x + 3, 0, min_z + i - 1)
		npc.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		npc:SetAnimation(1, 'idle', true)
	end

	-- 몬스터 배치
	for i, monster in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(monster)
		monster.Position = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x - 1, 0, min_z + i - 1)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, 'right')
	end

	-- 와이번 표정
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_guard1, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_guard2, { name = 'tired' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 연출 메인
	-- 플레이어와 몬스터 마주 보고 인사 나눔
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	for _, monster in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'victory' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 플레이어 비켜줌
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, max_z + 1), nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')

	-- NPC 앞으로 이동
	for i, monster in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		if i == #self.monster_list then
			character_util.move_to_async(monster, monster.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)
		else
			character_util.move_to(monster, monster.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- NPC와 상호작용
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		local npc = self.npc_list[i]
		local monster = self.monster_list[i]
		npc:SetAnimation(1, 'sing', true)
		npc:SetEmotion('love', true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(monster, { name = 'happy' }, { name = 'smile' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- NPC와 몬스터가 목장을 떠남
	self.leave_count = 0
	self.sync_on = true
	for i = 1, #self.npc_list do
		local npc = self.npc_list[i]
		local monster = self.monster_list[i]
		npc:SetAnimation(1, 'sing', true)
		npc:SetEmotion('love', true)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(monster, { name = 'happy' }, { name = 'smile' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.leave_together, self, npc, monster))
	end

	while self.leave_count < #self.npc_list do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.sync_on = false

	-- exit 숨기기
	local exit = field:GetFieldObject('exit')
	exit.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	-- 플레이어가 몬스터 떠나간 곳으로 달려감
	character_util.move_to(self.npc_guard1, vector(self.npc_guard1.Position.x + 1.5, 0, 3), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.move_to(self.npc_guard2, vector(self.npc_guard2.Position.x - 1.5, 0, 3), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, vector(16.5, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, 2), nil, 8, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success' }, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_guard1, { name = 'cry' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_guard2, { name = 'cry' })
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_cry_01')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_07')

	wait_for_sec(2)
	-- 나레이션 : 몬스터들이 새로운 주인들을 만나서 행복하게 살 겁니다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'pasture_adoption_narration' })

	-- 연출 종료
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_guard1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_guard2)
	self.npc_guard1.Position = self.npc_guard1_init_pos
	self.npc_guard2.Position = self.npc_guard2_init_pos
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_guard1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_guard2, 'down')
	user_party.Leader.Position = init_pos
	exit.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self:stop()
end

-- 몬스터랑 NPC 함께 떠남
function local_class:leave_together(npc, monster)
	npc:SetAnimation(1, 'walk', true)
	character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')
	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sync_npc, self, npc, monster))
	character_util.move_to_async(monster, vector(16, 0, monster.Position.z), nil, 2, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(monster, vector(monster.Position.x, 0,  3), nil, 2, true, true)
	monster.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	npc.Transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.leave_count = self.leave_count + 1
end

-- NPC 좌표와 방향을 몬스터와 싱크 시킴
function local_class:sync_npc(npc, monster)
	while self.sync_on == true do
		npc.Transform.localPosition = monster.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
		npc.Direction = monster.Direction
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('PastureObservationPetBed')

function local_class:init()

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		wait = 1,
		jump = 2,
		sleep = 3,
		exit = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.wait_duration = 0.1
	self.jump_time = 0.3
	self.sleep_time = 10
	self.exit_time = 0.5
	self.init_pos = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine(interactor, exit_pos)
	self.interactor = interactor

	self.exit_pos = exit_pos
	self:change_state(self.state.wait)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sleep then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		self.interactor:RemoveEmotion()
		self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_land_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + vector(0,1,0)
		self.init_pos = self.interactor.Position
		local move = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position)
		self.move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(move) / self.jump_time
		self.dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(move))
		self.height = move.y
		self.mod = -self.height / self.dist^2

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sleep then
		self.interactor.Position = self.target_pos

		self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('sleep', true)
		self.interactor:SetEmotion('sleep', true)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_sleep_03', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5, volume = 0.4})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.exit_pos
		self.init_pos = self.interactor.Position
		local move = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position)
		self.move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(move) / self.exit_time
		self.dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(move))
		self.height = self.interactor.Position.y
		self.mod = -self.height / self.dist^2

		self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(
				vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector), CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		self.cs_behaviour:FinishRoutine()
	end

end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed > self.wait_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local xz_move = self.time_passed * self.move_vector
		self.interactor.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.init_pos + xz_move,
				self.mod * (vector_util.magnitude(xz_move) - self.dist)^2 + self.height)

		if self.time_passed > self.jump_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.sleep)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.sleep then
		if self.time_passed > self.sleep_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.exit)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		local xz_move = self.time_passed * self.move_vector
		self.interactor.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.init_pos + xz_move,
				math.max(self.mod * vector_util.magnitude(xz_move)^2 + self.height, 0))

		if self.time_passed > self.exit_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:end_routine()
	self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	self.interactor:RemoveEmotion()
	self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.cs_behaviour = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end


function local_class:update_building(pooled_object)
end

function local_class:remove_building()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('PastureObservationPetwheel')

function local_class:init()

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		enter = 1,
		running = 2,
		action = 3,
		exit = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.enter_duration = 0.5
	self.running_duration = 12
	self.action_duration = 3
	self.exit_duration = 0.5

	self.begin_speed = 0.8
	self.running_speed = 1.2
	self.end_speed = 0.8

	self.accel_duration = 2
	self.middle_duration = 6.5

	self.is_damaged = false

	self.sfx_holder = nil

end

function local_class:start_routine(interactor, exit_pos)
	self.interactor = interactor
	self.exit_pos = exit_pos
	local child_count = self.fo.Transform.childCount
	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
		local child = self.fo.Transform:GetChild(i)
		if string.match(child.name, 'pet_wheel') then
			self.wheel = child
			break
		end
	end
	self.animator = self.wheel:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.animator.speed = 1
	self:change_state(self.state.enter)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_land_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.running then
		self.animator:Play('idle')
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.interactor)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_land_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + vector(0, 1, - 0.7)
		self.move_vector = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position) / self.enter_duration
		self.interactor.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector)
		self.interactor.SpineController:Jump(self.target_pos.y, self.enter_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.running then
		self.interactor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		self.animator:Play('roaming')
		self.sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wheel_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, duration = 8.5, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
		self.is_damaged = false
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.interactor.Position = self.target_pos
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('idle', true)
		self.interactor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		character_util.set_emotion(self.interactor, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.show_emoticon(self.interactor, nil, CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Happy)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.exit_pos
		self.move_vector = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position) / self.exit_duration
		self.interactor.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector)
		self.interactor.SpineController:Jump(self.interactor.Position.y - 0.25, self.exit_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		self.cs_behaviour:FinishRoutine()
	end

end

function local_class:update_running()

	if self.time_passed < self.accel_duration then
		local begin_cur_speed = self.begin_speed + (self.running_speed - self.begin_speed) * (self.time_passed / self.accel_duration)
		character_util.set_anim(self.interactor, { name = 'run', scale = begin_cur_speed })

	elseif self.time_passed >= self.accel_duration + self.middle_duration then
		if self.is_damaged == false then
			self.is_damaged = true
			self.sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_wheel_loop_01', loop = true, fade_out_time = 3.5, duration = 3.5, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
		end

		local remain_duration = self.running_duration - (self.middle_duration + self.accel_duration)
		local elapsed_time = self.time_passed - (self.middle_duration + self.accel_duration)

		local end_speed = self.running_speed + (self.end_speed - self.running_speed) * (elapsed_time / remain_duration)
		character_util.set_anim(self.interactor, { name = 'walk', scale = end_speed })
	end

end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		if self.time_passed > self.enter_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.running)
		else
			self.interactor.Position = self.interactor.Position + self.move_vector * dt
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.running then
		if self.time_passed > self.running_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			self:update_running()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.exit)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor.Position = self.interactor.Position + self.move_vector * dt
		if self.time_passed > self.exit_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:end_routine()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.interactor)

	if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.sfx_holder = nil
	end

		self.animator:Play('idle')
	end

local local_class = newclass('PastureObservationPetWheelInteractive')

function local_class:init(cs_behaviour)

	self.npc_guard2 = nil			-- 문지기 와이번2

	self.monster_list = nil			-- 그 외 몬스터 리스트
	self.wait_time = 1				-- 다음 몬스터 모이는 대기 시간
	self.gauge = 0					-- 속도 게이지
	self.fall_delay = 0				-- 속도가 떨어지는 지연 시간
	self.game_started = false		-- 게임 시작 여부
	self.game_over = false			-- 게임 오버 여부

end

end

--region Event
-- 달리기 버튼 눌렀을 때
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 게임이 시작되지 않았거나 게임 오버 상태이면 무시
	if self.game_started == false or self.game_over == true then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		if self.button_pushed ~= true then
			self.button_pushed = true
			self.gauge = self.gauge + 5
			self.mini_game_ui:SetArrowMoveIndex(self.gauge)
			self.mini_game_ui:ShowCurrDotEffect()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_select_item_01', 0.5)

	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
		self.button_pushed = false
	end

	return false

		print('wheel cheat immortal : ON')

	self.cheat_immortal = false
	print('wheel cheat immortal : OFF')

	return true
end

--region Main
function local_class:interact(monster_id)

	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run

	-- 연출 메인
	self.main_play_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.main_play, self))

		coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })

	-- 건초 보이기

		local ricestraw = get_field_object('ricestraw_' .. i)

	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_guard1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_guard2, 'down')

-- 게임 UI
function local_class:game_ui_show()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end
end

-- 연출 메인
function local_class:main_play()
	local animator = self.wheel:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:SetBool('is_on', true)
	self.gauge = 0
	self.fall_delay = 0
	self.game_started = true

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

	-- 몬스터 달리기 시작
	character_util.set_anim(self.main_monster, { name = 'run' })

	-- 가속
	local speed = 1
	while speed < 2 do
		speed = speed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		animator.speed = speed
		character_util.set_anim(self.main_monster, { name = 'run', scale = speed })
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.sfx_wheel = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_wheel_loop_01', loop = true, volume = 0.6})

	-- 시간에 따른 게이지 감소
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gauge_move, self))

	-- 한 마리씩 챗바퀴 앞으로 모임
	for i, fo in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		self:get_together(self.main_monster.Position, fo, i - 1)
	end

	local member_list = { self.npc_guard1, self.npc_guard2, self.npc_raccoon, user_party.Leader }
	for i = 1, 4 do
		self:get_together(self.main_monster.Position, member_list[i], i + 8)
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 마무리 연출
	animator:SetBool('is_on', false)
	character_util.set_anim(self.main_monster, { name = 'victory', loop = false })
	-- 몬스터
	character_util.set_anim(self.main_monster, { name = 'victory', loop = false })
	for _, fo in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'victory', loop = false })
	end

	-- 와이번
	for i = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(member_list[i], { name = 'victory', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
	end

	-- 너굴걸, 플레이어
	for i = 3, 4 do
		character_util.set_anim(member_list[i], { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	self:gameover(0)
end

-- 게이지 자동 감소
function local_class:gauge_move()
	while self.game_over == false do
		self.gauge = self.gauge - 1
		if self.cheat_immortal == false and self.gauge < - 5 then
			self:gameover(1)
		else
			self.mini_game_ui:SetArrowMoveLeft()
			self.mini_game_ui:ShowCurrDotEffect()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_select_item_01', 0.5)
			local delay = math.max(1 - self.fall_delay * 0.1, 0.1)
			wait_for_sec(delay)
		end
	end
end

-- 게임 오버 처리
function local_class:gameover(case)
	self.game_over = true
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	self.mini_game_ui:HideUI()
	local animator = self.wheel:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	if self.sfx_wheel ~= nil then
		self.sfx_wheel:FadeOut(2)
		self.sfx_wheel = nil
	end

	-- 속도가 떨어져서 게임 오버
	if case == 1 then
		stop_coroutine(self.main_play_coroutine)
		self:remove_all_anim()
		animator:SetBool('is_on', false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'tired'})
	-- 속도가 빨라서 게임 오버
	elseif case == 2 then
		stop_coroutine(self.main_play_coroutine)
		self:remove_all_anim()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.set_emotion(self.main_monster, { name = 'damaged'})

		local out_pos = vector(self.main_monster.Position.x + 3, 0, self.main_monster.Position.z - 2)
		self:face_to(user_party.Leader, out_pos)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.monster_out, self, out_pos))
	end

	self.main_play_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reserve_playend, self))
end

-- 3초후 연출 마무리
function local_class:reserve_playend()
	wait_for_sec(3)
	self.game_started = false
end

-- 모든 캐릭터 애니메이션 없애기
function local_class:remove_all_anim()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_raccoon)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_guard1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_guard2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.main_monster)
	for _, fo in ipairs(self.monster_list) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
	end
end

-- 챗바퀴 앞에 집합
function local_class:get_together(centerPos, mon, n)
	local move_speed = 8
	self.fall_delay = self.fall_delay + 1

	if mon == self.npc_raccoon or mon == user_party.Leader then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01', 0.6)
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_together_sfx, self))
	end

	if mon == self.npc_guard1 then
		character_util.move_to_async(mon, mon.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, move_speed, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(mon, mon.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), nil, move_speed, true)
	elseif mon == self.npc_guard1 then
		character_util.move_to_async(mon, mon.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, move_speed, true)
		character_util.move_to_async(mon, mon.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), nil, move_speed, true)
	end

	local pos = self:alignXAxis(centerPos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), n)
	character_util.set_anim(mon, { name =  'run' })
	self:face_to(mon, centerPos)
	character_util.move_to_async(mon, pos, nil, move_speed)
	character_util.set_direction(mon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(self.wait_time)
end

-- 모였을 때 효과음
function local_class:get_together_sfx()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
end

-- 챗바퀴 앞에 정렬
function local_class:alignXAxis(pos, n)
	local centerX = pos.x
	local centerZ = pos.z

	if n >= 7 then
		centerZ = centerZ - 0.7
		centerX = centerX - 0.35
		n = n - 7
	end

	for i = 1, n do
		if i % 2 == 1 then
			centerX = centerX + (i * 0.7)
		else
			centerX = centerX - (i * 0.7)
		end
	end

	return vector(centerX, 0, centerZ)
end

-- 몬스터 튕겨 나감
function local_class:monster_out(out_pos)
	self.is_roatate_monster = true
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_mon, self, self.main_monster))
	character_util.jump_move(self.main_monster, out_pos, 4, 2.5, true, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	self.is_roatate_monster = false
end

-- 몬스터 회전
function local_class:rotate_mon(mon)
	local rot = 0

	while self.is_roatate_monster == true do
		rot = rot + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * 360 * 10)
		if rot > 360 then rot = rot - 360 end
		character_util.spine_rotate(mon, rot, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 뒤집힘
	character_util.spine_rotate(mon, 180, 0)
end

-- 특정 위치를 바라봄
function local_class:face_to(fo, target_pos)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - fo.Position)
	if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		fo.Direction = dir
	end
end

-- endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}
