local local_class = newclass('PastureObservationTrampoline')

function local_class:init()

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		enter = 1,
		prepare = 3,
		action = 4,
		interval = 5,
		post = 6,
		exit = 7
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.prepare_duration = 1
	self.post_duration = 1

	self.enter_duration = 0.5
	self.interval_duration = 0.2
	self.action_duration = 1
	self.exit_duration = 0.5

	self.jump_height_per_count = 1

	self.jump_height_list = {}
	table.insert(self.jump_height_list,1)
	table.insert(self.jump_height_list,2)
	table.insert(self.jump_height_list,3)
	table.insert(self.jump_height_list,2)
	table.insert(self.jump_height_list,1)

	self.current_jump_count = 1
	self.max_jump_count = #self.jump_height_list

end

function local_class:start_routine(interactor, exit_pos)
	self.interactor = interactor
	self.exit_pos = exit_pos
	self.animator = self.fo.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	self:change_state(self.state.enter)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.current_jump_count <= self.max_jump_count then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
			self.animator:Play("on", -1, 0)
		end
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		self.interactor.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_land_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + vector(0, 1, - 0.5)
		self.move_vector = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position) / self.enter_duration
		self.current_jump_count = 1
		self.interactor.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector)
		self.interactor.SpineController:Jump(self.target_pos.y + 0.5, self.enter_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.interactor.Position = self.target_pos
		self.interactor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		--self.animator:Play("idle", -1, 0)
		--self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.interactor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		self.interactor.SpineController:Jump(self.jump_height_list[self.current_jump_count], self.action_duration)

		if self.current_jump_count == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
		end

		self.current_jump_count = self.current_jump_count + 1
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.interactor.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.exit_pos
		self.move_vector = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position) / self.exit_duration
		self.interactor.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector)
		self.interactor.SpineController:Jump(self.interactor.Position.y + 0.5, self.exit_duration)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		self.cs_behaviour:FinishRoutine()
	end

end

function local_class:update_shadow(duration)
	local half_duration = duration / 2
	local scale = 1
	local middle_fixed_scale = 0.5

	if self.time_passed < half_duration then
		scale = 1 + (middle_fixed_scale - 1) * (self.time_passed / half_duration)
	else
		local remain = self.time_passed - half_duration;
		scale = middle_fixed_scale + (1 - middle_fixed_scale) * (remain / half_duration)
	end

	self.interactor.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.enter then
		self.interactor.Position = self.interactor.Position + self.move_vector * dt

		if self.time_passed > self.enter_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		else
			self:update_shadow(self.action_duration)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed > self.interval_duration then
			if self.current_jump_count > self.max_jump_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.exit)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor.Position = self.interactor.Position + self.move_vector * dt

		if self.time_passed > self.exit_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:end_routine()

	if not is_unity_null(self.interactor) then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.animator) then
		self.animator:Play("idle", -1, 0)
	end
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.cs_behaviour = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
	self.jump_height_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end


function local_class:update_building(pooled_object)
end

function local_class:remove_building()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

		self.action_button_pushed = true

		print('trampoline cheat immortal : ON')

		print('trampoline cheat slow : ON')

function local_class:interact(monster_id)

	self.monster_id = monster_id
	self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.action_button_pushed = false

	self.npc_raccoon = get_character(self.data.raccoon_handle_name)
	self.raccoon_init_pos = self.npc_raccoon.Position
	self.npc_guard1 = get_character(self.data.guard1_handle_name)
	self.npc_guard2 = get_character(self.data.guard2_handle_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_routine, self))

function local_class:rotate_spin_direction()

	if self.spin_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	elseif self.spin_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	elseif self.spin_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	else
		self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	end

	return self.spin_direction
end

function local_class:interact_routine()
	self.cs_behaviour.IsExecuting = true

	local child_count = self.fo.Transform.childCount
	for i = 0, child_count - 1 do
		local child = self.fo.Transform:GetChild(i)
		if string.match(child.name, 'trampoline') then
			self.trampoline = child
			break
		end
	end
	self.object_init_pos = self.fo.Position + self.trampoline.localPosition
	self.game_started = true
	self.game_over = false
	self.first_jump = false
	self.current_height = 0
	self.spin_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	self.jump_phase = 0
	self.bgm_progress = 0
	self.push_count = 0

	-- UI 모두 숨김
	self:game_ui_show()

	-- 연출을 위해서 키지 않게 세팅
	CS.Oak.UI.PastureMonsterInfoUI.Instance.ForceHide = true
	CS.Oak.UI.PastureMonsterInfoUI.Instance:Close()

	-- 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.minigame_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 3 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 판정 UI
	self.mini_game_ui = self.resource_manager.TrampolineMiniGameUI
	self.mini_game_ui:HideUI()

	-- 몬스터 모두 숨김
	self:hide_all_monsters()

	-- 점프할 몬스터 세팅
	self.main_monster = self.monster_manager:GetCharacterById(self.monster_id);
	self.main_monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	self.main_monster.Position = self.object_init_pos + vector(0.5, self.trampoline_height, 0.5)

	self.main_monster.Direction = self.spin_direction
	character_util.set_emotion(self.main_monster, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.main_monster)

	-- 너굴걸 트램폴린 옆으로 이동
	self.npc_raccoon.Position = self.object_init_pos - vector(2, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_raccoon, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 플레이어 트램폴린 옆으로 이동
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.object_init_pos + vector(3, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 카메라 이동
	camera_util.move(self.object_init_pos, 0)

	-- 건초 숨기기
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local ricestraw = get_field_object('ricestraw_' .. i)
		ricestraw.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 카메라가 몬스터 추적하기 때문에 여기서부터 코루틴 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_update, self))

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 첫 튜토리얼
	if CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetInt('pasture_tramopline_tutorial') == 0 then
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'narration_pasture_tramopline_minigame_desc' })
		CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt('pasture_tramopline_tutorial', 1)
	end

	-- DPad, 공격버튼 표시
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run

	-- 메인 플레이 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.main_play, self))
	while self.game_started == true do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 페이드 아웃하고 상태 되돌려놓음
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })

	-- 건초 보이기
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local ricestraw = get_field_object('ricestraw_' .. i)
		ricestraw.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	-- 애니, 표정 없애기
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_raccoon)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.main_monster)

	-- 너굴걸 원위치
	self.npc_raccoon.Position = self.raccoon_init_pos
	character_util.set_direction(self.npc_raccoon, 'down')

	-- 몬스터 초기화
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.main_monster, 0, 0)
	self.main_monster.Position = vector(self.object_init_pos.x, 0, self.object_init_pos.z - 1)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.main_monster, true)
	self:show_all_monsters()

	-- 리더 초기화
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 돌려놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	-- 연출 때 꺼져 있던 정보창 킬수 있게 원복
	CS.Oak.UI.PastureMonsterInfoUI.Instance.ForceHide = false
	CS.Oak.UI.PastureMonsterInfoUI.Instance:OpenAndUpdate()

	-- UI 초기화
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = nil

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.cs_behaviour.IsExecuting = false
end

function local_class:spin_routine()
	while self.game_over == false do
		self.main_monster.Direction = self:rotate_spin_direction()
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

function local_class:jump_to_space(jumper, target_position)

	local back_tint = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0, 0, 0, 1)
	field:Tint(nil, back_tint, 0.5)

		jumper.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, jumper.transform)

	camera_util.move(vector(0, 999, 0 ), 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_missile_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	local screen_effect_2 = self.screen_2_pool:Instantiate(vector(0, 999, -3 ))

	field:Tint(nil, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1)

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'surprise' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.0, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
end


-- 몬스터 모두 숨기기
function local_class:hide_all_monsters()
	local count = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters.Count
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local monsterInfo = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters[i];
		local monster = self.monster_manager:GetCharacterById(monsterInfo.Id);
		monster.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

-- 몬스터 모두 보이기
function local_class:show_all_monsters()
	local count = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters.Count
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local monsterInfo = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters[i];
		local monster = self.monster_manager:GetCharacterById(monsterInfo.Id);
		monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

-- 연출 메인
function local_class:main_play()
	local animator = self.trampoline:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	while self.first_jump ~= true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 점프
	self.failed = false
	self.push_count = 0
	self.great_count = 0
	self.jump_height = 3
	self.jump_count = 0
	while self.jump_count < self.jump_max + 1 and self.failed == false do
		-- 남은 카운트 갱신
		self:set_remain_jump_count()

		animator.speed = 3
		animator:Play('on', 0, 0)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
		local duration = 0.7 + self.jump_height / 10 * self.jump_delay
		self:jump_routine(self.jump_height, duration)
		self.jump_count = self.jump_count + 1
	end

	-- UI 숨기기
	self.game_over = true
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	self.mini_game_ui:SetActiveRemainCount(false)
	self.jump_fx:Dispose()
	if self.bgm_falling ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.bgm_falling)
		self.bgm_falling = nil
	end

	local wait_delay = 0
	-- 실패
	if self.failed == true then
		animator.speed = 3
		animator:Play('on', 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(self.main_monster, 'down')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_02')

		character_util.set_direction(self.main_monster, 'right')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.monster_out, self))
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.main_monster, { name = 'damaged' })
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party })
		wait_delay = 2
	-- 일반 종료
	elseif self.great_count < self.jump_max then
		animator.speed = 3
		animator:Play('on', 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(self.main_monster, 'down')

		local out_pos = vector(self.main_monster.Position.x, 0, self.main_monster.Position.z - 2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump_move(self.main_monster, out_pos, 2, 2.5, true, 'right')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.set_anim(self.main_monster, { name = 'happy' })
		character_util.set_anim(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'clap' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')

		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party })
		wait_delay = 2
	-- 모두 Great 달성
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

		animator.speed = 2
		animator:Play('on', 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(self.main_monster, 'down')
		character_util.move_to(self.main_monster, self.main_monster.Position + vector(0, -0.3, 0), 0.15)

		-- 슬로우
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		time_util.mod('action', 0.1)
		wait_for_sec(0.15)
		time_util.unmod('action')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_charge_fire_01')
		character_util.move_to(self.main_monster, self.main_monster.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0), 0.15)

		-- 우주로 날아가기
		self:jump_to_space(self.main_monster, self.object_init_pos + vector(0, self.jump_height * 2, 0))
		wait_delay = 1
	end

	wait_for_sec(wait_delay)
	self.mini_game_ui:HideUI()
	self.game_started = false
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창, 미니맵 제거
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end
end

-- 게임 업데이트
function local_class:game_update()
	while self.game_over == false do
		-- 카메라가 몬스터를 추적
		local pos = self.main_monster.Position + self.main_monster.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.localPosition
		camera_util.move(pos, 0)

		-- 점프 높이 받아오기
		pos = self.main_monster.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.localPosition
		self.current_height = self.main_monster.Position.y - self.trampoline_height

		-- 판정
		if self.action_button_pushed then
			self:push_jump_button()
			self.action_button_pushed = false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 몬스터 튕겨 나감
function local_class:monster_out()
	local out_pos = vector(self.main_monster.Position.x + 2, 0, self.main_monster.Position.z - 1)
	local duration = 0.5 + (self.main_monster.Position.y / 20)

	self.is_roatate_monster = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_mon, self, self.main_monster))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_routine, self, out_pos, 4, duration))
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	self.is_roatate_monster = false
end

-- 몬스터 회전
function local_class:rotate_mon(mon)
	local rot = 0

	while self.is_roatate_monster == true do
		rot = rot + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * 360 * 10)
		if rot > 360 then rot = rot - 360 end
		character_util.spine_rotate(mon, rot, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 뒤집힘
	character_util.spine_rotate(mon, 180, 0)
end

-- 특정 위치를 바라봄
function local_class:face_to(fo, target_pos)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - fo.Position)
	if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		fo.Direction = dir
	end
end

-- 점프 버튼 누름
function local_class:push_jump_button()
	-- 점프 키를 누른 횟수를 카운트, 마지막 점프를 누르고 UI 숨김
	self.push_count = self.push_count + 1
	if self.push_count >= self.jump_max then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
		self.mini_game_ui:SetActiveRemainCount(false)
	end

	-- 점프 시작
	if self.first_jump == false then
		self.first_jump = true
		-- 점프 이펙트
		self.jump_fx = self.jump_pool:Instantiate(self.main_monster.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.main_monster.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform);
		character_util.set_active_shadow(self.main_monster, false)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spin_routine, self))
		-- 미니게임 UI 활성화 및 갱신
		self.mini_game_ui:InitUI()
		self.mini_game_ui:ShowUI()
		self:set_remain_jump_count()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	-- 뛰어 오르는 도중에 누른 경우
	elseif self.jump_phase == 0 then
		self:show_miss()
	-- 한 페이즈에 여러번 버튼을 누른 경우
	elseif self.push_count > self.jump_phase then
		self:show_miss()
	-- 점프 판정
	elseif self.game_over == false and self.failed == false then
		-- Miss
		if self.current_height > 1 then
			self:show_miss()
		-- Good
		elseif self.current_height > 0.5 then
			self:show_good()
		-- Great
		else
			self:show_great()
		end
		self.ui_hide_delay = 1
	end
end

-- Greate 판정
function local_class:show_great()
	self.mini_game_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.PastureMiniGameResultUI.MiniGameResult.Great)
	self.jump_height = self.jump_height + 1
	self.great_count = self.great_count + 1
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_heart_01')
end

-- Good 판정
function local_class:show_good()
	self.mini_game_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.PastureMiniGameResultUI.MiniGameResult.Good)
	self.jump_height = self.jump_height + 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')
end

-- Miss 판정
function local_class:show_miss()
	self.mini_game_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.PastureMiniGameResultUI.MiniGameResult.Miss)
	if self.cheat_immortal == false then
		self.failed = true
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	end
end

-- 점프 루틴
function local_class:jump_routine(height, duration)
	local start_position = self.main_monster.Position
	local time_passed = 0
	local is_phase_increase = false

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		self.main_monster.Position = start_position + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 판정 범위 넘어가는 순간
		if y > 1 then
			-- 버튼 안 눌렀으면 Miss 처리
			if self.cheat_immortal == false and self.push_count < self.jump_count then
				self:show_miss()
				return
			elseif is_phase_increase == false then
				-- 판정 범위를 넘어간 후에 다음 페이즈로 넘어감
				self.jump_phase = self.jump_phase + 1
				is_phase_increase = true
			end
		end

		-- Miss 판정 나면 바로 튕겨 나감
		if self.cheat_immortal == false and self.failed == true then
			return
		end
	end

	-- 자동 great 치트키
	if self.cheat_auto == true then
		self:push_jump_button()
	end

	self.main_monster.Position = start_position
end

-- 낙하 루틴
function local_class:fall_routine(end_position, height, duration)
	local start_position = self.main_monster.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		self.main_monster.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	self.main_monster.Position = end_position
end

-- 남은 점프 카운트 설정
function local_class:set_remain_jump_count()
	local remain_count = math.max(self.jump_max - self.jump_count, 0)
	self.mini_game_ui:SetRemainCount(remain_count)

	if self.bgm_progress == 0 and remain_count <= 7 then
		self.bgm_progress = self.bgm_progress + 1
		self.bgm_falling = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_prologue_falling_01', loop = true, volume = 0.2})
	elseif self.bgm_progress == 1 and remain_count <= 4 then
		self.bgm_progress = self.bgm_progress + 1
		self.bgm_falling.Volume = 0.4
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('PastureObservationWagon')

function local_class:init()

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		wait = 1,
		jump = 2,
		victory = 3,
		exit = 4
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.wait_duration = 0.1
	self.jump_time = 0.3

	self.exit_time = 0.5
	self.init_pos = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine(interactor, exit_pos)
	self.interactor = interactor
	self:get_sfx_name(interactor)

	self.right_ani_end_time = spine_util.get_animation_duration(interactor, 'victory') * 2
	self.right_direction_end_time = self.right_ani_end_time + 1

	self.left_ani_start_time = self.right_direction_end_time + 1
	self.left_ani_end_time = self.left_ani_start_time + spine_util.get_animation_duration(interactor, 'victory') * 2
	self.left_direction_end_time = self.left_ani_end_time + 1

	self.victory_time = self.left_direction_end_time + 1

	self.exit_pos = exit_pos
	self:change_state(self.state.wait)
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:get_sfx_name(interactor)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(interactor.FieldObjectController.CurrentState, CS.Oak.PastureMonsterBuildingActionState) then
		local species = interactor.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.Spec.SpeciesId

		if species == 101 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_pet_howl_03'
		elseif species == 102 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_cocktail_slime_01'
		elseif species == 103 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_creature_03'
		elseif species == 104 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_pet_howl_01'
		elseif species == 105 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01'
		elseif species == 106 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01'
		elseif species == 107 then
			self.sfx_name = '01_die_ant_01'
		else
			self.sfx_name = '01_bad_fairy_01'
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.victory then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
		self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_land_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.target_pos = self.fo.Position + vector(0,1,-0.2)
		self.init_pos = self.interactor.Position
		local move = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position)
		self.move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(move) / self.jump_time
		self.dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(move))
		self.height = move.y
		self.mod = -self.height / self.dist^2

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.victory then
		self.interactor.Position = self.target_pos

		self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Right,
				CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('victory', true)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.sfx_name, loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		self.interactor:SetAnimation('jump', false)
		self.target_pos = self.exit_pos
		self.init_pos = self.interactor.Position
		local move = (self.target_pos - self.interactor.Position)
		self.move_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(move) / self.exit_time
		self.dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(move))
		self.height = self.interactor.Position.y
		self.mod = -self.height / self.dist^2

		self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(
				vector_util.to_direction(self.move_vector), CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.none then
		self.cs_behaviour:FinishRoutine()
	end

end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed > self.wait_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local xz_move = self.time_passed * self.move_vector
		self.interactor.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.init_pos + xz_move,
				self.mod * (vector_util.magnitude(xz_move) - self.dist)^2 + self.height)

		if self.time_passed > self.jump_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.victory)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.victory then
		if self.time_passed > self.left_ani_end_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.left_ani_end_time  then
			self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()

		elseif self.time_passed > self.left_direction_end_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.left_direction_end_time then
			self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
					CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))

		elseif self.time_passed > self.left_ani_start_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.left_ani_start_time then
			self.interactor:SetAnimation('victory', true)
			self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
					CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.sfx_name, loop = false, parent = self.interactor, max_distance = 5})

		elseif self.time_passed > self.right_ani_end_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.right_ani_end_time then
			self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()

		elseif self.time_passed > self.right_direction_end_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.right_direction_end_time then
			self.interactor:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(CS.Oak.Direction.Down,
					CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.Custom))
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.victory_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.exit)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.exit then
		local xz_move = self.time_passed * self.move_vector
		self.interactor.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.init_pos + xz_move,
				math.max(self.mod * vector_util.magnitude(xz_move)^2 + self.height, 0))

		if self.time_passed > self.exit_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end


function local_class:end_routine()
	self.interactor:RemoveAnimation()
	self.interactor:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_behaviour)
end

-- IFO에 붙었을 때
function local_class:attach_to(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.cs_behaviour = fo.FieldObjectBehaviour
end

-- IFO에서 떨어졌을 때
function local_class:detach_from(_)
	self.fo = nil
	self.cs_behaviour = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end


function local_class:update_building(pooled_object)
end

function local_class:remove_building()
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

-- 공 던지기
function local_class:throw_ball(ball, end_position, duration)
	-- 시작 위치 얻기
	local start_position = ball.Position
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 1

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		ball.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	ball.Position = end_position
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_snowball_hit_01')
end

-- 공잡고 도망가는 몬스터
function local_class:catch_and_run(monster)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to(monster, monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 8, true)
	coroutine.yield()
	character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(monster, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'happy' })
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	scene_util.play_emoticon_action(monster, self, nil, nil, nil, 'tease')
	character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to(monster, monster.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), nil, 8, true)
end

-- 특정 위치를 바라봄
function local_class:face_to(fo, target_pos)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - fo.Position)
	if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		fo.Direction = dir
	end
end

-- 타원 안의 랜덤 좌표 리턴 (Chat-GPT 코딩)
function local_class:GetRandomPointInEllipse(centerX, centerY, semiMajorAxis, semiMinorAxis, side)
	local angle
	if side == 'left' then
		angle = math.random() * math.pi -- 0도에서 180도 사이의 랜덤한 각도
	else
		angle = math.random() * math.pi + math.pi -- 180도에서 360도 사이의 랜덤한 각도
	end

	local distance = math.sqrt(math.random())  -- [0, 1) 범위의 랜덤한 값

	local offsetX = math.cos(angle) * semiMajorAxis * distance
	local offsetY = math.sin(angle) * semiMinorAxis * distance

	local randomX = centerX + offsetX
	local randomY = centerY + offsetY

	return randomX, randomY
end

-- 타겟으로 부터 가장 가까운 원의 테두리 좌표를 리턴 (Chat-GPT 코딩)
function local_class:GetClosestPointOnCircle(centerX, centerY, radius, targetX, targetY)
	local angle = self:atan2(targetY - centerY, targetX - centerX)
	local closestX = centerX + math.cos(angle) * radius
	local closestY = centerY + math.sin(angle) * radius
	return closestX, closestY
end

-- 아크 탄젠트가 존재 하지 않아서 구현
-- 주의 : x값이 0이 되는 경우 계산 불가
-- Chat-GPT 코딩
function local_class:atan2(y, x)
	return math.atan(y / x) + (x < 0 and math.pi or 0) + (y < 0 and 2 * math.pi or 0)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

-- 공 던지기
function local_class:throw_ball(ball, end_position, duration)
	-- 시작 위치 얻기
	local start_position = ball.Position
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 1

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		ball.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	ball.Position = end_position
end

-- 둥실 둥실 애니메이션
function local_class:fishing_float_animation(fishing_float)
	local origin_pos = fishing_float.transform.localPosition
	while true do
		local time_passed = 0
		local height = 0.15
		local duration = 2
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			fishing_float.transform.localPosition = origin_pos + vector(0, y + self.fishing_float_offset_y, 0)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.fishing_float_speed
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 낚시찌 없애기
function local_class:dispose_fishing_float(fishing_float, fishing_float_coroutine)
	if fishing_float ~= nil then
		if fishing_float_coroutine then
			stop_coroutine(fishing_float_coroutine)
		end
		fishing_float_coroutine = nil
		fishing_float:Dispose()
		fishing_float = nil
	end
end

-- 침대 튀어 오르기
function local_class:fish_jump(fish, end_position, duration)
	-- 시작 위치 얻기
	local start_position = fish.transform.localPosition

	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 4

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		fish.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 최종 포지션으로 이동(프레임 스킵이 일어난 경우 마지막 좌표 안 오는 경우가 발생)
	fish.transform.localPosition = end_position
end

-- 트램폴린이 너굴걸 머리 위에 위치하다가 놓는 순간 던져짐
function local_class:trampoline_update(trampoline)
	while self.trampoline_hold == true do
		trampoline.transform.localPosition = self.npc_raccoon.Position + vector(-0.5, 1, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local start_position = trampoline.transform.localPosition
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 2
	local duration = 0.75
	local end_position = vector(trampoline.transform.localPosition.x + 2, 0, trampoline.transform.localPosition.z)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		trampoline.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_03')

	start_position = trampoline.transform.localPosition
	time_passed = 0
	height = 1
	duration = 0.75 / 2
	end_position = vector(trampoline.transform.localPosition.x + 1, 0, trampoline.transform.localPosition.z)
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		trampoline.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_03')

	start_position = trampoline.transform.localPosition
	time_passed = 0
	height = 0.5
	duration = 0.75 / 3
	end_position = vector(trampoline.transform.localPosition.x + 0.5, 0, trampoline.transform.localPosition.z)
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		trampoline.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_03')

	-- 최종 포지션으로 이동(프레임 스킵이 일어난 경우 마지막 좌표 안 오는 경우가 발생)
	trampoline.transform.localPosition = end_position
end

-- 너굴걸 트램폴린 점프
function local_class:raccoon_jump(trampoline)
	while self.raccoon_jump_progress < 1 do
		local animator = trampoline:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator.speed = 3
		animator:Play('on', 0, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(self.npc_raccoon, 'right', 1, 3)
	end

	-- 튕겨 나감
	local start_position = self.npc_raccoon.Position
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 3
	local duration = 0.5
	local end_position = vector(self.npc_raccoon.Position.x + 3.5, 0, self.npc_raccoon.Position.z - 1)

	-- 최고점까지 올라감
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.raccoon_spin, self))
	while time_passed < duration / 2 do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		self.npc_raccoon.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_raccoon, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- 공중 체류
	while self.raccoon_jump_progress < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 회전 멈춤
	self.raccoon_spin_end = true
	coroutine.yield()

	-- 바닥으로
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.npc_raccoon, 90, duration / 2)
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
		self.npc_raccoon.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.npc_raccoon.Position = end_position
end

-- 너굴걸 회전
function local_class:raccoon_spin()
	self.raccoon_angle = 0
	self.raccoon_spin_end = false

	while self.raccoon_spin_end == false do
		self.raccoon_angle = self.raccoon_angle + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * 360 * 3)
		if self.raccoon_angle >= 360 then
			self.raccoon_angle = self.raccoon_angle - 360
		end
		character_util.spine_rotate(self.npc_raccoon, self.raccoon_angle, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'pasture_new_monster_toy3' })

	self:stop()
end


-- 챗바퀴 떨어짐
function local_class:field_object_drop(duration)
	-- prefab 애니로 처리해서 할 것이 없음
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.75)
end

-- 챗바퀴 피하기
function local_class:avoid_wheel(character, force, last_direction)
	wait_for_sec(0.35)
	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.jump_move(character, character.Position + force, 8, 1, true, last_direction)
	character_util.set_anim(character, {name = 'prostrate'})
end

-- 몬스터 모두 숨기기
function local_class:hide_all_monsters()
	local count = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters.Count
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local monsterInfo = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters[i];
		local monster = self.monster_manager:GetCharacterById(monsterInfo.Id);
		monster.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

-- 몬스터 모두 보이기
function local_class:show_all_monsters()
	local count = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters.Count
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local monsterInfo = CS.Oak.UserPasture.Me.Monsters[i];
		local monster = self.monster_manager:GetCharacterById(monsterInfo.Id);
		monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QuestEventControllerBase')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	---@type LuaQuestEventController
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function local_class:load_resource()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.script_config = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

---@param start_progress nil|number
function local_class:activate_quest(start_progress)
	yield_return_func(self.cs_controller.ActivateQuest, self.cs_controller, start_progress)
end

function local_class:progress_section(count)
	yield_return_func(self.cs_controller.ProgressSection, self.cs_controller, count)
end

---@param data QuestCompleteInfo
function local_class:complete_quest(data)
	local grade = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'grade', 0)
	local run_complete_ui = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'run_complete_ui', true)
	local run_fame_alignment = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'run_fame_alignment', true)
	local return_control = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'return_control', true)
	local run_chapter_end_ui = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'run_chapter_end_ui', true)
	local undisplay_reward = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'undisplay_reward', nil)
	local stage_custom = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'stage_custom', nil)

	yield_return_func(self.cs_controller.CompleteQuest, self.cs_controller,
			grade, run_complete_ui, run_fame_alignment, return_control, run_chapter_end_ui, undisplay_reward, stage_custom)
end

function local_class:complete_hidden_quest_default()

		run_complete_ui = false,
		run_fame_alignment = false,
		return_control = false,
		run_chapter_end_ui = false,
	})
end

return local_class

---@class BreakInPartyMember
local local_class = newclass('BreakInPartyMember')

function local_class:init()
	self.is_battle = false

	self.is_stage_end = false

	self.saved_party = nil
end

--region CustomOption

function local_class:init_custom_option(_)
	-- fx
	self.fx = {
		reset_object = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.fx:load_all()

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent), 'on_waypoint_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointClosedEvent), 'on_waypoint_closed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	self.saved_party = {}

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.saved_party, user_party[i])
	end
end

--endregion CustomOption

--region Event

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	self:hide_party_member(false)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(_)
	if self.is_battle then
		return false
	end

	--TODO: BattleStart도 리더가 포함된 전투인지 체크가 필요할까 (or BattleEnd에서 체크를 제거하는게 좋을까)

	-- 전투 시작 시 파티원 난입
	self.is_battle = true
	self:break_in_party_member()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 리더가 포함되어 있지 않은 전투라면 return
	if not e:IsCharacterInBattle(leader) then
		return false
	end

	-- 리더가 사망해서 끝난 전투라면 리셋해주지 않음
	if leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	-- 전투 끝나면 파티원 다시 숨겨줌
	self.is_battle = false
	self:hide_party_member()

	return true
end

--endregion Event

-- 파티 멤버 숨겨 주는 함수
function local_class:hide_party_member(is_effect)
	is_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_effect, true)

	--TODO: 파티원을 캐싱 해두어야 하는지
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		if lua_helper.type_compare(party_member.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.PartyMemberCharacterController) then
			-- CharacterPriorityEmptyState 로 State 변경
			local state = CS.Oak.CharacterPriorityEmptyState.Create(10)
			message_system:SendSync(party_member, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state))

			-- 이팩트 재생한다면 재생
			if is_effect then
				self.fx.reset_object():Instantiate(party_member.Position)
			end

			-- 등장할 때 스파인 알파값 변경되어야 해서 0으로 변경
			character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(party_member, 0, 0)

			-- 999로 보내면서 스파인 강제 업데이트 한번 진행
			party_member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			party_member.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

			-- 영웅이 죽은 상태일 때
			if lua_helper.type_compare(party_member.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.HeroDeadState) then
				if party_member.IsInCoffin then
					-- 이미 관 상태면 코핀 한번 꺼줌
					party_member:HideCoffin()
				else
					-- 아직 죽는 연출 진행 중이라면 끝나고 코핀 꺼줌
					start_coroutine(self.wait_until_coffin_and_disable, self, party_member)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:wait_until_coffin_and_disable(party_member)
	-- Coffin이 세팅될 때까지 대기
	while not party_member.IsInCoffin and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_stage_end then
		-- 코핀 비활성화
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		party_member:HideCoffin()
	end
end

-- 파티원 등장 함수
function local_class:break_in_party_member()
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(party_member.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.PartyMemberCharacterController) then
			-- State 우선순위 낮춤
			local current_state = party_member.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterPriorityEmptyState) then
				current_state.Priority = 0
			end

			-- 파티원 Enable
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(party_member, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'enabled')
		end
	end

	-- 배틀 게이트 안쪽으로 파티원 이동 시켜주는 함수
	user_party:PrepareBattle()
end

function local_class:on_waypoint_opened_event(_)
	-- 파티원 활성화
	for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
		local party_member = self.saved_party[i]

		local current_state = party_member.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterPriorityEmptyState) then
			current_state.Priority = 0
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'enabled')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(party_member, 1, 0.3)
		party_member.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)

		party_member.Position = get_party_leader().Position
	end
end

function local_class:on_waypoint_closed_event(_)
	-- 파티원 비활성화
	for i = 1, #self.saved_party do
		local party_member = self.saved_party[i]

		local state = CS.Oak.CharacterPriorityEmptyState.Create(10)
		message_system:SendSync(party_member, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state))

		self.fx.reset_object():Instantiate(party_member.Position)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(party_member, 0, 0)
		party_member.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.1)
		party_member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true
	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointClosedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.fx = nil
	self.saved_party = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class FollowNpcBattleLogic
local local_class = newclass('FollowNpcBattleLogic')

function local_class:init()
	self.is_battle = false

	-- Constant 데이터
	self.constant_data = nil

	-- 타겟 퀘스트 아이디
	self.target_quest_id = 0

	-- 현재 프로그래스
	self.cur_progress = 0

	-- 클리어 여부
	self.is_complete = false
end

--region CustomOption

function local_class:init_custom_option(option_spec)
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_battle_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_battle_end_event')

	local constants = require('Quest/Base/CustomOption/FollowNpcBattleLogicConstants')

	self.target_quest_id = option_spec.quest_id
	self.constant_data = constants[self.target_quest_id]

	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.target_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		self.cur_progress = quest_progress.InnerProgress
		self.is_complete = quest_progress.IsComplete
	else
		self.cur_progress = 0
		self.is_complete = false
	end
end

--endregion CustomOption

--region Event

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	local follow_npc_list = self:get_follow_npc_list()

	if follow_npc_list == nil or #follow_npc_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local dir = leader.Direction
	local enter_party_count = user_party.Count - 1

	for i = 1, #follow_npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(follow_npc_list[i].name)

		if not follow_npc_list[i].exclude_start then
			-- 무적 상태로 변경
			character_util.set_immortal(npc, true)

			-- 방향 리더랑 같게
			character_util.set_direction(npc, dir)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)

			-- 위치 설정
			npc.Position = leader.Position + (-direction_util.to_vector3(dir) * i) * 0.7

			-- 파티원 세팅
			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(npc, user_party, false,
					CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -enter_party_count)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.target_quest_id then
		self.cur_progress = e.CurrentProgress

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId == self.target_quest_id then
		self.is_complete = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_start_event(_)
	if self.is_battle then
		return false
	end

	-- 변경해 줄 팔로우 npc가 없다면 그대로 return
	local follow_npc_list = self:get_follow_npc_list()

	if follow_npc_list == nil or #follow_npc_list <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	-- 전투 시작 시 파티원 난입
	self.is_battle = true
	start_coroutine(self.convert_non_party_member, self, follow_npc_list)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	-- 변경해 줄 팔로우 npc가 없다면 그대로 return
	local follow_npc_list = self:get_follow_npc_list()

	if follow_npc_list == nil or #follow_npc_list <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 리더가 포함되어 있지 않은 전투라면 return
	if not e:IsCharacterInBattle(leader) then
		return false
	end

	-- 리더가 사망해서 끝난 전투라면 리셋해주지 않음
	if leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	-- 전투 끝나면 파티원 다시 숨겨줌
	self.is_battle = false

	self:convert_to_following(follow_npc_list)

	return true
end

--endregion Event

function local_class:convert_to_following(follow_npc_list)
	for i = 1, #follow_npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(follow_npc_list[i].name)

		if user_party:Contains(npc) and not follow_npc_list[i].not_battle_npc then
			local party_index = user_party:FindIndex(npc)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(npc, user_party, false,
					CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.Keep, -party_index + i)
		end
	end
end

-- 파티원 등장 함수
function local_class:convert_non_party_member(follow_npc_list)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local member = {}

	for i = 1, #follow_npc_list do
		local npc = get_character(follow_npc_list[i].name)

		-- 파티에 포함되어 있으면서 전투 하는 캐릭터라면
		if user_party:Contains(npc) and not follow_npc_list[i].not_battle_npc then
			local pos = leader.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(get_party_leader().Direction) * 0.5

			character_util.jump(npc, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.move_to(npc, pos, 0.3, nil, true, false)

			scene_util.set_direction(npc, leader.Direction, false)

			table.insert(member, npc)
		end
	end

	-- 점프 대기
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= 0.3 and self.is_battle do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 점프 끝나고 나서 전투가 이미 끝났을 때 (순삭 당했을 때)
	if self.is_battle == false then
		return
	end

	-- 실제 전투 멤버로 변경
	for i = 1, #member do
		CS.Oak.StageUtil.NpcToAllyInBattle(member[i])
		field_object_util.set_active_state(member[i], active_state_type.enabled)
	end
end

function local_class:get_follow_npc_list()
	local stage_progress_data = self.constant_data.progress_data_list[stage.Name]

	if stage_progress_data == nil then
		return nil
	end

	-- 퀘스트 클리어 했다면 클리어 데이터로 리턴
	if self.is_complete then
		return stage_progress_data.complete_data
	end

	-- 섹션 프로그래스가 정보가 안되어 있다면 fallback으로 등록
	local section_progress_data = stage_progress_data.progress_data[self.cur_progress]
	if section_progress_data == nil then
		return stage_progress_data.fallback_data
	end

	return section_progress_data
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent))

---@class MiniEventManager
local local_class = newclass('MiniEventManager')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.quest_id = nil

	self.custom_key = nil

	self.callback_list = {}

	self.mini_event_scripts = {}
end

---@param quest_id number 해당 스테이지 커스텀 스테이트 저장용 MainQuest ID
---@param path string MiniEvents가 포함되어있는 폴더 경로
---@param event_name_list table 클리어 데이터를 받고 싶은 MiniEvents Name 리스트
---@param custom_key table minievent 클리어 정보 저장용 커스텀 키
---@param end_callback function MiniEvents 클리어마다 추가 처리에 대한 func
function local_class:add(event_controller, quest_id, path, event_name, custom_key, end_callback)
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.custom_key = custom_key

	if path == nil or not type_util.is_string(path) then
		logger_util.error('[path] is nil or not string')
		return false
	end

	if event_name == nil then
		logger_util.error('[event name list] is nil or not table')
		return false
	end

	local script_name = path .. '/' .. event_name

	local script = get_or_create_global_table(script_name)

	if end_callback ~= nil then
		self.callback_list[script.event_id] = end_callback
	end

	if script ~= nil then
		self.mini_event_scripts[script.event_id] = script
	end

	self:process_uncompleted_scripts('init', event_controller)

	--TODO 추후 좀더 좋은 방법으로 수정 하면 좋을듯
	start_coroutine(function()
		--coroutine.yield()

		self:process_uncompleted_scripts('load_resource')

		coroutine.yield()

		self:process_uncompleted_scripts('enter')
	end)

	return script.event_id
end
--
--function local_class:get_event_id()
--	return #self.mini_event_scripts + 1
--end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:process_uncompleted_scripts('exit')
	self:process_uncompleted_scripts('dispose')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	for _, script in pairs(self.mini_event_scripts) do
		script.is_stage_end = true
	end
end

function local_class:clear_check_mini_event(event_id)
	if event_id == nil then
		--logger_util.error('[event script id] is nil')

		--event script id가 없을 경우 클리어 처리
		return true
	end

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.quest_id)
	local clear_data = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	local is_clear = false

	if clear_data < 0 then
		return false
	end

	is_clear = clear_data & (1 << event_id) ~= 0

	return is_clear
end

--클리어 함수
function local_class:mini_event_clear(event_id)
	if event_id == nil then
		logger_util.error('[event script id] is nil')

		return false
	end

	local quest_progress = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.quest_id)
	local clear_data = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	local save_data = nil
	local bit_mask = 1 << event_id

	--clear_data가 -1일 경우 제대로 작동하지 않으므로 초기화 작업
	if clear_data == -1 then
		clear_data = 0
	end
	
	--if (clear_data & bit_mask) == 0 then
	--	return true
	--end

	self:process_uncompleted_script(event_id, 'exit')

	save_data = clear_data | bit_mask

	quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, self.custom_key, save_data)

	if self.callback_list[event_id] ~= nil then
		self.callback_list[event_id](event_id)
	end
end

--이벤트 내부 함수 실행용도 (단일 호출)
function local_class:process_uncompleted_script(event_id, action_name, extra_param)
	if self.mini_event_scripts == nil then
		return
	end

	local script = self.mini_event_scripts[event_id]
	local is_event_cleared = self:clear_check_mini_event(script.event_id)

	if not is_event_cleared then
		lua_helper.call_nullable(script, action_name, script, extra_param)
	end
end

--클리어 되지 않은 퀘스트 목록에게 init, enter, event, dispose (전체 호출)
function local_class:process_uncompleted_scripts(action_name, extra_param)
	if self.mini_event_scripts == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, script in pairs(self.mini_event_scripts) do
		local is_event_cleared = self:clear_check_mini_event(script.event_id)

		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(script, action_name, script, extra_param)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_clear_count(event_id_table)
	if event_id_table == nil or not type_util.is_table(event_id_table) then
		return
	end

	local count = 0

	for _, event_id in pairs(event_id_table) do
		for _, script in pairs(self.mini_event_scripts) do
			if script.event_id == event_id then
				count = count + 1
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return count
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end,
}

end

end

  return false

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
  if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.pepper) then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_s1_main, self)
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.v) then
    quest_marker_util.remove('v')
    sp_util.start_scene(self.scene_s2_main, self)
    return true
  end

    { asset_path = 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', asset_name = 'minigame_v_train_back3', init_x = 0, speed = 8, is_auto_move = true, size = 25, is_apply_player = true },
    { asset_path = 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', asset_name = 'minigame_v_train_back4', init_x = 0, speed = 0.1, is_auto_move = true , size = 18, is_apply_player = false},
  }

  self.train_data = {
    train_default = { asset_path = 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', asset_name = 'train_foothold', init_x = 0, size = 8 },
    train_default_2 = { asset_path = 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', asset_name = 'train_foothold_2', init_x = 0, size = 8 },
    train_engine = { asset_path = 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', asset_name = 'train_foothold_engine', init_x = 0, size = 8},
    train_distance = 1.5,
    train_speed = 16
  }

  local bg_offset = vector(0, 0, -3)

  self.bg_center = self.init_pos + bg_offset
  self.cur_speed = 0
  self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.bg_scroll_dir)

  self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do
    self.bg_map_pools[i] = {}

    local mid_idx = 2

    local gap = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.bg_data[i].size

    for j = 1, 3 do
      local idx_from_mid = mid_idx - j
      local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

      yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
          self.res_holder, self.bg_data[i].asset_path, self.bg_data[i].asset_name, function(prefab)
            local bg_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
            bg_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

            table.insert(self.bg_map_pools[i], bg_pool)
          end)
    end

    self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.init_pos.x + gap.x
  end

  self.train_pos_offset = vector(-4, 0.1, -2.1)
  self.train_reset_pos = self.init_pos.x + (self.train_data.train_default.size + self.train_data.train_distance) * 1.5

  local pos =  self.init_pos + self.train_pos_offset

  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      self.res_holder, self.train_data.train_engine.asset_path, self.train_data.train_engine.asset_name, function(prefab)
        local bg_train_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
        bg_train_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

        table.insert(self.bg_train_pool, bg_train_pool)
      end)

  for i = 1, 3 do
    local gap = direction_util.to_vector3('left') * (self.train_data.train_default.size + self.train_data.train_distance)
    pos =  self.init_pos + self.train_pos_offset + (gap * i)

    if i % 2 == 0 then
      yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
          self.res_holder, self.train_data.train_default_2.asset_path, self.train_data.train_default_2.asset_name, function(prefab)
            local bg_train_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
            bg_train_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

            table.insert(self.bg_train_pool, bg_train_pool)
          end)
    else
      yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
          self.res_holder, self.train_data.train_default.asset_path, self.train_data.train_default.asset_name, function(prefab)
            local bg_train_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
            bg_train_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

            table.insert(self.bg_train_pool, bg_train_pool)
          end)
    end

  end

end

function background_controller:scrolling(dt)
  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do

    local bg_data = self.bg_data[i]
    local speed = 0

    if bg_data.is_auto_move then
      speed = bg_data.speed
      if bg_data.is_apply_player then
        speed = speed + self.cur_speed
      end
    end

    speed = speed * self.time_scale

    background_scroller_util.update_by_frame(self.bg_map_pools[i], bg_data.size,
        self.bg_reset_pos[i], speed ,  self.bg_scroll_dir, dt)
  end

  if self.move_train then
    local train_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.bg_scroll_dir) * -1

    local temp_table = {}

    for i = 1, #self.bg_train_pool do
      local pos = self.bg_train_pool[i].transform.localPosition

      pos = pos + train_dir * self.train_data.train_speed * dt

      if pos.x > self.train_reset_pos then

        if i > 1 and self.infinity_move then
          table.insert(temp_table, i)
          self.bg_train_pool[i].transform.localPosition = pos
        end
      else
        self.bg_train_pool[i].transform.localPosition = pos
      end
    end

    if self.infinity_move then

      local gap = - train_dir * (self.train_data.train_default.size + self.train_data.train_distance)

      if #temp_table > 0 then
        local last_train = self.bg_train_pool[#self.bg_train_pool]

        for i = 1, #temp_table do
          local train = self.bg_train_pool[temp_table[i]]
          table.remove(self.bg_train_pool, temp_table[i])
          train.transform.localPosition = last_train.transform.localPosition + gap * i
          table.insert(self.bg_train_pool, train)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  self:apply_train_physics(dt)
end

function background_controller:set_move_train(is_move)
  self.move_train = is_move
end

function background_controller:set_move_train_infinity(is_infinity)
  self.infinity_move = is_infinity
end

function background_controller:reset()
  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do
    local mid_idx = 2

    local gap = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.bg_data[i].size

    for j = 1, #self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      local idx_from_mid = mid_idx - j
      local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

      self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition = pos
    end

    self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.init_pos.x + gap.x
  end
end

function background_controller:set_speed(speed)
  self.cur_speed = speed
end

function background_controller:dispose()
  self:dispose_bg_pool()

  self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = nil
  self.res_holder = nil
end

function background_controller:dispose_bg_pool()
  if self.bg_pools == nil then
    return false
  end

  for i = 1, #self.bg_map_pools do
    for j =1, #self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.bg_map_pools[i][j])
    end
  end

  for i = 1, #self.bg_train_pool do
    CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.bg_train_pool[i])
  end

  self.bg_map_pools = nil
  self.bg_train_pool = nil
end

local pos = 0       -- 현재 Y축 오프셋
local vel = 0       -- 현재 이동 속도 (관성)
local stiffness = 50 -- 탄성 (얼마나 강하게 당기는지)
local damping = 8    -- 감쇠 (얼마나 빨리 멈추는지)
local next_shake = 0
local frequency = 1

function background_controller:apply_train_physics(dt)
  local clamped_dt = math.min(dt, 0.05) -- 0.05초(20fps) 이상으로는 계산하지 않음
  -- 1. 충격 발생 시 초기 속도 부여
  local impulse = 0
  if unity_class.time.time >= next_shake then
    impulse = 1 -- 순간적인 힘 (값을 조절해 세기 조정)
    next_shake = unity_class.time.time + frequency
    camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.5)
  end
  -- 2. 스프링 물리 계산 (F = -kx - cv)
  -- pos: 현재 위치, vel: 현재 속도
  local force = (-stiffness * pos) - (damping * vel)

  vel = vel + (force * clamped_dt) - impulse --배경은 위가 아니라 아래로 움직여야 됨.
  pos = pos + (vel * clamped_dt) * self.time_scale
  local originalY = 0.1 -- 기본 높이값

  for i = 1, #self.bg_map_pools do
    for j = 1, # self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition, pos + originalY)
    end
  end
end

return {
  create = function()
    return background_controller()
  end
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)

  self.script_config = {
    HasPreSection = false,

    HasPostSection = true
  }

  self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

  -- 요리 솥
  self.food_pot = get_field_object('food_pot')

  self.current_flag = 1

  -- [gimmick]pot_pepper 세션 순서에 맞게 자식 순서 배치 필요
  self.pot_children = {
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(0), --base_pot
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(1), --part_meat
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(4), --part_water
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(3), --part_mushroom
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(2), --part_fire
    self.food_pot.transform:GetChild(5) --part_finished
  }

  self.pot_flags = {
    pot = 1,
    meat = 1 << 1,
    water = 1 << 2,
    mushroom = 1 << 3,
    fire = 1 << 4,
    finished = 1 << 5
  }

  self.pot_order = {
    "pot", "meat", "water", "mushroom", "fire", "finished"
  }

  self.is_s1_oneline_npc_enabled = false

  self.cave_loop_sfx = nil
  -- 동굴 환경 맵 들어 갔는지
  self.cave_inner = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
  local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest('60069')

  self:reset_pot()

  -- 세션 전부 완료시
  if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete then
    self:all_cook()
    return
  end

  local custom_state_mapping = {
    { bit = 1, item = 'meat' }, -- 미니 이벤트 1 클리어
    { bit = 2, item = 'water' }, -- 미니 이벤트 2 클리어
    { bit = 4, item = 'mushroom' }, -- 미니 이벤트 3 클리어
    { bit = 8, item = 'fire' }       -- 미니 이벤트 4 클리어
  }

  local clear_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(
      quest_progress,
      'main_s2_mini_events_clear'
  )

  if clear_state == nil or clear_state == -1 then
    clear_state = 0
  end

  for i = 1, #custom_state_mapping do
    local mapping = custom_state_mapping[i]

    if (clear_state & mapping.bit) ~= 0 then
      self:set_pot(mapping.item)
    end
  end
end

function local_class:dispose()
  self.super:dispose()

  if self.cave_loop_sfx then
    self.cave_loop_sfx:Stop()
  end
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
  return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleLeaveEvent), 'on_battle_leave_event')
end

function local_class:on_stage_end()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then
    self.cave_inner = false

    -- sfx
    if self.cave_loop_sfx then
      music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.cave_loop_sfx , 0, 0)
      music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })
    end

    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_4_main_zone') then
    self.cave_inner = true

    -- sfx
    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
    if self.cave_loop_sfx == nil then
      self.cave_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_cave_01', type_priority = 'event', loop = true })
    else
      music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.cave_loop_sfx , 1, 0)
    end

    return true
  end

  return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_leave_event(e)
  if e.FieldObject == get_party_leader() and self.cave_inner then
    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
    music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(self.cave_loop_sfx, 1, 0)
  end
end

--region pot
function local_class:set_pot(flag_name)
  local flag_value = self.pot_flags[flag_name]
  self.current_flag = self.current_flag | flag_value

  for i = 1, #self.pot_order do
    local current_state_name = self.pot_order[i]
    local state_flag = self.pot_flags[current_state_name]

    local is_active = (self.current_flag & state_flag) ~= 0

    self.pot_children[i].gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
  end
end

function local_class:reset_pot()
  self.current_flag = 1
  self:set_pot('pot')
end

function local_class:all_cook()
  self:set_pot('meat')
  self:set_pot('water')
  self:set_pot('mushroom')
  self:set_pot('fire')
  self:set_pot('finished')
end

  eat_sfx:Stop()

  -- 굶주린 피난민 놀람
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(hungry_refugee, 'right', 'embarrassed', 'surprise')

  -- 페퍼 (화면 밖에서) : 잠깐!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
  scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(get_party_leader(), self, nil,
      nil, nil, {
        key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_2',
        viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8),
        bubble_direction = 'ct'
      })

  -- 굶주린 피난민 놀람
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(hungry_refugee, 'up', 'embarrassed', 'surprise')

  local pepper_destination = self.marker.pepper()
  local pepper_start_pos = vector(pepper_destination.x, pepper_destination.y, pepper_destination.z + 6)
  character_util.set_position(pepper, pepper_start_pos)

  -- 화면 밖에서 국자 생성
  local ladle_pos = self.marker.pollution_bread()
  ladle_pos.y = ladle_pos.y + 2
  ladle_pos.z = ladle_pos.z + 6
  local ladle = drop_item_util.create_item({
    pos = ladle_pos,
    itemid = 20009,
    notforinven = true,
    sprscale = 1,
    lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
    showoncharacter = true
  })

  -- 국자 날아오는 연출
  do
    local p0 = ladle_pos
    local p2 = self.marker.pollution_bread() + vector(0, 0.5, -0.2)
    --local p1 = p0 + (p2 - p0) * 0.5 + vector(-1, 0, 0)

    local time = 0
    local move_speed = 1
    local rotation_speed = 720
    local time_key = 's1_ladle'
    local time_mod = true

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_12')

    -- 카메라 이동
    start_coroutine(function()
      camera_util.move_async(self.marker.pollution_bread() + vector(0, 0, 2), 0.5, { use_unscaledtime = true })
      camera_util.move(self.marker.pollution_bread(), 5, { use_unscaledtime = true })
    end)

    -- 카메라 줌 인/아웃
    start_coroutine(function()
      camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.5, true);
      camera_util.resize_to_default(5, true)
    end)

    -- 국자가 날아와서 오염된 빵에 명중
    while time < 1 do
      local pos = vector_util.lerp(p0, p2, time)
      ladle.Position = pos

      local rotation_delta = vector(0, 0, unity_class.time.deltaTime * rotation_speed)
      ladle.SpriteTransform:Rotate(rotation_delta)
      ladle.ShadowTransform:Rotate(rotation_delta)

      if time_mod and time > 0.4 then
        time_util.mod(time_key, 0.1)
        time_mod = false
      end

      time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime * move_speed
      coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    time_util.unmod(time_key)

    -- 오염된 빵 파괴
    do
      local fx_pos = self.marker.pollution_bread() + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
      unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(fx_pos)
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
      drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.pollution_bread)
      self.pollution_bread = nil

      if self.pollution_bread_fx ~= nil then
        self.pollution_bread_fx:Dispose()
        self.pollution_bread_fx = nil
      end
    end

    -- 국자 튕겨나가기
    local throw_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.marker.pollution_bread() + vector(-5, 0, 0), -2)
    drop_item_util.throw_item(ladle, throw_pos, {
      drop_start_offset = 0.5,
      initial_velocity = 8,
      initial_acceleration = 14,
      rotation_num = 2
    })

    drop_item_util.dispose_item(ladle)
    ladle = nil
  end

  -- 굶주린 피난민 idle 로 복귀
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hungry_refugee)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 페퍼 카메라 밖에서 달려온다
  do
    character_util.set_emotion(pepper, 'attack')

    character_util.remove_anim(pepper)
    wp_util.move_async(pepper, {
      self.marker.pepper()
    }, 6, nil, { run = true, last_direction = 'left', play_sfx = true })
  end

  character_util.set_direction(hungry_refugee, 'right')

  wait_for_sec(0.25)

  -- 페퍼 (left, attack) : (shout 말풍선) 안 됩니다! 그런 비위생적인 식재료는 위장에 대한 모독이에요!
  scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',

      'release', 'mad', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_4')

  -- 페퍼 (left, idle, idle) 점프 x2 : 절망에 빠진 사람들에게 필요한 건 기도가 아니라 '압도적인 칼로리'입니다. 제가 이 능선을 통째로 주방 삼아 [반격의 스튜]를 끓여드리죠!
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        character_util.normal_jump_async(pepper, true)
        character_util.normal_jump_async(pepper, true)
      end,
      function()
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
            'idle', 'idle', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_5')
      end
  )

  -- 굶주린 피난민 (right, tired, idle) :  ...스튜? 아가씨, 제정신이야? 여기 땔감 빼곤 아무것도 없어.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hungry_refugee, self, 'right',
      'idle', 'tired', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_6')

  -- 굶주린 피난민 (right, sleep_deep, idle) : 물이라곤 맹독이 풀린 뒤쪽 우물뿐이고... 고기 같은 건 저 언덕 아래 인베이더 보급 기지에나 산더미처럼 쌓여 있겠지!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hungry_refugee, self, 'right',
      'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_7')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 선택지 출력
  choose_util.play_async({
    {
      -- (mercy)오늘 저녁은 지옥에서 먹는다!!
      'bs_pepper_main_s1_choose_1_1',
      'mercy',
      function()
        -- 페퍼 victory_get
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
        character_util.set_anim(pepper, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

        wait_for_sec(1.5)

        -- 굶주린 피난민 (right, surprise, idle) :  히익! 혼자 저 괴물 소굴을 털어서 고기를 가져오겠다고?!
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hungry_refugee, self, 'right',
            'idle', 'surprise', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_8')

        -- 페퍼 (left, awesome, idle) : 켄터베리의 이름으로! 무자비한 식재료 탈환 작전을 시작하죠!
        character_util.set_anim_time_scale(pepper, 1)
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
            'idle', 'awesome', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_9')
      end
    },
    {
      -- (brutal)고기를 위해 심장을 바쳐라!!
      'bs_pepper_main_s1_choose_1_2',
      'brutal',
      function()
        -- 페퍼 victory_get
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
        character_util.set_anim(pepper, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

        wait_for_sec(1.5)

        -- 굶주린 피난민 (right, surprise, idle) :  이 아가씨 눈빛이 진심이야...! 국자 하나 들고 저 무시무시한 놈들에게 뛰어들 생각인가!
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(hungry_refugee, self, 'right',
            'idle', 'surprise', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_10')

        -- 페퍼 (left, idle, nod 2회 후 idle) : 완벽한 3대 영양소를 위해, 제 심장... 아니, 국자를 기꺼이 바치겠습니다!
        character_util.set_anim_time_scale(pepper, 1)
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
            { name = 'nod', count = 2 }, 'idle', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_11')
      end
    }
  })

  -- 페퍼 (left, smile, idle) :  걱정 마세요. 주방 밖은 온통 신선한 식재료 천지니까요!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
      'idle', 'smile', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_12')

  -- 페퍼 (left, smile, idle) : 제가 당장 재료를 구해올 테니, 다들 솥 주변에 땔감이나 잔뜩 모아둬요!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
      'idle', 'smile', 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_13')

  camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

  -- 나레이션 박스: [반격의 스튜]를 위한 4가지 궁극의 재료를 찾아야 합니다!
  field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec1_14' })

  -- 다음 섹션으로
  self.controller:progress_section()
  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

return local_class

  self.cs_controller = nil
  self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
