  return false
end

function local_class:move_item_async(item, p0, p1, p2, speed)
  local t = 0
  while t < 1 do
    local v = vector_util.quadratic_bezier(p0, p1, p2, t)
    item.Position = v

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  item.Position = p2
end

--region MiniEvents
-- 미니 이벤트 스테이트 로드
function local_class:load_mini_event_state()
  local cur_mini_event_state_pack = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_events_save_state_key)

  -- 0 미만이면 등록된게 없으므로 return
  if cur_mini_event_state_pack < 0 then
    return
  end

  for i = 1, #self.mini_event_save_state do
    local is_clear = ((cur_mini_event_state_pack >> (i - 1)) & 0x1)
    self.mini_event_save_state[i] = is_clear
  end
end

-- 현재 퀘스트 스테이트들을 합친 값 구하기
function local_class:get_pack_state_value()
  local data = 0
  local state = self.mini_event_save_state

  for i = 1, #state do
    local value = i > 1 and ((state[i] << (i - 1)) & (0x1 << (i - 1))) or (state[i] & 0x1)
    data = data | value
  end

  return data
end

function local_class:save_mini_event_cleared_state(mini_event_id)
  -- 이벤트 아이디에 해당하는 퀘스트를 1로
  self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] = 1

  -- 미니이벤트 플래그 합친 값으로 저장
  quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_events_save_state_key,
      self:get_pack_state_value())

  -- 다음 섹션 진행
  if self:get_pack_state_value() >= 15 then
    start_coroutine(self.end_event, self)
  end
end

function local_class:end_event()
  --screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, interpolations_constants.linear)
  self.controller:progress_section()
end

-- 미니 이벤트 클리어 했는지
function local_class:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(mini_event_id)
  if #self.mini_event_save_state < mini_event_id then
    return false
  end

  return self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] > 0
end
--endregion

function local_class:create_oneline_npc(npc_key, marker, direction, anim, emo, talk_id)
  local npc = self.characters.tilemap:get_character(npc_key)
  local position = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker)
  character_util.set_position(npc, position)
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(npc, direction, anim, emo)

  npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
  npc.Interactable.Talk = talk_id
end

function local_class:destroy_oneline_npc(npc_key)
  local npc = self.characters.tilemap:get_character(npc_key)
  character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
  npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
  self.is_disposed = false
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
end

function local_class:start()
  -- 솥에 재료 다 채워진 모습
  self.cs_controller.LuaTable:set_pot('water')
  self.cs_controller.LuaTable:set_pot('mushroom')
  self.cs_controller.LuaTable:set_pot('fire')
  self.cs_controller.LuaTable:set_pot('meat')

  self.current_state = self.states.none

  quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point('pot', self.quest_id,
      true, self.pot_quest_marker_pos)

  -- 솥 상호작용 추가
  self.interact_fo_food_pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

  self.controller:create_s1_oneline_npcs()
end

function local_class:exit()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

  quest_marker_util.remove('pot')
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_soldier_oldman')
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_civilian_male')
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_archives')
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_seira')

  -- 솥 상호작용 제거
  self.interact_fo_food_pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

  self.is_disposed = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
  self.controller = nil
  self.cs_controller = nil
  self.cs_section = nil

  self.is_disposed = true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
  return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.interact_fo_food_pot) then
    quest_marker_util.remove('pot')

    -- 솥 상호작용 제거
    self.interact_fo_food_pot.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

    sp_util.start_scene(self.intro_scene, self)
    return true
  end

  -- 늙은 병사와 대화
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.soldier_oldman) then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_with_soldier_oldman, self)
    return true
  end

  -- 피난민 가족과 대화
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.civilian_male) then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_with_civilian_male, self)
    return true
  end

  -- 기록관과 대화
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.archives) then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_with_archives, self)
    return true
  end

  -- 세이라와 대화
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.characters.seira) then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_with_seira, self)
    return true
  end

  return false
end

function local_class:intro_scene()

  -- 캐릭터 배치

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'up', 'idle', 'idle')

  local seira = self.characters.seira

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(seira, 'left', 'seat', 'tired')

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'right', 'seat', 'tired')

  local civilian_male = self.characters.civilian_male

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(civilian_male, 'left', 'seat', 'tired')

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(civilian_female, 'right', 'seat', 'tired')

  local kid_girl = self.characters.kid_girl
  character_util.set_position(kid_girl, self.marker.kid_girl())
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(kid_girl, 'right', 'seat', 'tired')

  local archives = self.characters.archives

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(archives, 'left', 'seat', 'tired')

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(kid_boy, 'right', 'seat', 'tired')

  -- 카메라 위치 조정

  -- 화면 페이드인

  -- 페퍼 (up, awesome) : (반짝이는 이펙트) 모든 준비는 끝났습니다. 이제 흩어졌던 식재료들이 하나의 '승리'로 거듭날 시간이에요!

  -- 페퍼 (up, attack) : 정화된 조리수 투하! 1등급 고기와 송이 엑기스를 넣고... 화력을 최대치로 올립니다!

      { name = 'attack', count = 1 }, 'idle', 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_2')
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_boiling_02')

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 피난민 아빠 (right, sleep_deep) :  이... 이 향기는...? 잊고 있었던 고향의 냄새요... 아니, 그 이상의 무언가가 코끝을 강타하고 있어!

      'idle', 'sleep_deep', 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_3')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 늙은 병사 (right, surprised) :  허억... 죽어있던 위장이 요동치는군. 세포 하나하나가 비명을 지르며 이 압도적인 향기에 굴복하고 있어!

  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldier_oldman, self, 'right',
      'idle', 'surprise', 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_4')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼 (up, awesome) : (shout 말풍선) 오래 기다리셨습니다! 켄터베리의 맥박을 다시 뛰게 할 궁극의 메뉴!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
  scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'up',
      'idle', 'awesome', 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_5')

  -- 나머지 NPC 들이 전부 일어난다
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(seira, 'left', 'idle', 'idle')
      end,
      function()
        character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(civilian_female, 'right', 'idle', 'idle')

        wait_for_sec(0.2)

        character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(kid_girl, 'right', 'idle', 'idle')
      end,

      function()
        character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(archives, 'left', 'idle', 'idle')

        wait_for_sec(0.25)

        character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(kid_boy, 'left', 'idle', 'idle')
      end

  -- 페퍼 (up, awesome) : [반격의 스튜], 완성입니다!!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'up',
      'idle', 'awesome', 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_6')

  camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

    quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('s3_soldier_oldman', self.quest_id, true, soldier_oldman)
  end

  -- 피난민 가족 인터렉션 활성화

    civilian_male.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
    quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('s3_civilian_male', self.quest_id, true, civilian_male)
  end

  -- 기록관 인터렉션 활성화
  do
    archives.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
    quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo('s3_archives', self.quest_id, true, archives)
  end

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:interact_with_soldier_oldman()

  -- 페퍼 위치 정렬

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼가 스튜를 전달
  self:play_give(pepper, soldier_oldman)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 늙은 병사 줌인
  do
    local duration = 0.5
    camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, duration)
    camera_util.move_to_target(soldier_oldman, duration)

    wait_for_sec(duration)

  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'right', 'idle', 'burning')

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 카메라 복원
  do
    local duration = 1
    camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
    camera_util.move_to_target(pepper, duration)
  end

  -- 늙은 병사 4 방향 제자리 점프

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)

    character_util.normal_jump_async(soldier_oldman)
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)

    wait_for_sec(0.25)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'left', { name = 'jump', loop = false }, 'burning')
    character_util.normal_jump_async(soldier_oldman)

    wait_for_sec(0.25)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'up', { name = 'jump', loop = false }, 'burning')
    character_util.normal_jump_async(soldier_oldman)

    wait_for_sec(0.25)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'right', { name = 'jump', loop = false }, 'burning')
    character_util.normal_jump_async(soldier_oldman)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(soldier_oldman, 'right', 'idle', 'burning')

    wait_for_sec(0.25)
  end

  -- 늙은 병사 (right, victory_extra) : (shout 말풍선) 오오오! 이 맛은...! 온몸의 혈관이 고속도로처럼 뚫리는 기분이다! 멈췄던 심장이 엔진처럼 포효하며 다시 뜨거운 피를 뿜어내고 있어!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')

      { name = 'victory_extra', keep = 'true' }, { name = 'burning', keep = true }, 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_7')

  camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

  -- 인터렉션 제거

  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_soldier_oldman')

  self.current_state = self.current_state | self.states.give_soldier_oldman
  self:try_enable_seira()

function local_class:interact_with_civilian_male()
  local pepper = get_character('pepper')
  local civilian_male = self.characters.civilian_male
  local civilian_female = self.characters.civilian_female
  local kid_girl = self.characters.kid_girl

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼 위치 정렬
  self:align_position(pepper, civilian_male, 1, 0.5)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼가 스튜를 전달
  self:play_give(pepper, civilian_male)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 피난민 아빠 줌인
  do
    local duration = 0.5
    camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, duration)
    camera_util.move_to_target(civilian_male, duration)

    wait_for_sec(duration)
  end

  start_coroutine(function()
    local fo_list = { civilian_male, civilian_female, kid_girl }

    local center
    do
      local pos1 = civilian_male.Position
      local pos2 = civilian_female.Position
      local pos3 = kid_girl.Position

      local x = (pos1.x + pos2.x + pos3.x) / 3
      local z = (pos1.z + pos2.z + pos3.z) / 3

      center = vector(x, 0, z)
    end

    for i = 1, #fo_list do
      character_util.set_emotion(fo_list[i], { name = 'smile', loop = true })
    end

    local distance = vector_util.distance(civilian_male.Position, center)
    local angle = 0
    local delta_angle = 120
    while not self.is_disposed do
      self:rotate_circle_position(center, fo_list, angle, angle + delta_angle, distance, 0.4)
      angle = angle + delta_angle

      wait_for_sec(0.5)
    end
  end)

  -- 피난민 아빠 (smile, jump) : 텅 비었던 위장에 '생명' 그 자체가 휘몰아친다! 마치 전설의 신수가 내 몸속을 달리는 듯한 이 카타르시스!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_male, self, nil, nil, nil, 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_8')

  -- 카메라 복원
  do
    local duration = 1
    camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
    camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
  end

  -- 인터렉션 제거
  civilian_male.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_civilian_male')

  self.current_state = self.current_state | self.states.give_civilian_male
  self.stop_jump_sfx = true
  self:try_enable_seira()
end

function local_class:interact_with_archives()
  local pepper = get_character('pepper')
  local archives = self.characters.archives
  local kid_boy = self.characters.kid_boy

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼 위치 정렬
  self:align_position(pepper, archives, -1.5, 0.5)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼가 스튜를 전달
  self:play_give(pepper, archives)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 필드와 다른 캐릭터 어둡게 처리
  local darken_key = 'darken'
  local darken_fos = {
    pepper,
    self.characters.soldier_oldman,
    self.characters.civilian_male,
    self.characters.civilian_female,
    self.characters.kid_girl,
    self.characters.seira
  }
  do
    field_util.darken(darken_key, 0.5, 0.1)

    for _, fo in ipairs(darken_fos) do
      character_util.add_color(fo, darken_key, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 0.1)
    end
  end

  -- 기록관 줌인
  do
    local duration = 0.5
    camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.6, duration)
    camera_util.move_to_target(archives, duration)

    wait_for_sec(duration)
  end

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 화면 번쩍번쩍
  do
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throne_thunder_01')

    local flash_timings = {
      { in_time = 0.03, out_time = 0.25, wait = 0.4 }, -- 짧고 강한 번개
      { in_time = 0.02, out_time = 0.08, wait = 0.15 }, -- 빠른 더블 스트라이크
      { in_time = 0.02, out_time = 0.08, wait = 0.6 }, -- 더블 스트라이크 잔상
      { in_time = 0.04, out_time = 0.45, wait = 1.0 }, -- 강하고 길게
    }

    for _, t in ipairs(flash_timings) do
      screen_util.fade_out_async(t.in_time, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
      wait_for_sec(t.in_time)
      screen_util.fade_in_async(t.out_time, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
      wait_for_sec(t.wait)
    end
  end

  -- 꼬마 신남
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(kid_boy, 'left', 'victory_extra', 'smile')

  -- 기록관 (left, smile, victory_extra) : 뇌리에 번개가 치는 듯하군! 잿더미 같던 내 역사서에 다시금 황금빛 문장이 새겨지는 기분일세!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archives, self, 'left',
      { name = 'victory_extra', keep = true }, { name = 'smile', keep = true }, 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_9')

  -- 카메라 및 암전 원복
  do
    local duration = 1

    field_util.undarken(darken_key, duration)

    for _, fo in ipairs(darken_fos) do
      character_util.remove_color(fo, darken_key, duration)
    end

    camera_util.resize_to_default(duration)
    camera_util.return_to_leader(duration)
  end

  -- 인터렉션 제거
  archives.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
  quest_marker_util.remove('s3_archives')

  self.current_state = self.current_state | self.states.give_archives
  self:try_enable_seira()
end

function local_class:align_position(character, target, target_dir, detour_distance)
  do
    local character_pos = character.Position

    -- target_dir > 0 인 경우 target 의 오른쪽에서 마주봐야 함
    local wrong_spot = target.Position + vector(-target_dir, 0, 0)
    local good_spot = target.Position + vector(target_dir, 0, 0)

    -- detour_dir == 1 인 경우 위로 돌아감
    local detour_dir
    if good_spot.z < character_pos.z then
      detour_dir = 1
    else
      detour_dir = -1
    end
    detour_dir = detour_dir * detour_distance

    local last_direction
    if target_dir > 0 then
      last_direction = 'left'
    else
      last_direction = 'right'
    end

    if vector_util.distance(character_pos, wrong_spot) < vector_util.distance(character_pos, good_spot) then
      -- 타겟과 부딫히지 않게 돌아가야 함
      local wp1 = character_pos + vector(0, 0, detour_dir)
      local wp2 = vector(good_spot.x, good_spot.y, wp1.z)
      character_util.remove_anim(character)
      wp_util.move_async(character, {
        wp1,
        wp2,
        good_spot
      }, -1, -1, { last_direction = last_direction })
    else
      local wp1 = vector(good_spot.x, good_spot.y, character_pos.z)
      character_util.remove_anim(character)
      wp_util.move_async(character, {
        wp1,
        good_spot
      }, -1, -1, { last_direction = last_direction })
    end
  end
end

function local_class:play_give(character, target)
  local prev_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(character)

  -- eat 애니메이션 방향 설정
  local eat_dir;
  if character.Position.x < target.Position.x then
    eat_dir = 'right'
  else
    eat_dir = 'left'
  end

  local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(character, eat_dir, 'eat', 'idle')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)
  eat_sfx:Stop()

  -- 방향 원복
  character_util.set_direction(character, prev_direction)
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
end

-- 회전 위치 계산 함수
function local_class:calc_circle_position(angle, distance)
  local radian = angle / 180
  local x = unity_class.mathf.Cos(unity_class.mathf.PI * radian) * distance
  local z = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * radian) * distance

  return vector(x, 0, z)
end

-- 오브젝트들을 center를 중심으로, 빙글빙글 회전시킴
function local_class:rotate_circle_position(center, fo_list, start_angle, end_angle, distance, duration)
  local time_passed = 0

  -- 시작 지점에서 부터 끝 지점까지의 방향을 계산해서, mario_jump에 사용
  for i = 1, #fo_list do
    local fo = fo_list[i]
    local fo_start_angle = ((i - 1) * (360 / #fo_list)) + start_angle
    local fo_end_angle = ((i - 1) * (360 / #fo_list)) + end_angle
    local start_offset = self:calc_circle_position(fo_start_angle, distance)
    local end_offset = self:calc_circle_position(fo_end_angle, distance)
    local start_position = center + start_offset
    local end_position = center + end_offset

    local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(end_position - start_position)

    if not self.stop_jump_sfx then
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
    end
    character_util.mario_jump_new(fo, dir, duration, 0.4)
  end

  -- 원 형태로 빙글빙글 돌게 함
  while time_passed < duration do
    local progress = time_passed / duration
    local angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, end_angle, progress)

    for i = 1, #fo_list do
      local fo = fo_list[i]
      local fo_angle = ((i - 1) * (360 / #fo_list)) + angle
      local offset = self:calc_circle_position(fo_angle, distance)

      fo.Position = center + offset
    end

    time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    coroutine.yield()
  end

  for i = 1, #fo_list do
    local fo = fo_list[i]
    local fo_angle = ((i - 1) * (360 / #fo_list)) + end_angle
    local offset = self:calc_circle_position(fo_angle, distance)

    fo.Position = center + offset

    local dir = vector_util.to_direction(center - fo.Position)
    character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
  end
end

function local_class:biryong_scene(character, other_fos)
  -- ====== 1. 셋업: 카메라 반경 계산, 필드 오브젝트 참조 ======
  local character_pos = character.Position
  local cam = stage_camera.Camera
  local shadow = character.transform:Find('shadow')
  local screenPlayPos = vector(-999, 0, -999)
  local fadeTime = 0.2
  local halfSize = vector(cam.orthographicSize * (CS.UnityEngine.Screen.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height) + 2,
      cam.orthographicSize + 2)

  -- ====== 2. 암전 + 파티 멤버 페이드아웃 ======
  local darken_key = 'darken'
  field_util.darken(darken_key, 1, fadeTime)

  -- 파티원들 투명하게 페이드 (0.2초)
  for i = 1, #other_fos do
    other_fos[i].SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, fadeTime)
  end

  -- 페이드 끝날 때까지 대기
  wait_for_sec(fadeTime)

  -- ====== 3. 연출 위치로 이동 ======
  camera_util.move(screenPlayPos, 0)
  shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)
  character.Position = screenPlayPos
  coroutine.yield(nil)

  -- ====== 4. 음악 끄고 번개 이펙트 ======
  music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)  -- BGM 음소거
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_coop_matched_01')        -- 번개 직전 효과음
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_count_final_01')         -- 긴장감 효과음
  -- 번개 FX (FX_Thunder) 인스턴스 생성 (위치: screenPlayPos 근처, Z축 -90도 회전)
  self.thunderEffectPool:Instantiate(vector(-1005.9, 1.4, -999),
      unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.forward), stage.StageGameObject.transform)

  wait_for_sec(0.8)        -- 번개 잔광 대기

  -- ====== 5. 캐릭터 놀람 + 대사 ======
  character_util.set_direction(character, 'down')
  character:SetEmotion('surprise', true)

  music_player:PlayDialogueSfx(CS.Oak.DialogueSfxType.Negative)
  -- 대사 말풍선 (bs_pepper_main_sec3_11, shout 타입)
  speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_11',
                                                           bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(-1000.4, 0, -999), skip = true })

  -- ====== 6. 캐릭터 마법 시전 연출 ======
  character:SetAnimation('meditation', true)           -- 명상(마법시전) 애니메이션
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_queen_spell_01')          -- 마법 시전 효과음
  -- 마법 루프 사운드 (페이드아웃 때까지 재생)
  local loopSfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_cast_magic_01',
                                               loop = true, type_priority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event,
                                               player_priority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc })
  -- 블랙홀 FX (FX_Chapter6_Sapa_energyball_cast) 생성
  local blackhole = self.blackholeEffectPool:Instantiate(character.Position:GetX0z(0.2))
  -- 블랙홀 스케업: 0 → 0.5 (0.3초)
  start_coroutine(self.blackhole_scaling, self, blackhole, 0.3, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5)
  -- 캐릭터: 3600도 회전 + 4초 동안 크기가 0으로 줄어듦 (블랙홀 속으로 빨려들어가는 연출)
  character.SpineController:Rotate(3600, 4)
  character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.zero, 4)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 대사 (bs_pepper_main_sec3_12, 1.8초 제한)
  --speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character,
  --    { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_12', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(-1001, 0, -999),
  --      skip = true, life_time = 1.8 })

  loopSfx:FadeOut()  -- 마법 루프 사운드 페이드아웃

  -- 블랙홀 스케다운: 0.5 → 0 (0.5초)
  yield_return_func(function()
    self:blackhole_scaling(blackhole, 0.5, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, unity_class.vector3.zero)
  end)
  blackhole:Dispose()  -- 블랙홀 FX 제거

  -- ====== 7. 캐릭터 재등장 ======
  -- 캐릭터를 화면 우측으로 이동 (원래 크기로 복귀)
  character.Position = vector(screenPlayPos.x + halfSize.x, 0, screenPlayPos.z)
  character.SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one, 0)    -- 크기 즉시 1로
  character.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)                         -- 회전 초기화
  character:SetEmotion('blush', true)
  character:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
  character_util.set_locked_dir(character, 'down')
  coroutine.yield(nil)

  -- 캐릭터가 우측에서 좌측으로 걷기
  start_coroutine(self.move_waypoint, self, character,
      vector(screenPlayPos.x - halfSize.x, 0, screenPlayPos.z), 4, 0, false, false)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- ====== 8. 지진 + 배경 전환 (검은 플레인으로 커버) ======
  loopSfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', -- 지진음 루프
                                         loop = true, type_priority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event,
                                         player_priority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc })

  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_keyitem_effect_01')     -- 아이템 효과음
  speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character,
      { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_12', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(-1001, 0, -999), skip = true })

  -- 카메라 앞에 검은 커버 플레인 생성 (화면 전체 덮는 반투명 메쉬)
  local coverPlane = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('CoverPlane')
  local meshFilter = coverPlane:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshFilter))
  local renderer = coverPlane:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

  -- 4 꼭짓점 + 2 삼각형 메쉬 빌드
  local vertices = {}
  table.insert(vertices, vector(halfSize.x, 0, halfSize.y))
  table.insert(vertices, vector(halfSize.x, 0, -halfSize.y))
  table.insert(vertices, vector(-halfSize.x, 0, -halfSize.y))
  table.insert(vertices, vector(-halfSize.x, 0, halfSize.y))
  local triangles = { 0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3 }
  local mesh = CS.UnityEngine.Mesh()
  mesh.vertices = vertices
  mesh.triangles = triangles
  meshFilter.mesh = mesh

  -- Unlit/Transparent Tint 셰이더, 검정색
  local mat = renderer.material
  mat.shader = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.Find('Unlit/Transparent Tint')
  mat.color = unity_class.color.black

  coverPlane.transform.position = cam.transform.position
  coverPlane.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-45, 0, 0)

  -- ====== 9. 용암 배경 로드 + 커버 플레인 페이드인(투명→보임) ======
  local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      resholder, 'theatres/dragon_boy', 'dragonboy_lava_bg', function(prefab)
        self.lavaTransform = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab).transform
        self.lavaTransform.position = vector(-999, 0, -999)
        self.lavaTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-45, 0, 0)
        self.lavaTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
      end)

  -- 커버 플레인 알파 1→0 (1초): 검정 화면에서 점차 배경이 보임
  local t = 1
  local tp = 0
  while tp <= t do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / t)
    mat.color = unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, 1 - progress)
    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  wait_for_sec(2)
  loopSfx:FadeOut()               -- 지진음 페이드아웃
  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 커버 플레인 알파 0→1 (1초): 배경이 다시 검정으로 덮임
  tp = 0
  while tp <= t do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / t)
    mat.color = unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, progress)
    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  -- 용암 배경 제거
  CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.lavaTransform.gameObject)
  self.lavaTransform = nil

  -- ====== 10. 하늘 배경으로 전환 ======
  character.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)  -- 캐릭터 즉시 투명
  CS.SpeechBubble.Return(character)             -- 말풍선 제거
  -- 하늘 배경 (flyout_bg) 비동기 로드
  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      resholder, 'theatres/flyout_sky', 'flyout_bg', function(prefab)
        self.skyTransform = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab).transform
        self.skyTransform.position = screenPlayPos
      end)

  stage_camera:ResizeTo(3, 0)  -- 카메라 줌아웃 (3배)

  -- 커버 플레인 알파 1→0 (1초): 하늘 배경이 점점 드러남
  tp = 0
  while tp <= t do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / t)
    mat.color = unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, 1 - progress)
    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  -- ====== 11. 캐릭터 하늘로 날아감 ======
  local newhalfSize = vector(cam.orthographicSize * (CS.UnityEngine.Screen.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height) + 2,
      cam.orthographicSize + 2)

  character.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, 0)  -- 캐릭터 즉시 복귀
  character.Position = vector(screenPlayPos.x, 0, screenPlayPos.z - newhalfSize.y)  -- 화면 아래쪽 배치
  character.SpineController:Rotate(0, 0)
  character:SetEmotion('sleep_deep', true)
  character:RemoveAnimation()
  character_util.set_locked_dir(character, 'up')

  coroutine.yield(nil)

  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_get_heal_01')  -- 치유 효과음
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bird_enter_01')  -- 새 소리
  --speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character,
  --    { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_13', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(-1001, 0, -999), skip = true })

  -- 캐릭터 화면 아래에서 중심으로 EaseOutQuart 비행 (2.5초)
  yield_return_func(self.fly_character, self, character, character.Position, screenPlayPos, 2.5)

  -- 캐릭터 착지
  character:SetEmotion('smile', true)
  character:SetAnimation('get', true)
  character_util.set_locked_dir(character, 'down')

  speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character,
      { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_13', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = vector(-1001, 0, -999), skip = true })

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- ====== 12. 폭죽 + 박수 ======
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_clap_02')  -- 박수
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_firework_01')    -- 폭죽 소리

  -- 5개 지점에서 폭죽 FX (fx_s_fireworks_explosion) 순차 생성
  local fireworkPointList = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
  fireworkPointList:Add(screenPlayPos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 2)
  fireworkPointList:Add(screenPlayPos + unity_class.vector3.left * 3)
  fireworkPointList:Add(screenPlayPos + unity_class.vector3.right * 3)
  fireworkPointList:Add(screenPlayPos + unity_class.vector3.left * 3 + unity_class.vector3.back * 2)
  fireworkPointList:Add(screenPlayPos + unity_class.vector3.right * 3 + unity_class.vector3.back * 2)

  while true do
    local random = CS.Utils.GetRandomInt(0, fireworkPointList.Count)
    local pos = fireworkPointList[random]
    self.fireworkEffectPool:Instantiate(pos)
    fireworkPointList:RemoveAt(random)
    wait_for_sec(0.15)
    if fireworkPointList.Count == 0 then
      break
    end
  end

  wait_for_sec(2.5)

  -- ====== 13. 하늘 배경 제거 + 원래 위치로 복귀 ======
  -- 커버 플레인 알파 0→1 (1초): 하늘 배경을 검정으로 덮음
  tp = 0
  while tp <= t do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / t)
    mat.color = unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, progress)
    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.skyTransform.gameObject)
  self.skyTransform = nil
  CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(coverPlane)
  coverPlane = nil

  -- 캐릭터 원래 위치로
  character.Position = character_pos
  camera_util.move(character_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

  -- 필드 암전 해제
  stage.Field:Undarken(darken_key, 1)
  shadow.gameObject:SetActive(true)

  -- 파티원들 페이드인 (1초)
  for i = 1, #other_fos do
    other_fos[i].SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, 1)
  end

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- ====== 14. 캐릭터 점프 + 마무리 대사 ======
  character:SetEmotion('damaged', true)
  music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
  character.SpineController:Jump(0.7, 0.5)  -- 높이 0.7, 지속 0.5초 점프
  music_player:PlayDialogueSfx(CS.Oak.DialogueSfxType.Positive)

  speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec3_14',
                                                           bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

  -- 방향 잠금 해제
  if character.LockedDirection ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
    character.Direction = character.LockedDirection
    character_util.set_locked_dir(character, 'none')
  end

  character:RemoveAnimation()
  character:RemoveEmotion()
  stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0.5)  -- 카메라 줌 원복
  wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:blackhole_scaling(blackhole, scalingTime, startScale, targetScale)
  local tp = 0

  while tp <= scalingTime do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / scalingTime)

    if progress <= 0 then
      progress = 0.01
    end

    blackhole.transform.localScale = startScale * (1 - progress) + targetScale * progress

    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end
end

function local_class:move_waypoint(character, targetpos, duration, speed, prevAnimCancel, run)
  if prevAnimCancel then
    character:RemoveAnimation()
  end

  if duration > 0 then
    local move_done = false
    local diff = (targetpos - character.Position):GetX0z().magnitude
    local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(targetpos, diff / duration, run)
    info.callback = function()
      move_done = true
    end

    CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(character, info)

    while not move_done do
      coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
  else
    if speed > 0 then
      local move_done = false
      local info = CS.Oak.WaypointMoveInfo.Create(targetpos, speed, run)
      info.callback = function()
        move_done = true
      end

      CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState.MoveWaypoints(character, info)

      while not move_done do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
      end
    else
      character.Position = targetpos
    end
  end
end

function local_class:fly_character(character, startpos, targetpos, duration)
  local tp = 0

  while tp <= duration do
    local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(tp, 0, 1, duration))

    character.Position = startpos * (1 - progress) + targetpos * progress

    tp = tp + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

end

return local_class

    if script ~= nil then

    end
  end

local mini_event = newclass('MiniEvent1')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)

  self.event_controller = event_controller

  self.quest_id = self.quest_controller.cs_controller.QuestId

  -- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
  self.states = {
    none = 1,
    start = 2,
    battle_end = 3,
    get_beef = 4,
    done = 5
  }
  self.current_state = self.states.none

  -- fo
  self.characters = self.quest_controller.characters

  local guard_count = 24
  local prefix = 'guard_'
  self.guards = {}
  for i = 1, guard_count do

  self.interact_fo_food_box = get_field_object('s2_1_food_box')

  self.interact_fo_enter_main = get_field_object('s2_1_enter')
  self.interact_fo_exit_main = get_field_object('s2_1_exit')

  self.reset_switch = get_field_object('s2_1_reset_switch')

  -- marker
  self.pot_quest_marker_pos = self.interact_fo_food_pot.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 1)
  self.food_box_quest_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_1_pepper_food_box_pos') + vector(0.5, 0, 2)

  self.return_pos_1 = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_1_discover_return_1_pos')
  self.return_pos_2 = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_1_discover_return_2_pos')

  self.return_pos = {
    self.return_pos_1,
    self.return_pos_2
  }
  self.current_return_pos = self.return_pos[1]

  self.guard_23_origin_pos = self.guards[23].Position
  self.guard_24_origin_pos = self.guards[24].Position

  -- fx
  self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
    teleport = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
    end
  })

  -- etc
  self.battle_gate_name = 's2_1_battle_gate_'
  self.battle_gate_count = 2
  self.battle_group_name = 's2_1_battle_group'

  self.battle_wall_name = 's2_1_battle_wall_'
  self.battle_wall_count = 6

  -- 폭탄으로 죽는 정찰병
  self.guard_14_dead = false
  self.guard_15_dead = false
  self.guard_23_dead = false
  self.guard_24_dead = false

  -- 상수
  self.const_bomb_range = 1.7

  -- virtual field object
  self.virtual_wall_list = {
    fo = {},
    create_wall = function(this, pos, hitbox)
      local new_wall = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(pos, { hit_box = hitbox })
      table.insert(this.fo, new_wall)
    end,
    dispose_all = function(this)
      for i = 1, #this.fo do
        local wall = this.fo[i]

        if wall ~= nil then
          wall:Dispose()
        end

        wall = nil
      end
      this.fo = nil
    end
  }
end

function mini_event:enter()
  self.current_state = self.states.start

  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
end

function mini_event:start()

  self:battle_wall_active(false)

    { zone = 's2_1_food_box_zone', target = self.food_box_quest_marker_pos }
  }, 's2_1_food_box', self.quest_id, true )
end

function mini_event:exit()

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

  self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

--region state 셋팅

--endregion

--region Event 처리
function mini_event:on_event(e)
  if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
    self:on_interact_event(e)
    return true
  end
end

function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
  if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.interact_fo_food_box) then
    self:interact_food_box()

    return true
  end

  return false
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') and
      self.current_state == self.states.start or self.current_state == self.states.battle_end then

    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_1_food_box_zone') and
      self.current_state == self.states.start or self.current_state == self.states.battle_end then

    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_1_discover_zone_1') then
    self:discover_zone_1_enter()

    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_1_discover_zone_2') then
    self:discover_zone_2_enter()

    return true
  end
end

function mini_event:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
  if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
    start_coroutine(self.battle_end, self)
    self:unblock_cliff()
    return true
  end

  return false
end

function mini_event:on_custom_stage_event(e)
  if self.is_detected then
    return
  end

  if e.Params[0] == 'discovered' then
    local detector = stage:GetCharacter(e.Params[1])
    sp_util.start_scene(self.on_detected, self, detector)
  end
end

function mini_event:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
  -- 폭탄이 터진 경우
  if lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) then
    if (self.guards[14].Position  - e.FieldObject.Position).magnitude < self.const_bomb_range then
      if not self.guard_14_dead then
        self.guard_14_dead = true
        self:dead_guard(self.guards[14])
        character_util.set_direction(self.guards[14],'left')
      end
    end

    if (self.guards[15].Position  - e.FieldObject.Position).magnitude < self.const_bomb_range then
      if not self.guard_15_dead then
        self.guard_15_dead = true
        self:dead_guard(self.guards[15])
        character_util.set_direction(self.guards[15],'right')
      end
    end

    if (self.guards[23].Position  - e.FieldObject.Position).magnitude < self.const_bomb_range then
      if not self.guard_23_dead then
        self.guard_23_dead = true
        self:dead_guard(self.guards[23])
      end
    end

    if (self.guards[24].Position  - e.FieldObject.Position).magnitude < self.const_bomb_range then
      if not self.guard_24_dead then
        self.guard_24_dead = true
        self:dead_guard(self.guards[24])
      end
    end
  end
end

function mini_event:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
  if e.SwitchObject == self.reset_switch then
    print('test: ')
    self.fx.teleport():Instantiate(self.guards[23].Position)
    self.fx.teleport():Instantiate(self.guards[24].Position)

    self.guards[23].Position = self.guard_23_origin_pos
    self.guards[24].Position = self.guard_24_origin_pos

    self.fx.teleport():Instantiate(self.guards[23].Position)
    self.fx.teleport():Instantiate(self.guards[24].Position)
  end
end

  self.current_return_pos = self.return_pos[1]

  self.current_return_pos = self.return_pos[2]

function mini_event:convert_party()
  -- 플레이 파티 캐싱
  self.cache_party = user_party
  local party_pos = get_party_leader().Position

  -- 플레이어블 캐릭터들 npc로 변환
  for i = 0, self.cache_party.Count - 1 do
    local member = self.cache_party[i]
    character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
    field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.disabled)
    member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
  end

  -- 기존 프리셋 파티 플레이어블 파티로 변경
  for i, member in ipairs(party_util.get_origin_party()) do
    if i == 1 then
      local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
      param.MoveCamera = false
      character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(member, param)
    else
      character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(member, user_party, true)
    end
    member.Position = party_pos
    field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.enabled)
    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, member:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())
  end
end

  party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

  -- fo
  local pepper = self.characters.tilemap:get_character('pepper')
  local leader_pos = get_party_leader().Position
  pepper.Position = leader_pos

  camera_util.set_position(leader_pos)

  -- 기존 파티원 정리
  local current_party = get_user_party()
  for i = current_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
    local member = current_party[i]
    character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
    field_object_util.set_active_state(member, active_state_type.disabled)
    member.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

  for i = 1, self.battle_wall_count do
    local wall = get_field_object(self.battle_wall_name .. i)
    if show then
      field_object_util.set_active_state(wall, active_state_type.enabled)
    else
      field_object_util.set_active_state(wall, active_state_type.disabled)
    end
  end
end

--베지어 곡선
function mini_event:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, height_x1, height_x2)
  height_x1 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x1, 0)
  height_x2 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x2, 0)

  local pos = {
    start_pos,
    start_pos + vector(height_x1, height, 0),
    end_pos + vector(height_x2, height, 0),
    end_pos
  }
  local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

  a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
  b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
  c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
  d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
  e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
  f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

  return f_pos
end
--endregion

function mini_event:on_detected(finder)
  -- fo
  local pepper = self.characters.tilemap:get_character('pepper')

  self.is_detected = true

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_police_01')

  character_util.look_at(pepper, finder)
  character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(pepper, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
  wait_for_sec(0.2)

  scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(finder, 'qs_horse_racing_s1_12')

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
  screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

  -- 리셋 세팅
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pepper)
  pepper.Position = self.current_return_pos
  self:reset_guard()

  screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

-- 인베이더 순찰 On
function mini_event:set_guard_on()
  for i = 1, #self.guards do
    field_object_util.set_active_state(self.guards[i], active_state_type.enabled)
  end
end

-- 인베이더 순찰 Off
function mini_event:set_guard_off()
  for i = 1, #self.guards do
    field_object_util.set_active_state(self.guards[i], active_state_type.disabled)
  end
end

-- 인베이더 순찰 초기화
function mini_event:reset_guard()
  for i = 1, #self.guards do
    message_system:SendSync(self.guards[i], CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
  end

  self.is_detected = false
end
--endregion

function mini_event:dead_guard(target)
  character_util.set_anim(target, {name ='prostrate', loop = true})
  character_util.set_emotion(target, {name = 'damaged', loop = true})

  target.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
  local req = CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('prostrate', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Default, true)
  local state = CS.Oak.CharacterMarionetteState.Create(target, req)
  local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(state)
  state.CurrentAction = CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped
  message_system:SendSync(target.FieldObjectBehaviour, state_change_event)

  target.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
end

return {
  create = function()
    return mini_event
  end

local mini_event = newclass('MiniEvent2')

    })

    local pos = self.gamepad_label_x.transform.localPosition
    pos.x = self.gamepad_label_b.transform.localPosition.x - 180
    self.gamepad_label_x.transform.localPosition = pos
  end
end

function mini_event:hide_gamepad_label()
  if self.gamepad_label_a ~= nil then
    gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label_a)
    self.gamepad_label_a = nil
  end

  if self.gamepad_label_x ~= nil then
    gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label_x)
    self.gamepad_label_x = nil
  end

  if self.gamepad_label_b ~= nil then
    gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label_b)
    self.gamepad_label_b = nil
  end
end

function mini_event:intro_scene()
  local pepper = self.characters.tilemap:get_character('pepper')

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

  -- 페퍼 위치 정렬
  do
    local cur_pos = pepper.Position
    local dest_pos = self.marker.well_keeper() + vector(1, 0, 0)
    local wp = vector(dest_pos.x, cur_pos.y, cur_pos.z)

    character_util.remove_anim(pepper)
    scene_util.hide_weapon(pepper)
    character_util.force_update_spines(pepper, 0)
    wp_util.move_async(pepper, {
      wp,
      dest_pos
    }, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
  end

  -- 페퍼, 우물지기 노인 마주보기
  character_util.set_direction(self.well_keeper, 'right')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 우물지기 노인 (right, attack, attack) :  멈춰! 오지 마! 맹독성 슬라임 체액이 풀린 물이야. 냄새만 맡아도 즉사한다고!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.well_keeper, self, 'right',
      { name = 'attack', count = 1 }, 'attack', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_1')

  -- 선택지 출력
  choose_util.play_async({
    {
      -- (mercy)독성 점액이라니... 천연 점증제로 딱이군요!
      'bs_pepper_main_s2_2_choose_1_1',
      'mercy',
      function()
        -- 페퍼 victory_get
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
        character_util.set_anim(pepper, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

        wait_for_sec(1.5)

        -- 우물지기 노인(right, surprise, idle) : 무슨 헛소리야! 한 방울만 닿아도 위장이 녹아내린다고!
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.well_keeper, self, 'right',
            'idle', 'surprise', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_2')

        -- 페퍼(left, smile, idle) : 후후, 산도를 조절해서 약불에 졸이면 훌륭한 소스가 되거든요. 바질리스크 독샘이랑 곁들이면 최고죠.
        character_util.set_anim_time_scale(pepper, 1)
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
            'idle', 'smile', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_3')
      end
    },
    {
      -- (brutal)맹독일수록 극한의 감칠맛을 끌어내는 법이죠!
      'bs_pepper_main_s2_2_choose_1_2',
      'brutal',
      function()
        -- 페퍼 victory_get
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
        character_util.set_anim(pepper, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

        wait_for_sec(1.5)

        -- 우물지기 노인(right, surprise, idle) : 맛을 느끼기도 전에 혀가 타들어 갈 거다!
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.well_keeper, self, 'right',
            'idle', 'surprise', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_4')

        -- 페퍼(left, attack, attack) : [shout]독을 핑계로 식재료를 포기하는 건 삼류 셰프나 하는 짓입니다!
        character_util.set_anim_time_scale(pepper, 1)
        scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'left',
            { name = 'attack', count = 1, one_shot_sfx = '01_count_01' }, 'attack', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_5')
      end
    }
  })

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼가 우물에 붙는다
  do
    -- 우물지기 노인이 페퍼를 바라본다
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(self.well_keeper, 'up', 'idle', 'idle')

    -- 카메라 우물로 이동
    camera_util.move(self.marker.well(), 1)

    local dest = self.marker.well() + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
    local wp1 = vector(pepper.Position.x, dest.y, dest.z)
    character_util.remove_anim(pepper)
    wp_util.move_async(pepper, {
      wp1,
      dest
    }, -1, -1, { last_direction = 'down' })
  end

  -- 우물지기 노인이 페퍼를 바라본다
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(self.well_keeper, 'left', 'idle', 'idle')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 페퍼가 품에서 자신의 머리통만 한 거대한 알(코카트리스의 알)들을 여러 개 꺼낸다 (up, eat)
  local eggs = {}
  local egg_positions = {
    pepper.Position + vector(-0.5, 1, 0.5),
    pepper.Position + vector(0, 1, 0.5),
    pepper.Position + vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)
  }
  do
    local p1 = pepper.Position + vector(0, 1, 1)
    local speed = 6

    local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'right', 'eat', 'idle')

    wait_for_sec(1)

    eggs[1] = drop_item_util.create_item({
      pos = pepper.Position,
      itemid = 23010,
      notforinven = true,
      sprscale = 1,
      lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
    })

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
    self:move_item_async(eggs[1], pepper.Position, p1, egg_positions[1], speed)

    wait_for_sec(1)

    eggs[2] = drop_item_util.create_item({
      pos = pepper.Position,
      itemid = 23010,
      notforinven = true,
      sprscale = 1,
      lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
    })

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
    self:move_item_async(eggs[2], pepper.Position, p1, egg_positions[2], speed)

    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    eggs[3] = drop_item_util.create_item({
      pos = pepper.Position,
      itemid = 23010,
      notforinven = true,
      sprscale = 1,
      lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
    })

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')
    self:move_item_async(eggs[3], pepper.Position, p1, egg_positions[3], speed)

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    eat_sfx:Stop()

    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', 'hold_loop', 'idle')
  end

  -- 페퍼 (down, smile, idle) : 맹독성 체액으로 탁해진 국물... 아니, 물을 맑게 만드는 건 요리의 기본 중의 기본입니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'down',
      'hold_loop', 'smile', { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_6', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

  -- 페퍼 (down, attack, idle) : (반짝이는 이펙트) 달걀흰자를 풀어 끓여내면, 흰자가 맹독성 불순물을 전부 흡착해 떠오르는 '콘소메 정화법'을 쓰죠!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'down',
      { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'idle', { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_7', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

  -- 우물지기 노인 (right, scared, idle) :  계... 계란으로 이 거대한 독우물을 정화하겠다고?!
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(self.well_keeper, self, 'left', 'idle', 'scared',
      'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_8')

  -- 우물지기 노인 놀람
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(self.well_keeper, 'left', 'idle', 'surprise')

  -- [1단계: 흰자 분리 타격]
  do
    self.current_state = self.states.acting_1

    local pepper_position = pepper.Position
    local qte_pos = vector(0, -200, 0)
    local qte_start_scale = 250
    local qte_end_scale = 25
    local qte_success_scale_max = 130
    local qte_success_scale_min = 60

    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

    local qte_node = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_blue_node'):Instantiate(qte_pos)
    qte_node:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer)).color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 100.0 / 255.0)
    qte_node.gameObject:SetActive(false)

    local qte_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(qte_pos)
    local qte_button_spine = qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
    CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(qte_button.transform, "FieldUI")
    qte_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)
    qte_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

    local qte_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
    qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
    qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

    if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
      self:show_gamepad_label()
    end

    local faded_out = false
    while true do
      local game_win = false

      -- 상태 초기화
      qte_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
      qte_button_spine:Update(0.1)
      qte_button_spine:LateUpdate()
      qte_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

      qte_node.transform.localScale = vector(qte_start_scale, qte_start_scale, qte_start_scale)
      qte_node.gameObject:SetActive(false)

      character_util.set_position(pepper, pepper_position)
      pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'idle')

      for i = 1, #eggs do
        eggs[i].Position = egg_positions[i]
      end

      if faded_out then
        screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
      end

      -- 페퍼 (up, attack) : (shout 말풍선) 노른자는 빼고, 흰자만 간다!!
      scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'up',
          { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'idle', { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_9', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

      -- 시작 카운트
      local start_count = 3
      local title_mod = 2.1
      for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
        CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format('{0}', i), title_mod)

        wait_for_sec(1)
      end

      music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 1 })
      music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_complete_01')

      qte_node.gameObject:SetActive(true)
      qte_button.gameObject:SetActive(true)

      for i = 1, #eggs do
        game_win = self:throw_egg_qte(pepper, eggs[i],
            qte_node, qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale,
            qte_button_spine, qte_button_touch_handler,
            qte_success_scale_max, qte_success_scale_min,
            i < #eggs)

        if not game_win then
          music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0)
          music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
          break
        end

        if i < #eggs then
          wait_for_sec(0.5)
        else
          -- 마지막 계란을 던져 넣으면 우물 비주얼 갱신
          self.well_clean:SetActive(false)
          self.well_egg:SetActive(true)
          self.well_poison:SetActive(false)
        end
      end

      -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
      if game_win then
        break
      end

      -- 실패 연출
      do
        pepper.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
        CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(pepper, 1, unity_class.color.red, pepper.Position)

        camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

        local p0 = pepper.Position;
        local p2 = self.marker.well()
        local p1 = p0 + (p2 - p0) * 0.5 + vector(0, 4, 0)
        local rotation_speed = 1440

        self:fall_into_well(pepper, p0, p1, p2, 0.5, rotation_speed)
      end

      wait_for_sec(1)

      -- 재시작
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
      faded_out = true
      screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
    end

    qte_button_spine.state:SetEmptyAnimation(0, 0)
    coroutine.yield(nil)

    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', 'idle', 'idle')

    -- 성공 시 리소스 정리
    for i = 1, #eggs do
      drop_item_util.dispose_item(eggs[i])
      eggs[i] = nil
    end
    eggs = {}

    qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
    qte_button_touch_handler = nil

    qte_node:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer)).color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
    qte_node:Dispose()
    qte_node = nil

    qte_button:Dispose()
    qte_button = nil

    self:hide_gamepad_label()

    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))
  end

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- [2단계: 머랭 장벽 젓기]
  do
    self.current_state = self.states.acting_2
    local pepper_position = pepper.Position;

    local left_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(vector(-200, -200, 0))
    local left_button_spine = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
    CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(left_button.transform, "FieldUI")
    left_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)
    left_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
    left_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

    local left_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
    left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
    left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
    left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(5, 5)

    local right_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(vector(200, -200, 0))
    local right_button_spine = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
    CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(right_button.transform, "FieldUI")
    right_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)
    right_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
    right_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

    local right_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
    right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
    right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
    right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(5, 5)

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

    if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
      self:show_gamepad_label()
    end
    
    local faded_out = false
    while true do
      local game_win = true

      -- 페퍼 위치 리셋
      pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
      character_util.set_position(pepper, pepper_position)
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', 'idle', 'idle')

      if faded_out then
        screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
      end

      wait_for_sec(0.5)

      -- 페퍼 (down, attack) : 섬세하게 저어야 합니다! 너무 빠르면 장벽이 깨지고, 너무 느리면 독이 뭉치지 않아요!!
      scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(pepper, self, 'down',
          { name = 'attack', count = 1 }, 'attack', { key = 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_2_10', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lb' })

      music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 1 })
      music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_complete_01')

      left_button.gameObject:SetActive(true)
      left_button_spine:Update(0.1)
      left_button_spine:LateUpdate()
      right_button.gameObject:SetActive(true)
      right_button_spine:Update(0.1)
      right_button_spine:LateUpdate()

      local gauge_value = 0.5
      self.gauge_ui_component:SetProgress(gauge_value)
      self.gauge_ui_obj:SetActive(true)

      wait_for_sec(1)

      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'cast2', loop = true }, 'attack')

      local direction = math.random(0, 1) * 2 - 1
      local velocity = 0
      local acceleration = 0.2 * direction
      local push_power = 0.3

      local elapsed_time = 0
      local acting_time = 20

      local interact_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
        sfx_name = '01_interact_saloon_01', loop = true, volume = 0,
        type_priority = 'event',
      })

      field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')

      while elapsed_time < acting_time do
        local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

        left_button_touch_handler:Update()
        right_button_touch_handler:Update()

        local is_pressed = false
        if left_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_x_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A) then
          self.is_x_button_pressed = false
          is_pressed = true
          -- 왼쪽 버튼 클릭
          left_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)

          if acceleration > 0 then
            acceleration = -unity_class.random.Range(0, 0.2)
          end

          acceleration = acceleration + -push_power * dt
        elseif right_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_b_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D) then
          self.is_b_button_pressed = false
          is_pressed = true
          -- 오른쪽 버튼 클릭
          right_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)

          if acceleration < 0 then
            acceleration = unity_class.random.Range(0, 0.2)
          end

          acceleration = acceleration + push_power * dt
        else
          is_pressed = false
        end

        if is_pressed then
          music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(interact_sfx, 1, 0)
        else
          music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(interact_sfx, 0, 0)
        end

        velocity = velocity + acceleration * dt
        gauge_value = math.min(math.max(gauge_value + velocity * dt, 0), 1)

        local rotation_value = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(180, -180, gauge_value)
        pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, rotation_value)

        self.gauge_ui_component:SetProgress(gauge_value)

        -- 성공 범위를 넘어간 경우 실패
        if gauge_value < 0.4 or gauge_value > 0.6 then
          game_win = false

          music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0)
          music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
          break
        end

        elapsed_time = elapsed_time + dt
        coroutine.yield(nil)
      end

      interact_sfx:Stop()

      left_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)
      right_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

      self.gauge_ui_obj:SetActive(false)

      -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
      if game_win then
        break
      end

      -- 실패 연출
      do
        camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

        local p0 = pepper.Position;
        local p2 = self.marker.well()
        local p1 = p0 + (p2 - p0) * 0.5 + vector(0, 4, 0)
        local rotation_speed = 1440
        if gauge_value > 0.5 then
          rotation_speed = -rotation_speed
        end

        self:fall_into_well(pepper, p0, p1, p2, 0.5, rotation_speed)
      end

      wait_for_sec(0.5)

      -- 재시작
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

      faded_out = true
      screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
    end

    -- 페퍼 애니메이션 초기화
    pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', 'idle', 'idle')

    -- 성공 시 UI 정리
    left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
    left_button_touch_handler = nil

function mini_event:move_item_async(item, p0, p1, p2, speed)
  local t = 0
  while t < 1 do
    local v = vector_util.quadratic_bezier(p0, p1, p2, t)
    item.Position = v

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  item.Position = p2
end

function mini_event:throw_egg_qte(character, egg,
                                  qte_node, qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale,
                                  qte_button_spine, qte_button_touch_handler,
                                  qte_success_scale_max, qte_success_scale_min,
                                  return_to_hold_anim)
  self.is_a_button_pressed = false

  local qte_win = false

  local t = 0
  local qte_speed = 0.4
  while t < 1 do
    local v = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale, t)
    qte_node.transform.localScale = vector(v, v, v)

    qte_button_touch_handler:Update()

    if qte_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_a_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Z) then
      self.is_a_button_pressed = false

      -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
      local node_scale = qte_node.transform.localScale.x
      if node_scale <= qte_success_scale_max and node_scale >= qte_success_scale_min then
        qte_win = true
      end

      break
    end

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * qte_speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  if qte_win then
    qte_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)

    wait_all_lua(
        function()
          character_util.set_direction(character, 'down')
          scene_util.set_anim_async(character, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

          if return_to_hold_anim then
            character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(character, 'up', 'hold_loop', 'idle')
          end
        end,
        function()
          wait_for_sec(0.25)

          local p0 = egg.Position
          local p2 = self.marker.well()
          local p1 = p0 + (p2 - p0) * 0.5 + vector(0, 2, 0)
          self:move_item_async(egg, p0, p1, p2, 4)

          unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(p2)
          music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')
        end
    )
  else
    qte_button_spine.state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_touch_on', false)
  end

  return qte_win
end

function mini_event:fall_into_well(character, p0, p1, p2, speed, rotation_speed)
  local t = 0
  local angle = 0
  local pivot_offset = vector(0, 0.35, 0)

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')

  while t < 1 do
    local pivot_pos = vector_util.quadratic_bezier(p0, p1, p2, t)

    angle = angle + rotation_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
    local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.forward)

    local rotated_offset = rot * pivot_offset
    character.Position = pivot_pos - rotated_offset
    character.transform.rotation = rot

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')
  unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in'):Instantiate(p2)
end

function mini_event:meet_oneline_well_keeper()

  -- 이제 우물은 완전히 오염되어 버렸어… 더는 피해자가 나오게 할 수 없어….

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
    return false
  end

  -- 버섯에 가까이 접근
  if self.current_state == self.states.start and
      type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_3_mushroom_spot_zone') then

    elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
      self.is_a_button_pressed = true

  return false
end

function mini_event:rhythm_qte(character, target,
                               up_notes, down_notes,
                               up_button_pos, down_button_pos,
                               up_button_touch_handler, down_button_touch_handler,
                               up_button_state, down_button_state)
  local up_note_objects = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
  local up_note_hits = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
  for i = 0, up_notes.Count - 1 do
    up_note_objects:Add(nil)
    up_note_hits:Add(0)
  end

  local down_note_objects = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
  local down_note_hits = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
  for i = 0, down_notes.Count - 1 do
    down_note_objects:Add(nil)
    down_note_hits:Add(0)
  end

  local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height;
  local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight);
  local note_speed = target_size.x / 2.0
  local note_appear_dist = target_size.x + 120
  local note_appear_time = note_appear_dist / note_speed
  local time_threshold = 0.085
  local note_disappear_time = 300 / note_speed
  local time_passed = 0

  local note_count = up_notes.Count + down_notes.Count
  local failed = false
  local failed_count = 0
  local hit = false
  local game_clear = true

  self.is_y_button_pressed = false
  self.is_a_button_pressed = false

  if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
    self.is_show_pc_narration = true
    field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
  end

  while note_count > 0 do
    time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    up_button_touch_handler:Update()
    down_button_touch_handler:Update()

    local up_button_pressed = up_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_y_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
    local down_button_pressed = down_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_a_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)

    if up_button_pressed then
      self.is_y_button_pressed = false
      up_button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)
    end

    if down_button_pressed then
      self.is_a_button_pressed = false
      down_button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_touch_on', false)
    end

    -- 파랑 노트
    for i = 0, up_notes.Count - 1 do
      local up_pos = up_button_pos - vector(note_speed * (up_notes[i] - time_passed), 0, 0)
      if up_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (up_note_hits[i] == 0 or up_note_hits[i] == -1) then
        if time_passed >= up_notes[i] + note_disappear_time then
          up_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
          up_note_hits[i] = -2
          note_count = note_count - 1
        elseif time_passed >= up_notes[i] + time_threshold and up_note_hits[i] == 0 then
          failed = true
          failed_count = failed_count + 1
          up_note_hits[i] = -1
        elseif up_button_pressed and unity_class.mathf.Abs(time_passed - up_notes[i]) <= time_threshold then
          up_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
          up_note_hits[i] = 1
          note_count = note_count - 1

          -- 적중
          hit = true

          local vfx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue"):Instantiate(up_button_pos)
          vfx.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
        else
          up_note_objects[i].transform.localPosition = up_pos
        end
      else
        if time_passed <= up_notes[i] and time_passed >= up_notes[i] - note_appear_time then
          if up_note_hits[i] == 0 then
            local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_blue_node'):Instantiate(up_pos)
            stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = up_pos
            stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(125, 125, 125)
            up_note_objects[i] = stage_item_obj
          end
        end
      end
    end

    -- 빨강 노트
    for i = 0, down_notes.Count - 1 do
      local down_pos = down_button_pos - vector(note_speed * (down_notes[i] - time_passed), 0, 0)
      if down_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (down_note_hits[i] == 0 or down_note_hits[i] == -1) then
        if time_passed >= down_notes[i] + note_disappear_time then
          down_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
          down_note_hits[i] = -2
          note_count = note_count - 1
        elseif time_passed >= down_notes[i] + time_threshold and down_note_hits[i] == 0 then
          failed = true
          failed_count = failed_count + 1
          down_note_hits[i] = -1
        elseif down_button_pressed and unity_class.mathf.Abs(time_passed - down_notes[i]) <= time_threshold then
          down_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
          down_note_hits[i] = 1
          note_count = note_count - 1

          -- 적중
          hit = true

          local vfx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_red"):Instantiate(down_button_pos)
          vfx.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
        else
          down_note_objects[i].transform.localPosition = down_pos
        end
      else
        if time_passed <= down_notes[i] and time_passed >= down_notes[i] - note_appear_time then
          if down_note_hits[i] == 0 then
            local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_red_node'):Instantiate(down_pos)
            stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = down_pos
            stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(125, 125, 125)
            down_note_objects[i] = stage_item_obj
          end
        end
      end
    end

    if hit then
      hit = false
      failed = false

      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_hit_02')

      scene_util.normal_shake(target)
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(target, 'down', { name = 'damaged', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' }, 'idle')

      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
      unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position)
    elseif failed then
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')

      -- 5 회 이상 미스나면 실패
      if failed_count >= 5 then
        game_clear = false
        break
      end

      failed = false

      camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
      character.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
      CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(character, 1, unity_class.color.red, character.Position)
    end

    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  up_button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
  down_button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_idle', true)

  -- 리소스 정리
  for i = 0, up_note_objects.Count - 1 do
    if up_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (up_note_hits[i] == 0 or up_note_hits[i] == -1) then
      up_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
    end
  end
  up_note_objects:Clear()
  up_note_hits:Clear()

  for i = 0, down_note_objects.Count - 1 do
    if down_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (down_note_hits[i] == 0 or down_note_hits[i] == -1) then
      down_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
    end
  end
  down_note_objects:Clear()
  down_note_hits:Clear()

  coroutine.yield(nil)

  return game_clear
end

function mini_event:fail_rhythm_qte(character, mushroom)
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        -- 실패 판정시 재생
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
        camera_util.shake(0.1, 99999)

function mini_event:move_item_async(item, p0, p1, p2, speed)
  local t = 0
  while t < 1 do
    local v = vector_util.quadratic_bezier(p0, p1, p2, t)
    item.Position = v

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  item.Position = p2
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') and
      self.current_state == self.states.start then

    self.s4_main_zone_inner = false

      self.current_state == self.states.start then

    local lava_pos = self.lava_slime.Position
    self.fx.lava_pool():Instantiate(lava_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0))

  return false
