function mini_event:start_cook_lava_game()
  -- fo
  local pepper = self.characters.tilemap:get_character('pepper')

  local slime_origin_pos = self.lava_slime.Position

  -- etc
  local qte_pos = vector(0, -200, 0)
  local qte_start_scale = 250
  local qte_end_scale = 25
  local qte_success_scale_max = 130
  local qte_success_scale_min = 60

  local win_count = 5

  local qte_node = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_blue_node'):Instantiate(qte_pos)
  qte_node:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer)).color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 100.0 / 255.0)

  local qte_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(qte_pos)
  CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(qte_button.transform, "FieldUI")
  qte_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)

  local qte_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
  qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
  qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)

  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

  if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
    self:show_gamepad_label()
  end

  local faded_out = false
  while true do
    local game_win = false

    qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
    qte_node.transform.localScale = vector(qte_start_scale, qte_start_scale, qte_start_scale)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'up', 'idle', 'idle')

    if faded_out then
      screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
      character_util.cancel_jump(self.lava_slime)
      character_util.jump_move(self.lava_slime, slime_origin_pos, 4.2, 1, false, 'down')
    end

    -- 페퍼 (up, attack) : (shout 말풍선) 코팅되지 않은 불꽃은 요리를 망칠 뿐!!
    scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'up',
        { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, { name = 'idle' }, 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_4_4')

    -- 시작 카운트
    local start_count = 3
    local title_mod = 2.1
    for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
      CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format('{0}', i), title_mod)

      wait_for_sec(1)
    end

    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 1 })
    music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

    for i = 1, win_count do
      game_win = self:cook_slime_qte(pepper, self.lava_slime,
          qte_node, qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale,
          qte_button, qte_button_touch_handler,
          qte_success_scale_max, qte_success_scale_min,
          i < win_count)

      if not game_win then
        break
      end

      if i < win_count then
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
      end
    end

    -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
    if game_win then
      break
    end

    -- 실패 연출
    music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0)
    camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
    pepper.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
    CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(pepper, 1, unity_class.color.red, pepper.Position)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
    wait_for_sec(1)

    -- 재시작
    faded_out = true
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
    screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
  end

  qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetEmptyAnimation(0, 0)
  coroutine.yield(nil)

  -- 성공 시 리소스 정리
  qte_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
  qte_button_touch_handler = nil

  qte_node:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer)).color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1)
  qte_node:Dispose()
  qte_node = nil

  qte_button:Dispose()
  qte_button = nil

  self:hide_gamepad_label()

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))
end

function mini_event:cook_slime_qte(character, slime,
                                   qte_node, qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale,
                                   qte_button, qte_button_touch_handler,
                                   qte_success_scale_max, qte_success_scale_min,
                                   return_to_hold_anim)

  character_util.jump_move(slime, character.Position + vector(0, 1, 0.1)
  , 3.8, 1, false, 'down')

  self.is_a_button_pressed = false
  local qte_win = false
  local t = 0
  local qte_speed = 1.5

  while t < 1 do
    local v = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(qte_start_scale, qte_end_scale, t)
    qte_node.transform.localScale = vector(v, v, v)

    qte_button_touch_handler:Update()

    if qte_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_a_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Z) then
      self.is_a_button_pressed = false
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(character, 'up', { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'idle' })
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

      -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
      local node_scale = qte_node.transform.localScale.x
      if node_scale <= qte_success_scale_max and node_scale >= qte_success_scale_min then
        qte_win = true
      end

      break
    end

    t = t + unity_class.time.deltaTime * qte_speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  if qte_win then
    -- character
    character_util.stop(slime)
    character_util.cancel_jump(slime)
    character_util.mario_jump_new(slime, 'right', 1.55, 3)
    -- ui
    qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)
    -- fx
    slime.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
    self.fx.hit():Instantiate(slime.Position)
    -- 성공 sfx
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_01')

    wait_all_lua(
        function()
          character_util.set_direction(character, 'up')
          scene_util.set_anim_async(character, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

          if return_to_hold_anim then
            character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(character, 'up', 'hold_loop', 'idle')
          end
        end
    )
  else
    -- 실패
    -- ui
    qte_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_touch_on', false)
    -- fx
    self.fx.hit_fire():Instantiate(character.Position)
    -- sfx
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
    start_coroutine(self.jump_jump, self)
  end

  return qte_win
end

function mini_event:start_wok_tossing_game()
  -- fo
  local pepper = self.characters.tilemap:get_character('pepper')
  local pepper_position = pepper.Position;
  local lava_origin_pos = self.lava_slime.Position

  local left_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(vector(-200, -200, 0))
  CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(left_button.transform, "FieldUI")
  left_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)
  left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
  left_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

  local left_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
  left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
  left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
  left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(5, 5)

  local right_button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(vector(200, -200, 0))
  CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(right_button.transform, "FieldUI")
  right_button.transform.localScale = vector(30, 30, 30)
  right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_idle', true)
  right_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

  local right_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
  right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
  right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
  right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(5, 5)

  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'gamepad_connected')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'gamepad_disconnected')

  if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
    self:show_gamepad_label()
  end

  local faded_out = false
  while true do
    local game_win = true

    -- 페퍼 위치 리셋
    pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
    self.lava_slime.Position = lava_origin_pos
    self.lava_slime.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)

    character_util.set_position(pepper, pepper_position)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'idle')
    if faded_out then
      screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
      character_util.cancel_jump(self.lava_slime)
    end

    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_car_crash', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 1 })
    music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    -- 페퍼 (down, attack) : (shout 말풍선) 불꽃에 공기를 주입해 산소 공급량을 통제한다! 튕기고! 돌리고! 웍헤이!!
    scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pepper, self, 'down',
        { name = 'hold_loop', keep = true }, 'idle', 'bs_pepper_main_sec2_4_5')

    left_button.gameObject:SetActive(true)
    right_button.gameObject:SetActive(true)

    local gauge_value = 0.5
    self.gauge_ui_component:SetProgress(gauge_value)
    self.gauge_ui_obj:SetActive(true)

    wait_for_sec(1)
    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'hold_loop', loop = true }, 'attack')

    local direction = math.random(0, 1) * 2 - 1
    local velocity = 0
    local acceleration = 0.2 * direction
    local push_power = 0.3

    local elapsed_time = 0
    local acting_time = 20

    local interact_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
      sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true, volume = 0,
      type_priority = 'event',
    })

    field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')

    while elapsed_time < acting_time do
      local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

      left_button_touch_handler:Update()
      right_button_touch_handler:Update()

      local is_pressed = false
      if left_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_x_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A) then
        self.is_x_button_pressed = false
        is_pressed = true

        -- 왼쪽 버튼 클릭
        left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)

        if acceleration > 0 then
          acceleration = -unity_class.random.Range(0, 0.2)
        end

        acceleration = acceleration + -push_power * dt
      elseif right_button_touch_handler.Pressed or self.is_b_button_pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D) then
        self.is_b_button_pressed = false
        is_pressed = true

        -- 오른쪽 버튼 클릭
        right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'blue_touch_on', false)

        if acceleration < 0 then
          acceleration = unity_class.random.Range(0, 0.2)
        end

        acceleration = acceleration + push_power * dt
      else
        is_pressed = false
      end

      -- sfx
      if is_pressed then
        music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(interact_sfx, 1, 0)
      else
        music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(interact_sfx, 0, 0)
      end

      velocity = velocity + acceleration * dt
      gauge_value = math.min(math.max(gauge_value + velocity * dt, 0), 1)

      local rotation_value = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(90, -90, gauge_value)
      pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, rotation_value)
      local head_pos = pepper.transform:TransformPoint(vector(0, 1, 0));
      self.lava_slime.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, rotation_value)
      self.lava_slime.Position = head_pos
      self.gauge_ui_component:SetProgress(gauge_value)

      -- 성공 범위를 넘어간 경우 실패
      if gauge_value < 0.4 or gauge_value > 0.6 then
        game_win = false
        break
      end

      elapsed_time = elapsed_time + dt
      coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    interact_sfx:Stop()

    left_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)
    right_button.gameObject:SetActive(false)

    self.gauge_ui_obj:SetActive(false)

    -- 게임 승리 조건 검사
    if game_win then
      break
    end

    -- 실패 연출
    do
      music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0)
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

      camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
      self:jump_jump()
    end

    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    -- 재시작
    faded_out = true
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
    screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
  end

  -- 페퍼 애니메이션 초기화
  pepper.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
  self.lava_slime.Position = lava_origin_pos
  self.lava_slime.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(pepper, 'down', 'idle', 'idle')

  -- 성공 시 UI 정리
  left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
  left_button_touch_handler = nil

  left_button:Dispose()
  left_button = nil

  right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
  right_button_touch_handler = nil

  right_button:Dispose()
  right_button = nil

  CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.gauge_ui_obj)
  self.gauge_ui_obj = nil
  self.gauge_ui_component = nil

  self:hide_gamepad_label()

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))
end

function mini_event:jump_jump()
  character_util.mario_jump_new(self.lava_slime, 'right', 1, 1)
  wait_for_sec(1)
  character_util.mario_jump_new(self.lava_slime, 'right', 1, 1)
end

return {
  create = function()
    return mini_event
  end
}

  }

  self.dynamic_npc = metatable_helper.inherit(
      {
        container = nil,
        specs = {
          mom = 'shortstory_br23_civilian_female',
          boy = 'shortstory_br23_kid_boy',
          old_male_1 = 'shortstory_br23_desertelf_male',
          old_male_2 = 'shortstory_br23_desertelf_male',
          old_female = 'shortstory_br23_desertelf_female',

          civilian_female = 'shortstory_br23_civilian_female',
        }
      }, {

          if this.container ~= nil then
            return
          end

          this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async('main_s1_', this.specs)
        end,

        dispose = function(this)
          if this.container == nil then
            return
          end

          load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

          this.container = nil
        end,

        get = function(this, name)
          return this.container[name]
        end
  })

    return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
  end

    reset_NPC = function(npc)
      character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
      character_util.set_position(npc, self.INIT_POS)
      character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
      npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
    end

    if type(npcs) == "table" then
      for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
        reset_NPC(npc)
      end
    else
      reset_NPC(npcs)
    end
  end

  self.typing_text = nil

  self.dynamic_npc:load_async()

  --이거 안하면 페이드인 안됨? 왜지
  screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

  local old_male2 = self.dynamic_npc:get('old_male_2')

  local civilian_male2 = self.dynamic_npc:get('civilian_male_2')

  character_util.set_position(civilian_boy, group_a_pos+ vector(0.5,0,0))

  character_util.set_position(old_female1, group_b_pos + vector(0.5,0,-0.5))
  character_util.set_direction(old_female1, 'left', false)
  character_util.set_position(old_male2, group_b_pos + vector(-0.5,0,-0.5))
  character_util.set_direction(old_male2, 'right', false)

  character_util.set_direction(civilian_male1, 'down', false)
  character_util.set_position(civilian_female, group_c_pos + vector(1,0,-0.5))
  character_util.set_direction(civilian_female, 'left', false)
  character_util.set_position(civilian_male2, group_c_pos + vector(-1,0,-0.5))
  character_util.set_direction(civilian_male2, 'right', false)

  self:play_typing_text('bs_seira_main_sec1_0_1')

  screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, interpolations_constants.linear)

  camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6, 0)

  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx('crowd_buzz_03', {

  wait_for_sec(4)

  scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'sleep_deep')
  scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

  --세이라 shake(0.03) 1초

  wait_for_sec(1)

  --티탄피난민(left, tired, idle) : 세이라, 이제 그만해. 안테나가 부러져서 수신조차 안 되잖아.

  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_female, self, 'left',
      'cross_arm', 'attack', 'bs_seira_main_sec1_13')

  --어른_남8(right, tired, question) : 내 아이가 다치지 않게 꽁꽁 숨겨야….

function local_class:play_typing_text(text)
  local text_fade_in_duration = 1
  local text_fade_out_duration = 1
  local text_maintain_duration = 3
  local text_exposure_duration = text_fade_in_duration + text_maintain_duration + text_fade_out_duration
  local text_width = 1500
  local text_speed = 0

  --아래 text_out이 들어가고 중간에 text가 사라지게 되어서 start_coroutine_enumerator로 변경 후 대기시간동안 기다려준다.
  wait_all({
    --typing_text setting
    self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
        text,
        text_width,
        text_speed,
        text_exposure_duration,
        true,
        false
    ),
    util.cs_generator(function()
      --fade in 대기
      self:fade_typing_text_in(self.typing_text, text_fade_in_duration)

      --노출 시간 대기
      wait_for_sec(text_maintain_duration)

      --fade out 대기
      self:fade_typing_text_out(self.typing_text, text_fade_out_duration)
    end)
  })
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 인
function local_class:fade_typing_text_in(typing_text, duration)
  self:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 1, duration)
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 아웃
function local_class:fade_typing_text_out(typing_text, duration)
  self:fade_typing_text(typing_text, 0, duration)
end

-- 나레이션 대사 페이드 함수
function local_class:fade_typing_text(typing_text, target_alpha, duration)
  local start_alpha = typing_text.Label.alpha
  local end_alpha = target_alpha

  coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_alpha, end_alpha, function(_, cur_value)
    typing_text.Label.alpha = cur_value
  end)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_3_start_oneline_zone') and
      not self.play_s2_3_main_oneline then
    self.play_s2_3_main_oneline = true
    start_coroutine(self.on_s2_3_start_main_oneline, self)
    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.invader_zone_name) then
    if self.current_attack_event_state == self.invader_attack_states.ready then
      start_coroutine(self.invader_attack_event, self)
    elseif self.current_attack_event_state == self.invader_attack_states.done then
      start_coroutine(self.invader_attack_done_event, self)
    end
    return true
  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.invader_zone_name_2) then
    if self.current_attack_event_state == self.invader_attack_states.done then
      start_coroutine(self.invader_attack_done_event, self)
    end
    return true
  end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
  -- 폭탄이 터진 경우
  if lua_helper.type_compare(e.FieldObject.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.BombFieldObjectBehaviour) then
    local invader_soldier_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_1')
    if invader_soldier_1 and (invader_soldier_1.Position - e.FieldObject.Position).magnitude < 3 then
      if self.current_attack_event_state == self.invader_attack_states.attacked then
        start_coroutine(self.defeat_invader_event, self)
      end
    end
  end
end

function local_class:load_mini_event_state()
  local cur_mini_event_state_pack = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_events_save_state_key)

  -- 0 미만이면 등록된게 없으므로 return
  if cur_mini_event_state_pack < 0 then
    return
  end

  for i = 1, #self.mini_event_save_state do
    local is_clear = ((cur_mini_event_state_pack >> (i - 1)) & 0x1)
    self.mini_event_save_state[i] = is_clear
  end
end

-- 현재 퀘스트 스테이트들을 합친 값 구하기
function local_class:get_pack_state_value()
  local data = 0
  local state = self.mini_event_save_state

  for i = 1, #state do
    local value = i > 1 and ((state[i] << (i - 1)) & (0x1 << (i - 1))) or (state[i] & 0x1)
    data = data | value
  end

  return data
end

function local_class:save_mini_event_cleared_state(mini_event_id)
  -- 이벤트 아이디에 해당하는 퀘스트를 1로
  self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] = 1
  self:set_oneline(mini_event_id)

  -- 미니이벤트 플래그 합친 값으로 저장
  quest_util.set_custom_state(self.cs_controller.QuestProgress, self.mini_events_save_state_key,
      self:get_pack_state_value())

  -- 다음 섹션 진행
  if self:get_pack_state_value() >= 7 then
    start_coroutine(self.end_event, self)
  end
end

  return self.mini_event_save_state[mini_event_id] > 0

  do
    --어른여성22(left, scared, walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후, (left, scared, idle)
    --어른남성23(left, scared, walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후. (left, scared, idle)

    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_female, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_female, self, 'walk')
    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_male, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_male, self, 'walk')

    wp_util.move(civilian_female, civilian_female.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
    wp_util.move_async(civilian_male, civilian_male.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 2, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_female, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_female, self, 'idle')
    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_male, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_male, self, 'idle')
  end

  --동시연출

  --어른여성22 shake(0.03) 유지
  scene_util.shake(civilian_female, 0.03, 999, false)
  --어른남성23 shake(0.03) 유지
  scene_util.shake(civilian_male, 0.03, 999, false)

  --어른여성22(left, scared, idle) : 히, 히익!!!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_female, self, 'left',
      nil, { 'scared', keep = true }, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_1_1_1')

  --어른남성23(left, scared, idle) : 사, 살려주세요!!!
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('dialogue_sadness_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_male, self, 'left',
      nil, { 'scared', keep = true }, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_1_1_2')

  --동시연출
  do
    --어른여성22(left, scared, walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후, (left, scared, idle)
    --어른남성23(left, scared, walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후. (left, scared, idle)

    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_female, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_female, self, 'walk')
    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_male, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_male, self, 'walk')

    wp_util.move(civilian_female, civilian_female.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
    wp_util.move_async(civilian_male, civilian_male.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_female, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_female, self, 'idle')
    scene_util.set_emotion(civilian_male, self, 'scared')
    scene_util.set_anim(civilian_male, self, 'idle')
  end

  --1초 대기
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  self.current_attack_event_state = self.invader_attack_states.attacked

  if self.current_attack_event_state >= self.invader_attack_states.defeat then
    return
  end

  --동시연출
  do
    --인베이더1(right, doyagao, sword_walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후 (right, doyagao, idle)
    --인베이더2(right, doyagao, sword_walk) 속도1로 우측으로 1타일 이동 후 (right, doyagao, idle)
    scene_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_1, self, 'sword_run')
    scene_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_2, self, 'sword_run')

    wp_util.move(invader_soldier_1, invader_soldier_1.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
    wp_util.move_async(invader_soldier_2, invader_soldier_2.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
    scene_util.set_emotion(invader_soldier_2, self, 'doyagao')
    scene_util.set_emotion(invader_soldier_1, self, 'doyagao')
    scene_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_2, self, 'sword_idle')
    scene_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_1, self, 'sword_idle')
  end


end

function local_class:defeat_invader_event()
  self.current_attack_event_state = self.invader_attack_states.defeat

  local invader_soldier_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_1')
  local invader_soldier_2 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_2')

  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('die_villain_01')
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        local target_pos = invader_soldier_1.Position + vector(-15, 10, 20)
        character_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_1, { name = 'damaged' })
        character_util.spine_rotate(invader_soldier_1, 540, 3)
        coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(3.5, invader_soldier_1.Position, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
          invader_soldier_1.Position = cur_value
        end)
        invader_soldier_1.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
      end,
      function()
        local target_pos = invader_soldier_2.Position + vector(-50, 5, -10)
        character_util.set_anim(invader_soldier_2, { name = 'damaged' })
        character_util.spine_rotate(invader_soldier_2, 540, 3)
        coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(3, invader_soldier_2.Position, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
          invader_soldier_2.Position = cur_value
        end)
        invader_soldier_2.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
      end
  )

  self.current_attack_event_state = self.invader_attack_states.defeat_end
end

local is_invader_attack_done_event = false
function local_class:invader_attack_done_event()
  if is_invader_attack_done_event then
    return
  end

  is_invader_attack_done_event = true
  local civilian_male = self.dynamic_npc:get('civilian_male_attacked')
  local civilian_female = self.dynamic_npc:get('civilian_female_attacked')

  --어른남성21(right, sleep_deep, idle) : 아직 희망이 있었어….
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_male, self, 'right',
      'idle', { 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_1_1_3')
  --어른여성22(left, smile, cast) : 사, 살았어!
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('dialogue_positive_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(civilian_female, self, 'left',
      { 'cast', keep = true }, { 'smile', keep = true }, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_1_1_4')

  is_invader_attack_done_event = false
end

local local_class = newclass('BridgeStorySeiraMainSection3')

--region 섹션
function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
  ---@type BridgeStorySeiraMainController
  self.controller = controller

  ---@type LuaQuestEventController
  self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

  ---@type LuaQuestEventSection
  self.cs_section = cs_section

  -- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
  --self.available_stage_names = {}

  -- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
  self.states = {
    none = 1,
    start = 2,
    done = 3
  }

  self.current_state = self.states.none

  self.marker = {
    start_pos = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_start_pos')
    end
  }

  -- Character Setting
  local dynamic_npc_helper = {
    container = nil,
    group_name = nil,
    specs = nil,

    get = function(this, name)
      return this.container[name]
    end,

    get_character = function(this, name)
      return get_character(this.specs[name])
    end,

    load_async = function(this)
      if this.container == nil then
        this.container = {}
      end

      this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(this.group_name, this.specs)

      return this.container
    end,

    dispose = function(this)
      if this.container == nil then
        return
      end

      load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

      this.container = nil
    end,
  }

  self.characters = metatable_helper.inherit({
    tilemap = metatable_helper.inherit({
      group_name = 's3_npc_',
      specs = {
        seira = 'seira',
        mom = 'civilian_female',
        dad = 'civilian_male',
        daughter = 'kid_girl',
        old_soldier = 'teatan_old_soldier',
        kael = 'kael',
        kid_boy = 'kid_boy',
        archives = 'archives'
      },
    }, dynamic_npc_helper),
    dynamic = metatable_helper.inherit({
      group_name = 's3_monster_',
      specs = {
        before_seira = 'shortstory_br23_bridge_messenger2',
        invader_1 = 'shortstory_br23_fat_invader_guard',
        invader_2 = 'shortstory_br23_fat_invader_guard',
        invader_3 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
        invader_4 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
        invader_5 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
        invader_6 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_assassin',
        invader_7 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_archer',
        invader_8 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_assassin'
      },
    }, dynamic_npc_helper),
  }, {
    dispose = function(this)
      for key, value in pairs(this) do
        value:dispose()
      end
    end,
  })

  self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
    object_twinkle = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
    end,
    dead = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
    end,
    red_twinkle = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
    end
  })

  --operator_ui
  self.operator_ui = nil
end

    mini_game_util.load_resource_async(self.mini_game_name, 'bridge_story_seira')

    sp_util.enter_scene()
    self:intro_scene()
    sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

    mini_game_util.game_start(self.mini_game_name)
  end)

function local_class:exit()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
  mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.mini_game_name)

  self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

  self:dispose_rain_effect()

  if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
    for i = 1, #self.twinkle_effect do
      self.twinkle_effect[i]:Dispose()
    end
    self.twinkle_effect = nil
  end

  if self.transmitter_pilar ~= nil then
    self.transmitter_pilar:Dispose()
    self.transmitter_pilar = nil
  end

  if self.resholder ~= nil then
    self.resholder:Dispose()
    self.resholder = nil
  end
end

  self.controller = nil
  self.cs_controller = nil
  self.cs_section = nil
end

  return false

function local_class:qte_progress(count)
  local tap_count = 0
  local event_listener = {}

  -- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
  event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
    if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

      -- 터치 연출
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
      camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)

      tap_count = tap_count + 1

      return true
    end

    return false
  end

  event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
    message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

    return true
  end

  message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
  message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

  field_util.darken('qte_darken', 0.5, 0.1)
  message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

  while tap_count < count do
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  field_util.undarken('qte_darken')
  message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

  message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_complete_01')
end

function local_class:start_qte_ui()
  local event_listener = {}

  -- TouchEvent EventListener 생성
  event_listener.on_touch_event = function(_, e)
    if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

      -- 터치 연출
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

    end

    return false
  end

  event_listener.on_stage_end_event = function(_, _)
    message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

    return true
  end

  message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
  message_system:SubscribeOnce(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

  qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap(true, vector(0, 0), 0.85, false)

end

function local_class:end_qte_ui(event_listener)
  message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

  screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:repair_transmitter(transmitter, transmitter_turn)
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
  self.transmitter_repair_count = math.min(self.transmitter_repair_count + 1, self.transmitter_repair_count_max)
  local t = self.transmitter_repair_count / self.transmitter_repair_count_max

  local rotation_speed = 2
  local current_rotation = transmitter_turn.localEulerAngles
  local target_rotation = vector_util.lerp(vector(0, 0, 0), vector(0, 135, 0), t)

  local time = 0
  while time < 1 do
    transmitter_turn.localEulerAngles = vector_util.lerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, time)

    time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime * rotation_speed
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  transmitter_turn.localEulerAngles = target_rotation
  field_object_util.shake(transmitter, 0.1, 0.3)
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, cs_section)
  ---@type BridgeStorySeiraMainController
  self.controller = controller

  ---@type LuaQuestEventController
  self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

  ---@type LuaQuestEventSection
  self.cs_section = cs_section

  -- 스테이지 제약이 있는 경우 주석 해제하고 스테이지명 입력. string과 string 테이블 둘 다 사용 가능
  --self.available_stage_names = {}

  self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

  self.rain_screen_effect = nil
  self.rain_ground_effect = nil
  self.rain_sfx = nil

  self.marker = {
    start_pos = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_start_pos')
    end,

    surround_pos_1 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_1')
    end,

    surround_pos_2 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_2')
    end,

    surround_pos_3 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_3')
    end,

    surround_pos_4 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_4')
    end,

    surround_pos_5 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_5')
    end,

    surround_pos_6 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_6')
    end,

    surround_pos_7 = function()
      return field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_surround_pos_7')
    end,
  }

  self.dynamic_npc = metatable_helper.inherit(
      {
        container = nil,
        specs = {
          teatan_male = 'shortstory_br23_teatan_male',
          teatan_female = 'shortstory_br23_teatan_female',
          soldier_oldman = 'shortstory_br23_soldier_oldman',
          desert_elf_male = 'shortstory_br23_desertelf_male',
          desert_elf_female = 'shortstory_br23_desertelf_female',
          civilian_male = 'shortstory_br23_civilian_male',
          civilian_female = 'shortstory_br23_civilian_female',
          kid_girl = 'shortstory_br23_kid_girl',
          archives = 'shortstory_br23_archives',
          invader_soldier_1 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_2 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_3 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_4 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_5 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_6 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
          invader_soldier_7 = 'shortstory_br23_invader_soldier',
        }
      }, {
        load_async = function(this)
          if this.container ~= nil then
            return
          end

          this.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async('main_s5_', this.specs)
        end,

        dispose = function(this)
          if this.container == nil then
            return
          end

          load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(this.container)

          this.container = nil
        end,

        get = function(this, name)
          return this.container[name]
        end
      })

  self.kanterbury_castle_pos = vector(189.5, 0, 246.05)
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:on_pre_load()
  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      self.resholder, 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/theatres', 'bg_sealedkingdom_dark', function(prefab)
        local bg = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
        local bg_transform = bg.transform
        bg_transform.localPosition = self.kanterbury_castle_pos
      end)
end

--- 해당 기능을 사용하지 않으면 지워도 무관함
function local_class:need_skip()
  return false
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
  sp_util.start_scene(self.ambushed_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
  self:dispose_ambushed_scene()
  self.dynamic_npc:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
  self.controller = nil
  self.cs_controller = nil
  self.cs_section = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
  return false
end

function local_class:ambushed_scene()
  local leader = get_party_leader()

  -- 2 초간 페이드 아웃
  screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
  screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black)

  self.dynamic_npc:load_async()

  local archives = self.dynamic_npc:get('archives')
  local soldier_oldman = self.dynamic_npc:get('soldier_oldman')
  local teatan_male = self.dynamic_npc:get('teatan_male')
  local teatan_female = self.dynamic_npc:get('teatan_female')
  local civilian_male = self.dynamic_npc:get('civilian_male')
  local civilian_female = self.dynamic_npc:get('civilian_female')
  local kid_girl = self.dynamic_npc:get('kid_girl')
  local desert_elf_male = self.dynamic_npc:get('desert_elf_male')
  local desert_elf_female = self.dynamic_npc:get('desert_elf_female')

  -- 모여있는 배치
  local start_pos = self.marker.start_pos()
  local character_group = {}
  camera_util.set_position(start_pos, true)
  self:init_character(leader, start_pos, character_group)
  self:init_character(kid_girl, start_pos + vector(1, 0, -2.5), character_group)
  self:init_character(archives, start_pos + vector(-1, 0, -2), character_group)
  self:init_character(soldier_oldman, start_pos + vector(1, 0, -2), character_group)
  self:init_character(teatan_male, start_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -3), character_group)
  self:init_character(teatan_female, start_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -3), character_group)
  self:init_character(civilian_male, start_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -3), character_group)
  self:init_character(civilian_female, start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -3), character_group)
  self:init_character(desert_elf_male, start_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -4), character_group)
  self:init_character(desert_elf_female, start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -4), character_group)

  -- 폭우 이펙트, 사운드
  self:create_rain_effect()

  -- 2 초간 페이드 인 하면서
  screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
  screen_util.fade_in(2, unity_class.color.black)

  -- 모두 앞으로 이동
  do
    local leader_duration = 4
    local leader_move_delta = vector(0, 0, 4)

    character_util.remove_anim(character_group[1])
    wp_util.move(character_group[1], character_group[1].Position + leader_move_delta, nil, leader_duration)
    camera_util.move(character_group[1].Position + leader_move_delta, leader_duration, { ignorecameragrids = true })

    local duration = 5
    local move_delta = vector(0, 0, 5)

    for i = 2, #character_group do
      character_util.remove_anim(character_group[i])
      wp_util.move(character_group[i], character_group[i].Position + move_delta, nil, duration)
    end

    wait_for_sec(duration + 1)
  end

  -- 세이라 : 다왔어요. 이제 조금만 가면…
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'up',
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec5_1')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 위쪽 전경을 비추고 내려온다
  do
    local duration = 3
    camera_util.move_async(self.kanterbury_castle_pos, duration)

    wait_for_sec(2)

    camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, duration, { ignorecameragrids = true })
  end

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 표지광 모듈이 점멸
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        wait_for_sec(1)

        yield_return_func(self.blink_object, self, self.controller.seira_point_light.gameObject, 0.1)

        wait_for_sec(0.2)

        yield_return_func(self.blink_object, self, self.controller.seira_point_light.gameObject, 0.1)

        wait_for_sec(0.4)

        yield_return_func(self.blink_object, self, self.controller.seira_point_light.gameObject, 0.1)

        wait_for_sec(0.5)

        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_operator_light_01')
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_06')

        self.controller.seira_point_light.gameObject:SetActive(false)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(3)

        -- 세이라 느낌표 말풍선
        character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'notice')
      end
  )

  -- 세이라 (up, surprised, idle) : 어...?
  scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.3)
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'up',
      nil, 'surprised', 'bs_seira_main_sec5_2')

  -- 세이라 (up, tired, sit) : 안 돼... 제발, 지금 꺼지면 안 돼...!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'up',
      'seat', 'tired', 'bs_seira_main_sec5_3')

  -- 세이라 (up, attack) : (기계를 거칠게 흔들며) 이 능선만 넘으면... 숨겨진 은신처란 말이야...!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'up',
      'attack', nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec5_4')

  -- 기록관이 한칸 앞으로 이동
  character_util.remove_anim(archives)
  wp_util.move_async(archives, archives.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 0.5)

  -- 기록관 (right, scared) : 빛이 나갔어! 이 어둠 속에서 길을 어떻게 찾는단 말인가!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archives, self, 'right',
      nil, { name = 'scared', keep = true }, 'bs_seira_main_sec5_5')

  -- 숲의 어둠 속에서 인베이더 정찰병들의 붉은 안광이 수십 개 번쩍인다.

  -- SFX 기괴한 기계음과 철컥거리는 무기 장전 소리

  -- 인베이더 생성
  local invaders = {}
  do
    local pos_offset = vector(0, 0, -3)
    local move_duration = 3

    local ch_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_1');
    local pos_1 = self.marker.surround_pos_1()
    self:init_character(ch_1, pos_1 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_1)
    wp_util.move(ch_1, pos_1, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_2 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_2');
    local pos_2 = self.marker.surround_pos_2()
    self:init_character(ch_2, pos_2 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_2)
    wp_util.move(ch_2, pos_2, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_3 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_3');
    local pos_3 = self.marker.surround_pos_3()
    self:init_character(ch_3, pos_3 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_3)
    wp_util.move(ch_3, pos_3, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_4 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_4');
    local pos_4 = self.marker.surround_pos_4()
    self:init_character(ch_4, pos_4 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_4)
    wp_util.move(ch_4, pos_4, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_5 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_5');
    local pos_5 = self.marker.surround_pos_5()
    self:init_character(ch_5, pos_5 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_5)
    wp_util.move(ch_5, pos_5, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_6 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_6');
    local pos_6 = self.marker.surround_pos_6()
    self:init_character(ch_6, pos_6 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_6)
    wp_util.move(ch_6, pos_6, nil, move_duration)

    local ch_7 = self.dynamic_npc:get('invader_soldier_7');
    local pos_7 = self.marker.surround_pos_7()
    self:init_character(ch_7, pos_7 + pos_offset, invaders)
    character_util.remove_anim(ch_7)
    wp_util.move(ch_7, pos_7, nil, move_duration)

    -- 인베이더들 검게 처리
    for i = 1, #invaders do
      local ch = invaders[i]
      character_util.add_color(ch, ch.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
    end
  end

  -- 아래에 몰려온 인베이더를 보여준다
  do
    local duration = 3
    camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, duration)
    camera_util.move_async(character_group[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -4), duration, { ignorecameragrids = true })
  end

  -- 카메라 쉐이킹 강도: 0.1 시간: 0.3 초
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
  camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 티탄 난민이 인베이더들을 바라본다
  character_util.set_direction(teatan_male, 'down')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 티탄 피난민 (down, damaged, embarrassed) : 놈들이 우릴 쫓아왔어... 이제 도망칠 곳도 없는데...!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(teatan_male, self, 'down',
      'embarrassed', { name = 'damaged' }, 'bs_seira_main_sec5_6')

  -- 세이라가 몰려온 인베이더를 바라본다
  character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 세이라 (down, cry) :  ...죄송해요, 선배님.
  self.controller.sfx:play_stage_music({ state = 'field' }, 'bgm_run')
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx( 'rain_loop_01', {loop = true, volume = 0.3, fade_out_time = 1, type_priority = "default"})
  scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.3)
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
      nil, { name = 'sleep_deep', keep = true }, { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec5_7', bubble_direction = 'rb', skip = true })

  -- 세이라 (down, cry) : 결국 제 손에서... 사람들을 이끌 마지막 불빛이 꺼졌어요.
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
      nil, nil, { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec5_8', bubble_direction = 'rb', skip = true })

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 인베이더들이 다가온다
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[1])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[1], invaders[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[2])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[2], invaders[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[3])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[3], invaders[3].Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[4])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[4], invaders[4].Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[5])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[5], invaders[5].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[6])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[6], invaders[6].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 2)
      end,
      function()
        character_util.remove_anim(invaders[7])
        wp_util.move_async(invaders[7], invaders[7].Position + vector(0, 0, 3), 2)
      end)

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 절망적인 정적 속에서, 어린 딸이 세이라의 옷자락을 꽉 쥔다.
  local kid_girl_destination = leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
  character_util.remove_anim(kid_girl)
  wp_util.move_async(kid_girl,
      {
        vector(kid_girl_destination.x, 0, kid_girl.Position.z),
        kid_girl_destination
      }, nil, 1,
      { last_direction = 'left', })

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 어린 딸 : 언니, 안 끝났어. 우리가 있잖아.
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)
        character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_girl, true)
      end,
      function()
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(kid_girl, self, 'left',
            nil, nil, { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec5_9', bubble_direction = 'rb', skip = true })
      end
  )

  -- 세이라 쉐이크 하며 idle 로 복귀
  scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.3)
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 늙은 병사 : ...꼬마 말이 맞다. 통신병, 고개 들어라.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldier_oldman, self, 'up',
      nil, nil, { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec5_10', bubble_direction = 'rb', skip = true })

  -- 늙은 병사가 인베이더들을 바라본다
  character_util.set_direction(soldier_oldman, 'down')

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 늙은 병사, ACT 2에서 챙겼던 '부러진 근위대의 검'을 빼 든다
  character_util.spine_set_attachment(soldier_oldman, '[base]weapon1', 'broken_sword')
  soldier_oldman.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
  soldier_oldman.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'sword_walk'

  -- 늙은 병사 (left, idle) : 쥐새끼처럼 등 뒤를 내주고 죽는 건... 예전에 버린 내 부하들만으로 족하다.
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldier_oldman, self, 'down',
            nil, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec5_11', bubble_direction = 'rb', skip = true })
      end,
      function()
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
        scene_util.set_anim_async(soldier_oldman, self, { name = 'sword_attack', count = 1 })
        scene_util.set_anim(soldier_oldman, self, { name = 'sword_idle', loop = true })
      end
  )

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 늙은 병사가 피난민 무리의 선두에 서며
  do
    local wp1 = soldier_oldman.Position + vector(0, 0, -3)
    local wp2 = wp1 + vector(-1, 0, 0)
    character_util.remove_anim(soldier_oldman)
    wp_util.move_async(soldier_oldman,
        {
          wp1,
          wp2,
        }, -1, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
  end

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  -- 늙은 병사 (left, release) : 켄터베리의 백성들아, 도망치는 건 여기까지다! 놈들에게 우리 끝을 순순히 내주지 마라!
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
        scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldier_oldman, self, 'down',
            { name = 'release' }, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec5_12')
      end,
      function()
        -- release 애니에서 대기
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        character_util.set_anim_time_scale(soldier_oldman, 0)
      end
  )

  character_util.set_anim_time_scale(soldier_oldman, 1)

  -- 피난민 무리가 주변을 두리번 거린다
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        character_util.remove_emotion(archives)
        scene_util.look_around(archives, { 'left', 'right' }, '')
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        scene_util.look_around(civilian_male, { 'right', 'left' }, '', 0.5)
      end,
      function()
        scene_util.look_around(civilian_female, { 'right', 'left' }, '', 0.5)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        scene_util.look_around(teatan_male, { 'left', 'right' }, '', 0.5)
      end,
      function()
        scene_util.look_around(teatan_female, { 'right', 'left', 'right' }, '', 0.5)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        scene_util.look_around(desert_elf_male, { 'right', 'left' }, '', 0.5)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.2)
        scene_util.look_around(desert_elf_female, { 'left', 'right' }, '', 0.5)
      end
  )

  -- 피난민 무리가 무기를 줍는 애니메이션 (세이라와 어린딸은 제외)
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx('equipping_01', { loop = true, type_priority = 'event'})
  for i = 3, #character_group do
    character_util.set_anim(character_group[i], { name = 'eat', loop = true })
  end

  wait_for_sec(1)

  -- 일제히 무기를 주워든다 (세이라와 어린딸은 제외)
  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        self:equip_weapon(archives, 9090124)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.3)
        self:equip_weapon(teatan_male, 9019034)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.2)
        self:equip_weapon(teatan_female, 9091884)
      end,
      function()
        self:equip_weapon(civilian_male, 9019034)
      end,
      function()
        wait_for_sec(0.3)
        self:equip_weapon(civilian_female, 9093024)
      end,
      function()
        self:equip_weapon(desert_elf_male, 9093024)
      end,

local controller = newclass('Main2MiniEventController')

function controller:init(quest_controller)
	self.quest_controller = quest_controller

	local file_path_prefix = 'Quest/BridgeStory/Seira/Main/Main2MiniEvents/'

	-- 병렬 이벤트 처리 파일들
	local script_file_names = {
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent1.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent2.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'MiniEvent3.lua',
	}

	self.event_scripts = self:load_scripts(script_file_names)
end

function controller:load_scripts(file_names)
	local scripts = {}

	for i = 1, #file_names do
		local script = get_or_create_global_table(file_names[i])
		if script ~= nil then
			table.insert(scripts, script(self))
		end
	end

	return scripts
end

function controller:enter()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		local is_event_cleared = self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_scripts[i].event_flag)

		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'enter', self.event_scripts[i])
		end
	end
end

function controller:start()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'start', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:exit()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'exit', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

	self.quest_controller = nil
end

function controller:dispose()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'dispose', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:on_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		local is_event_cleared = self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i)

		if not is_event_cleared then
			lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'on_event', self.event_scripts[i], e)
		end
	end
end

--region NPC 셋팅

function controller:set_npc()

end

--endregion

function controller:is_every_events_cleared()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function controller:get_uncleared_events()
	local event_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(i) then
			table.insert(event_list, self.event_scripts[i])
		end
	end

	return event_list
end

return {
	create = function()
		return controller
	end
}

local mini_event = newclass('MiniEvent1')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)
  self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1
  self.event_controller = event_controller
  ---@type LuaQuestEventController
  self.quest_controller = event_controller.quest_controller

  self.character = self.quest_controller.character
  self.controller = self.quest_controller.controller

  --이벤트 플래그. 미니이벤트 n은 1 << n
  self.event_flag = 1

  -- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
  self.states = {
    none = 1,
    meet_old_soldier = 2,
    done = 3
  }

  self.quest_constants_key = 'old_soldier_quest'
  self.quest_marker = {
    meet_solider = 'meet_old_soldier',
    dig_pile_ = function(number)
      return 'dig_pile_' .. number
    end,
    give_sword = 'give_sword'
  }


  --region Zone
  self.old_soldier_zone_name = 's2_1_old_soldier'
  self.is_old_soldier_zone_In_check = true

  --endregion

  self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
    dig = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
    end,
  })

  self.quest_doors = {
    name = {'section2_door_after_event_1','section2_door_after_event_2'},
    open = function(this)
      message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name[1], false))
      message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(this.name[2], false))
    end,
  }

  self.current_state = self.states.none

  self.pile_of_dirt_cnt = 3
  self.get_pile_of_dirt = function(number)
    return get_field_object('s2_pile_of_dirt_' .. number)
  end

  self.old_sword_item_id = 23006
  self.old_sword_item_name = 'bs_bridege21_sword'
end

local function create_none_data()
  return {
    type = 'none',
    name = nil,
  }
end

function mini_event:enter()
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

  start_coroutine(function()
    --self.fx:load_async()
    self:setting_on_enter()
  end)
end

function mini_event:setting_on_enter()

  local old_soldier = self.character.old_soldier
  local old_soldier_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_1_old_soldier')

  character_util.set_position(old_soldier, old_soldier_pos + vector(0,0,-0.5))
  character_util.set_direction(old_soldier, 'right', false)
  scene_util.set_emotion(old_soldier, self, 'tired')
  scene_util.set_anim(old_soldier, self, 'idle')

  old_soldier.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function mini_event:start()
  if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
    -- Quest Marker Setting
    quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_constants_key, {
      { zone = 'main_field', target = self.character.old_soldier},
      { zone = 's2_2_quest_field', create_none_data() },
    }, self.quest_marker.meet_solider)
  else
    self.quest_doors:open()
  end
end

function mini_event:exit()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

  self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:dispose()
end

--region Event
function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character.old_soldier) then
    if self.current_state == self.states.none then
      sp_util.start_scene(self.meet_old_soldier_event, self)
    elseif self.current_state == self.states.meet_old_soldier then
      sp_util.start_scene(self.give_sword_event, self)
    end
    return true
  else
    for i = 1, self.pile_of_dirt_cnt do
      local pile = self.get_pile_of_dirt(i)
      if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, pile) then
        sp_util.start_scene(self.start_dig_pile_event, self, i)
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end

--endregion

--region 연출

function mini_event:meet_old_soldier_event()

  local leader = user_party.Leader
  local old_soldier = self.character.old_soldier

function mini_event:start_dig_pile_event(idx)
  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
  local pile = self.get_pile_of_dirt(idx)
  local leader = user_party.Leader
  pile.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
  local hb = pile.Hitbox.size
  wp_util.move_async(leader, pile.Position + vector(hb.x,0,0), 2, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  --세이라(left, idle, eat) 2초
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx('equipping_01', {
    loop = true, type_priority = 'event'})
  scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
  scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
  wait_for_sec(2)
  self.controller.sfx:stop_sfx('equipping_01')

  --오브젝트 제거

  field_object_util.set_active_state(pile, active_state_type.disabled)
  wait_for_sec(1)
  dig_effect:Dispose()
  --리더 애니 초기화
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

  if idx == 3 then

    -- 아이템 획득

    screen_util.item_get_event(

        'bs_seira_main_sword_title',
        'bs_seira_main_sword_subtitle',
        'bs_seira_main_sword_desc'
    )
    for i = 1, self.pile_of_dirt_cnt do
      quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_constants_key, self.quest_marker.dig_pile_(i))
    end

    quest_marker_util.add_auto_control(self.quest_constants_key, {
      { zone = 'main_field', target = self.character.old_soldier},
      { zone = 's2_2_quest_field', create_none_data() },
    }, self.quest_marker.give_sword)

    self.character.old_soldier.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

function mini_event:give_sword_event()
  local leader = user_party.Leader
  local old_soldier = self.character.old_soldier

  local choose_table = {
    { 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_choose_1', 'mercy' },
    { 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_choose_2', 'brutal' }
  }
  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

  --선택지 출력
  local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(choose_table)

  if result == 2 then
    music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
    return
  end

  quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_constants_key, self.quest_marker.give_sword)

  --애니 초기화
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(old_soldier)

  --세이라(left, idle, walk) 1초에 걸쳐 정렬 후 (left, idle, idle)
  wp_util.move_async(leader, old_soldier.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  --늙은병사에게 검 전달 연출
  local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
    pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
    target = old_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0),

  })

  quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, old_soldier)
  wait_for_sec(2)

  --늙은병사(right, damaged, idle) : 치워!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(old_soldier, self, 'right',
      {name = 'embarrassed', keep = true}, 'attack', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_20')

  --칼을 떨어뜨림
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('air_spin_02')
  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', parent = old_soldier, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
  character_util.set_anim(old_soldier, { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false })
  item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = old_soldier.Position, target = leader.Position + vector(0.5,0,0),
                                                     itemid = self.old_sword_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

  item:SetSortingLayer(true)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  character_util.remove_anim(old_soldier)

  --늙은병사(right, damaged, idle) : 내 눈앞에서 치워라! 그날의 비명소리가... 으아아!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(old_soldier, self, 'right',
      {name = 'embarrassed', one_shot_sfx = false}, 'damaged', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_21')

  --늙은병사(left, scared, idle) shake 0.03
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('rustle_01')
  scene_util.set_direction(old_soldier, 'left', false)
  scene_util.set_anim(old_soldier, self, 'idle')
  scene_util.set_emotion(old_soldier, self, 'scared')
  scene_util.shake(old_soldier, 0.03, 1, false)

  --2초 대기
  wait_for_sec(2)

  --세이라 검을 줍는다.
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx('equipping_01', {
    loop = true, type_priority = 'event'})
  scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
  scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'eat',scale = 0.5, remove_after = 0.4})
  scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'idle')
  self.controller.sfx:stop_sfx('equipping_01')

  drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
  scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

  --1초 대기
  wait_for_sec(1)

  --세이라 검을 건넨다.
  item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
    pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0),
    target = old_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0),
    item_id = self.old_sword_item_id,
    loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
    show_on_character = true,
    skip_item_text = true,
  })

  quest_drop_item_util.consumed(item, old_soldier)
  character_util.spine_set_attachment(old_soldier, '[base]weapon1', 'broken_sword')

  --2초 대기
  wait_for_sec(2)

  --세이라(left, attack, idle) : : 이 기억을 포기해버리면... 당신을 믿고 죽어간 부하들도 영원히 패배자로 지워지는 거예요.
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('dialogue_ready_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
      nil, 'attack', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_22')

  --세이라(left, idle, nod) : 그 차가운 검을 들고 집결지로 가세요.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
      'nod', nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_23')

  --세이라(left, idle, cast2) : 그들을 기억하는 것, 그것이 도망친 당신의 죗값입니다.
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('fade_out_03')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'left',
      'cast2', nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_24')

  --3초 대기
  wait_for_sec(0.5)
  scene_util.set_emotion(old_soldier, self, 'sleep_deep')
  scene_util.shake(old_soldier, 0.03, 0.5, false)
  wait_for_sec(1)
  scene_util.set_anim(old_soldier, self, 'sword_idle')
  scene_util.shake(old_soldier, 0.03, 0.5, false)
  wait_for_sec(1)
  scene_util.shake(old_soldier, 0.03, 0.5, false)
  wait_for_sec(1)

  --늙은병사(up, idle, idle) : ...잔인한 통신병이로군.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(old_soldier, self, 'up',
      nil, 'sword_idle', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_25')

  --늙은병사(up, release, idle) : 앞장서라.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(old_soldier, self, 'right',
      'release', nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_26')

  --늙은병사(up, victory_get, idle) : 내 부하들의 이름을 명부에 올리기 전까진... 이 목숨, 함부로 버리지 않겠다.
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('stage_intro_jump_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(old_soldier, self, 'right',
      { name = 'victory_get', sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false  } , nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_27')

  --나레이션 박스: 늙은 병사가 합류했다.
  field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_1_28' })

  character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(old_soldier, 0, 0.5)

  wait_for_sec(0.5)
  --field_object_util.set_active_state(old_soldier, active_state_type.disabled)
  old_soldier.Position  = vector(999,0,999)
  character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(old_soldier, 1, 0)

  self.current_state = self.states.done
  --리더 애니 초기화
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
  self.quest_doors:open()
  self.quest_controller:save_mini_event_cleared_state(self.event_flag)

local mini_event = newclass('MiniEvent2')

function mini_event:init(event_controller)
  self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1
  self.event_controller = event_controller
  ---@type LuaQuestEventController
  self.quest_controller = event_controller.quest_controller
  self.controller = event_controller.quest_controller.controller

  --이벤트 플래그. 미니이벤트 n은 1 << n
  self.event_flag = 2

  -- 섹션 내부 스테이트 enum
  self.states = {
    none = 1,
    start = 2,
    meet_parent = 3, -- 부모 만남
    angry_parent = 4, -- 지하에서 부모 화냄
    go_vent = 5, -- 벤트로 이동
    maze = 6, -- 미로
    showed_daughter = 7, -- 딸 봤음
    fixed_lantern = 8, -- 랜턴 고친 후
    done = 9
  }
  self.current_state = self.states.none

  self.character = self.quest_controller.character
  self.quest_id = self.quest_controller.cs_controller.QuestId

  self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
    morning_light_loop = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bs_morning_light_loop')
    end,
    object_twinkle = function()
      return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
    end
  })

  self.mini_game_name = 'VentMiniGame'
  self.mini_game_key = 'vent_mini_game_bridge_seira_1'

  -- virtual field object
  self.virtual_wall_list = {
    fo = {},
    create_wall = function(this, pos, hitbox)
      local new_wall = field_object_util.create_virtual_field_object(pos, { hit_box = hitbox })
      table.insert(this.fo, new_wall)
    end,
    dispose_all = function(this)
      for i = 1, #this.fo do
        local wall = this.fo[i]

        if wall ~= nil then
          wall:Dispose()
        end

        wall = nil
      end
      this.fo = nil
    end
  }
end

function mini_event:enter()
  if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
    start_coroutine(function()
      -- 미니게임 로드
      self.vent_mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

      local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
      mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, self.mini_game_key, function()
        self.vent_mini_game:set_enemies_leg_walk()
        is_mini_game_load_complete = true
      end)

      --mini_game_util.get_or_create(self.mini_game_name, self.quest_id)
      --mini_game_util.load_resource_async(self.mini_game_name,  self.mini_game_key)
    end)

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
  end
end

local function create_none_data()
  return {
    type = 'none',
    name = nil,
  }
end

function mini_event:start()
  if not self.quest_controller:check_mini_event_cleared_by_id(self.event_flag) then
    self.current_state = self.states.start
    self:set_start()
    self.fx:create_all()
  end
end

function mini_event:exit()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

  -- 확실히 제거
  quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('parent_meet_quest')

  self.event_controller = nil
end

function mini_event:dispose()
  self.virtual_wall_list:dispose_all()
  mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.mini_game_name)
end

function mini_event:on_event(e)
  if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
    self:on_interact_event(e)
    return true
  end
end

--region 셋팅
function mini_event:set_start()
  -- 마커 셋팅
  quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('parent_meet_quest', {
    { zone = 'main_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_2_underground_enter_pos') }
  })

  -- npc 셋팅
  local mom = self.character.mom
  local dad = self.character.dad
  local daughter = self.character.daughter

  local mom_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_2_mom_block_pos')
  local dad_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_2_dad_block_pos')
  local daughter_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_2_daughter_pos')

  character_util.set_position(mom, mom_pos)
  character_util.set_position(dad, dad_pos)
  character_util.set_position(daughter, daughter_pos)

  field_object_util.set_active_state(mom, active_state_type.enabled)
  field_object_util.set_active_state(dad, active_state_type.enabled)
  field_object_util.set_active_state(daughter, active_state_type.enabled)

  -- 기믹 셋팅
  CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(
      CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE))
end

--endregion

--region Event 처리
function mini_event:on_interact_event(e)
  if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.mom) or type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.character.dad)then
    self:interact_angry_parent()
    return true
  end

  return false
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
  if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_parent_meet_zone') and
      self.current_state == self.states.start then

    self:s2_2_parent_meet_zone_enter()
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_underground_start_zone')
    and self.current_state < self.states.angry_parent then
    self:s2_2_underground_start_zone_enter()
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_maze_zone') then
    self:s2_2_maze_zone_enter()
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_maze_bubble_zone') then
    start_coroutine(self.passing_vent_area, self)
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_maze_vent_zone') then
    self:s2_2_vent_zone_enter()
    return true

  elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_2_maze_broken_lantern_zone') then
    self:s2_2_maze_broken_lantern_zone_enter()
    return true
  end

  return false
end

--region 연출
-- 길막
function mini_event:scene_rock_block()
  local seira = self.character.seira
  local mom = self.character.mom
  local dad = self.character.dad
  local parent = { mom, dad }
  local rock_1 = get_field_object('parent_block_rock')
  local rock_2 = get_field_object('parent_block_rock_2')

  --[동시연출]
  do
    --아빠, 엄마(right, attack, push) 3초에 걸쳐 0.5타일 우측으로 이동
    scene_util.set_group_anim(parent, self, 'push')
    scene_util.set_group_direction(parent, 'right', false)
    scene_util.set_group_emotion(parent, self, 'attack')

    --아빠, 엄마,바위  3초에 걸쳐 우측으로 0.5타일 이동
    wp_util.move(mom, mom.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 5)
    wp_util.move(dad, dad.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 5)

    -- 바위 밀때 이펙트
    start_coroutine(function()
      for j = 1, 10 do
        stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(dad.Position + vector(0,0,0.5))
        stage.SmokeManager:SetBottomSmokeOnce(dad)
        stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(dad.Position + vector(0,0,-0.5))
        stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(mom.Position + vector(0,0,0.5))
        stage.SmokeManager:SetBottomSmokeOnce(mom)
        stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(mom.Position + vector(0,0,-0.5))
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
      end
    end)

    local rock_1_start_position = rock_1.Position
    local rock_2_start_position = rock_2.Position

    -- 바위 이동
    coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(5, 0, 1.5, function(_, cur_value)

      -- 세이라 바위 충돌 체크 (가만히 있으면 뚫음)
      if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(seira.Bounds, rock_1.Bounds) or
          bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(seira.Bounds, rock_2.Bounds) then
        seira.Position = seira.Position + vector(0.035, 0, 0)
      end

      rock_1.Position = rock_1_start_position + vector(cur_value, 0, 0)
      rock_2.Position = rock_2_start_position + vector(cur_value, 0, 0)
    end)
  end

  --엄마(right, attack, idle) : 이러면 우리 아이에게 아무도 접근 못하겠죠.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mom, self, 'right', nil,
      'attack', {key = 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_a_1', skip =  false})

  --아빠(down, attack, nod 1회 후 idle) : 고생했소. 여보. 이제 우리 아이는 안전할거요!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dad, self, 'down', { name = 'nod', count = 1 },
      'attack', {key = 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_a_2', skip = false})

  --아빠, 엄마(left, idle, walk) 속도 6으로 우측으로 이동 후, 카메라 그리드 밖에서 제거
  local out_pos_1 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', dad.Position, -3)
  local out_pos_2 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', mom.Position, -3)
  wp_util.move(dad, out_pos_1, 6)
  wp_util.move(mom, out_pos_2, 6)

  --1.5초 대기
  wait_for_sec(1.5)

  -- 카메라 그리드 밖에서 제거
  character_util.set_position(dad, vector(999, 0, 999))
  character_util.set_position(mom, vector(999, 0, 999))

  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dad)
  character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mom)
end

-- 지하 벙커에서 설득하지만 화내는 부모
function mini_event:scene_angry()
  local seira = self.character.seira
  local mom = self.character.mom
  local dad = self.character.dad

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

  -- 세이라 이동
  wp_util.move_async(seira, mom.Position + vector(1,0,0.5), 2, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

  --아빠(right, attack, idle) : 당장 나가! 우리 아이는 안전한 곳에서 살게 할거요!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dad, self, 'right',
      nil, 'attack', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_1')

  --세이라(left, idle, release) : 진정하세요. 켄터베리 통신병 세이라 입니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(seira, self, 'left',
      'release', nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_2')

  --세이라(left, idle, idle) : 생존자들을 안전한 집결지로 대피시키고 있습니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(seira, self, 'left',
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_3')

  --아빠(right, mad, cast2) : 대피?
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dad, self, 'right',
      { name = 'cast2', loop = true }, 'mad', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_4')

  --아빠(right, mad, release) : 밖은 적들 천지인데 누굴 지킨다는 거요! 우린 아무 데도 안 가!
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('male_shout_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(dad, self, 'right',
      {name = 'release', count = 1}, 'mad', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_5')

  --엄마(right, scared, nil) : 우리 애는… 우리 애만큼은 무조건 이 안전한 곳에서 살릴거에요!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mom, self, 'right',
      nil, 'scared', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_6')

  --세이라(left, jumpx2, surprised) : 안에 아이가 있나요?
  character_util.set_emotion(seira, {name = 'surprise' , loop = true })
  character_util.normal_double_jump(seira, true)
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(seira, self, 'left',
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_7')

  --세이라(left, idle, idle) : 두분, 이렇게 고립되면 결국 식량도 떨어집니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(seira, self, 'left',
      'idle', 'idle', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_8')

  --세이라(left, sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 무엇보다 여긴… 빛 한 줌들지 않는 곳이잖아요.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(seira, self, 'left',
      'cross_arm', 'sleep_deep', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_9')

  character_util.shake(mom, 0.03, 0.5)
  --엄마 (mad, shake 한번 ) : 숨 막히는 어둠 속에 숨어서라도 살아남는 게, 밖에서 찢겨 죽는 것보단 나아요!
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('female_shout_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mom, self, 'right',
      nil, 'mad', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_10')

  --엄마 (mad, release, shout 말풍선) : 우린 절대로 안 가요!
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('dialogue_negative_01')
  scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(mom, self,
      { dir = 'right', sfx = false },
      { name = 'release' },
      { name = 'mad' },
      { key = 'bs_seira_main_sec2_2_b_11', skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

  --0.5초 대기
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  --플레이어 컨트롤 해제
  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
  self.current_state = self.states.go_vent

  character_util.remove_relate_event(mom, self.quest_controller)
  character_util.remove_relate_event(dad, self.quest_controller)

  mom.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
  dad.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

  -- 부모 사이 못지나가도록 막기
  local pivot_pos = mom.Position
  self.virtual_wall_list:create_wall(pivot_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 0, 0.5)))
end

function mini_event:create_fire_wall(marker_name)

  if self.fire_walls[marker_name] ~= nil then
    return
  end

  local cnt = self.getTableLength(self.fire_walls)
  if cnt >= self.field_obj.fire_gimmick_cnt then
    return
  end

  local fire_obj = self.field_obj.fire_gimmick_fire_(cnt + 1)
  fire_obj.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name)
  field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_obj, active_state_type.enabled)

  self.fire_walls[marker_name] = fire_obj
end

function mini_event:get_extinguished(fo)

  local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
  local duration = 1
  local init_scale = fo.transform.localScale
  local init_Hitbox = fo.Hitbox

  fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 0))

  while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
    fo.transform.localScale = init_scale * (1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time))
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  fo.Position = self.fire_init_pos
  fo.transform.localScale = init_scale
  fo.Hitbox = init_Hitbox
  field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)

  if self.current_state == self.states.after_meet_archivist and self.remove_fire_cnt >= 3 then
    sp_util.start_scene(self.after_extinguish_fire, self)
  end
end

--불을 제거한다.
function mini_event:remove_firewall(marker_name, not_action)

  local fire_obj = self.fire_walls[marker_name]
  self.fire_walls[marker_name] = nil

  if fire_obj == nil then
    return
  end

  if is_action ~= nil and is_action then
    fo.Position = self.fire_init_pos
    field_object_util.set_active_state(fire_obj, active_state_type.disabled)
  else
    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_extinguished, self, fire_obj))
  end
end

function mini_event:remove_all_firewall()
  for marker_name, fire in pairs(self.fire_walls) do
    self:remove_firewall(marker_name, true)
  end
  self.fire_walls = {}
end

function mini_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
