function mini_event:enter_archivist_zone()

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
  local archivist = self.character.archivist
  local boy = self.character.boy

  --소년(up, smile, idle) : 할아버지, 그래서 기사님이 드래곤을 무찔렀어요?
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(boy, self, 'up',
      nil, 'smile', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_1')

  --기록관(down, idle, nod 1회 후 idle) : 그렇단다. 그 기사의 용맹함과 백성들의 환호성이 이 역사서들에 고스란히 살아 숨 쉬고 있지.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archivist, self, 'down',
      { name = 'nod', count = 1 }, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_2')

  --기록관(down, idle, idle) : 수레 정리가 끝나면 마저 알려줄테니 잠시 기다리거라.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archivist, self, 'down',
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_3')


  local wagon = self.field_obj.archivist_wagon()
  local books = self.field_obj.pile_of_books()

  local booksPos = books.Position + vector(1, 0, 1)
  local wagonPos = wagon.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1.5)

  local booksBoyPos = books.Position + vector(-1, 0, 1)

  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        wp_util.move_async(boy, vector(booksBoyPos.x, 0, boy.Position.z), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
        wp_util.move_async(boy, booksBoyPos , nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
        wait_for_sec(0.5)
        scene_util.set_anim(boy, self, 'eat')
      end,
      function()
        wp_util.move_async(archivist, booksPos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })
        scene_util.set_anim(archivist, self, 'eat')
      end
  )

  local arrive_wagon = false

  start_coroutine(function()

    wait_for_sec(2)
    while self.current_state == self.states.none do
      character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(archivist)
      if arrive_wagon then
        wp_util.move_async(archivist, booksPos, 2, 0, { last_direction = 'left' })
        arrive_wagon = false
      else
        wp_util.move_async(archivist, wagonPos, 2, 0, { last_direction = 'right' })
        arrive_wagon = true
      end
      wait_for_sec(0.5)
      scene_util.set_anim(archivist, self, 'eat')
      wait_for_sec(2)
      coroutine.yield()
    end
  end, self)

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function mini_event:meet_archivist()

  music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

  self.current_state = self.states.after_meet_archivist

  quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control(self.quest_constants_key, self.quest_marker.meet_archivist)

  local archivist = self.character.archivist
  local boy = self.character.boy
  local leader = get_party_leader()

  local wagon = self.field_obj.archivist_wagon()

  archivist.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
  boy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

  --세이라(left, idle, walk) 이미지 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 이동 후 (left, idle, idle)
  wait_for_sec(0.5)
  local pos = leader.Position
  wp_util.move_async(leader, pos + vector(archivist.Position.x - pos.x + 0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })
  wp_util.move_async(leader, pos + vector(archivist.Position.x - pos.x + 0.5, 0, archivist.Position.z - pos.z + 0.5), nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'left' })
  wait_for_sec(0.5)

  --세이라 (left, idle) : 켄터베리 통신병 세이라입니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_10')

  --세이라 (left, idle) :  외곽 생존자들을 모으고 있습니다. 당장 이곳을 떠나셔야 합니다.
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, nil,
      nil, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_11')

  --기록관 (right,smile,cast2) : 오오, 통신병! 마침 잘 왔네. 어서 이 기록물 정리를 좀 돕게.
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('dialogue_positive_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archivist, self, 'right',
      'cast2', 'smile', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_12')

  --기록관, 세이라 수레로 이동.

  wp_util.move(archivist, wagon.Position  + vector(-1, 0, 2), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right' })
  wp_util.move_async(leader, wagon.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 2.3), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })

  scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'shoot')
  wait_for_sec(1)
  --세이라 (오전에 이야기 했던 shot 애니 대화동안 반복) : 수레의 짐이 너무 많습니다. 산길을 넘어야 하니 무거운 짐은 버리고 가셔야…
  self.controller.sfx:play_sfx_one_shot('rustle_01')
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(leader, self, 'down',
      { name = 'shoot', loop = true }, nil,'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_13')

  --기록관(right,release,mad) : 짐이라니! 그 입 함부로 놀리지 마라!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archivist, self, 'right',
      'release', 'mad', 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_14')

  -- 세이라 기록관을 본다.
  character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)

  --기록관 (right, shot동작 대화동안 유지) : 이건 단순한 종이 뭉치들이 아니야. 켄터베리의 초대 왕이 흘린 피부터, 시장 골목에서 뛰어놀던 아이들의 웃음소리까지 모두 담긴 ‘왕국의 영혼’이다!
  scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(archivist, self, 'right',
      { name = 'shoot', loop = true }, nil, 'bs_seira_main_sec2_3_15')

function mini_event:water_destroyed(fo)

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dive_01')

    end

function mini_event:reset_bowl()

  message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent.Create(reset_finish))
end

function mini_event:load_bombing_range_pool()
  self.bombing_range_pool = {}
  for _ = 1, self.bombing_range_pool_size do
    local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.bombing_radius)
    attack_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)
    table.insert(self.bombing_range_pool, attack_range)
  end
end

function mini_event:get_bombing_range(bombing_radius)
  for i = 1, #self.bombing_range_pool do
    local attack_range = self.bombing_range_pool[i]
    if attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
      attack_range:ResizeCircle(bombing_radius)
      attack_range.gameObject:SetActive(true)
      return attack_range
    end
  end

  -- 풀에서 전부 끌어다 썼을 때
  local new_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, bombing_radius)
  table.insert(self.bombing_range_pool, new_attack_range)

  return new_attack_range
end

function mini_event:dispose_bombing_range(range)
  range.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function mini_event:bomb_fall_start(target_pos, delay, move_time, shake, bombing_radius, no_sfx)
  local bomb_info = {
    target_pos = target_pos,
    delay = delay,
    move_time = move_time,
    shake = shake,
    bombing_radius = bombing_radius,
    no_sfx = no_sfx
  }
  start_coroutine(self.bomb_fall, self, bomb_info)
  return bomb_info
end

function mini_event:bomb_fall(bomb_info)

  local shake_power = lua_helper.get_or_default(bomb_info.shake, 0.15)
  local end_pos = bomb_info.target_pos

  local start_pos = end_pos + vector(0, self.bomb_start_height, 0)

  local attack_range = self:get_bombing_range(bomb_info.bombing_radius)

  --바닥 높이로 설정
  local field = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field
  local height = field:GetTileInfoAt(end_pos):GetHeightAt(end_pos)
  attack_range.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos, height + 0.1)
  attack_range:Show()

  local time_passed = 0
  while time_passed < bomb_info.delay do
    time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
    coroutine.yield()
  end

  time_passed = 0
  local missile_effect = self.fx.darkmagic_missile():Instantiate(start_pos)

  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', play_pos = end_pos })

  local move_time = bomb_info.move_time
  while time_passed <  move_time do

    --외부에서 시간 변경시 초기화
    if bomb_info.move_time ~= move_time then
      move_time = bomb_info.move_time
      time_passed = 0
      start_pos = missile_effect.transform.position
    end

    time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

    local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_time)

    missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
    coroutine.yield()
  end

  missile_effect:Dispose()
  self:dispose_bombing_range(attack_range)

  if bomb_info.no_sfx == nil or not bomb_info.no_sfx then
    music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = end_pos })
    --music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_kick_02', play_pos = end_pos })
  end

  if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(end_pos, { bonus_distance = 3 }) then
    return
  end

  local explosion_effect = self.fx.darkmagic_missile_explosion():Instantiate(end_pos)

  explosion_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5
  camera_util.shake(shake_power, 0.2)
end

--endregion

return {
  create = function()
    return mini_event
  end
}

function local_class:move_item_async(item, p0, p1, p2, speed)
  local t = 0

---@class ICharacterPlaceController
---@field initialize fun(self:self)
---@field activate_group fun(self:self, group_name : string)
---@field deactivate_group fun(self:self, group_name : string)
---@field get_group fun(self:self, group_name : string)

---@class CharacterPlaceController : ICharacterPlaceController
local local_class = newclass('CharacterPlaceController')

---@class ICharacterPlaceGroup
---@field get_dynamic_member fun(self:self, member_name : string)

---@class CharacterPlaceGroup : ICharacterPlaceGroup
local character_place_group = newclass('CharacterPlaceGroup')

-- get_position함수에서 받은 데이터가 table 타입일 경우 좌표값 반환 처리
---@param pos_data string|Vector3
local return_place_pos_from_table = function(pos_data)
	if type_util.is_string(pos_data) then
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(pos_data)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(pos_data, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3) then
		return pos_data
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.zero
end

-- 전달받은 data를 기반으로 좌표값 반환
---@param data table|Vector3
local get_position = function(data)
	if type_util.is_table(data) then
		local pos = return_place_pos_from_table(data.pivot)

		if data.offset ~= nil then
			return pos + data.offset
		end

		return pos
	elseif type_util.is_string(data) then
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(data, CS.UnityEngine.Vector3) then
		return data
	end

	return unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:init()
	---@type table<string, CharacterPlaceGroup>
	self.place_groups = {}

	---@type { none:number, exist:number, absend:number }
	self.group_condition_state = {
		none = 1,
		exist = 2,
		absent = 3,
	}

	self.is_already_initialized = false

	-- 캐싱할 다이나믹 npc 리스트
	self.cached_dynamic_npc_list = {}
end

function local_class:initialize()
	if self.is_already_initialized then
		return
	end

	-- 배치될 캐릭터 그룹들 초기화
	local init_place_groups = function(place_group_data, placer_data)
		-- 배치하는 주체인 스크립트의 타입에 따라 stage data 반환 방식을 다르게 진행(stage타입과 다른 타입은 테이블 구조가 약간 다르기 때문)
		local set_stage_data = function()
			if placer_data == nil or placer_data.placer_info.type ~= 'stage' then
				return place_group_data[stage.Name]
			else
				if placer_data.placer_info.type == 'stage' and placer_data.placer_info.stage_name ~= stage.Name then
					return nil
				else
					return place_group_data
				end
			end
		end

		local stage_data = set_stage_data()

		if stage_data ~= nil then
			for name, data in pairs(stage_data) do
				local creator = character_place_group

				--스크립트 타입이 섹션 혹은 컨트롤러일 경우, 퀘스트 ID 저장
				if placer_data ~= nil and placer_data.placer_info ~= nil then
					if data.condition ~= nil and data.condition.quest_id == nil then
						if placer_data.placer_info.type == 'section' or placer_data.placer_info.type == 'controller' then
							data.condition.quest_id = placer_data.placer_info.quest_id
						end
					end

					-- 섹션 타입일 경우 Progress 셋팅
					if placer_data.placer_info.type == 'section' then
						if placer_data.placer_info.progress ~= nil then
							if data.condition == nil then
								data.condition = {}
							end

							data.condition.quest_id = placer_data.placer_info.quest_id
							data.condition.progress_infos = {}
							data.condition.progress_infos[1] = {}
							data.condition.progress_infos[1].from = placer_data.placer_info.progress
							data.condition.progress_infos[1].to = placer_data.placer_info.progress
						end
					end
				end

				-- 스크립트 타입 저장
				if placer_data ~= nil and placer_data.placer_info ~= nil and placer_data.placer_info.type ~= nil then
					data.script_type = placer_data.placer_info.type
				end

				self.place_groups[name] = creator(self, data)
			end
		end
	end

	local chapter_constants_path_list = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Etc/CharacterPlaceController/CharacterPlaceChapterPath')

	local chapter_code = stage.Spec.ChapterCode.Value
	local chapter_path_list = chapter_constants_path_list[chapter_code]

	-- 각 경로의 스크립트에 데이터들 셋팅
	for _, path in pairs(chapter_path_list) do
		local character_place_data = get_or_create_global_variable(path)

		init_place_groups(character_place_data.groups, character_place_data.placer)
	end

	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')

	self.is_already_initialized = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	for group_name, group in pairs(self.place_groups) do
		local is_valid = group:check_condition(self.group_condition_state)

		if is_valid == self.group_condition_state.exist then
			start_coroutine(self.activate_group, self, group_name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	-- 캐싱해둔 dynamic npc 제거
	for _, npc_list in pairs(self.cached_dynamic_npc_list) do
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(npc_list)
	end

	self.cached_dynamic_npc_list = nil

	for group_name, group in pairs(self.place_groups) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)

		group:dispose()

		self.place_groups[group_name] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	return self:on_quest_condition_changed(e.QuestId)
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	return self:on_quest_condition_changed(e.QuestId)
end

function local_class:on_quest_condition_changed(target_quest_id)
	local groups_to_init = {}
	local groups_to_dispose = {}

	for group_name, group in pairs(self.place_groups) do
		local quest_id = group.condition_data.quest_id

		-- 클리어하거나 progress를 넘긴 퀘스트와 같은 퀘스트만 처리한다.
		if target_quest_id == quest_id then
			local is_activated = group.activated
			local is_valid = group:check_condition(self.group_condition_state)

			if not is_activated and is_valid == self.group_condition_state.exist then
				groups_to_init[#groups_to_init + 1] = group_name
			elseif is_activated and is_valid == self.group_condition_state.absent then
				groups_to_dispose[#groups_to_dispose + 1] = group_name
			end
		end
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_dispose) do
		self:deactivate_group(group_name)
	end

	for _, group_name in ipairs(groups_to_init) do
		start_coroutine(self.activate_group, self, group_name)
	end

	return true
end

---@param group_name string 활성화할 그룹 이름
function local_class:activate_group(group_name)
	local group = self.place_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()

	--logger_util.log(string.format('[CharacterPlaceController] Group [Name : %s] activated.', group_name))
end

---@param group_name string 비활성화할 그룹 이름
function local_class:deactivate_group(group_name)
	local group = self.place_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false

	--logger_util.log(string.format('[CharacterPlaceController] Group [Name : %s] deactivated.', group_name))
end

---@param group_name string 반환할 그룹 이름
---@return CharacterPlaceGroup
function local_class:get_group(group_name)
	local group = self.place_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	return group
end

function local_class:reset_group_settings(group_name)
	local group = self.place_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:place_characters()
end

--- 캐싱해둔 다이나믹 npc 가져오기
---@param key string 가져올 다이나믹 npc 그룹 이름
---@return Character
function local_class:get_cached_dynamic_npc(key)
	local dynamic_npc_group = self.cached_dynamic_npc_list[key]

	if dynamic_npc_group == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for _, dynamic_npc in ipairs(dynamic_npc_group) do
		if dynamic_npc.ActiveState == active_state_type.disabled then
			-- disabled로 체크하고 있으니 활성화하고 넘기기
			field_object_util.set_active_state(dynamic_npc, active_state_type.enabled)
			return dynamic_npc
		end
	end

	return nil
end

--- 등록할 키에 npc 세팅
---@param key string 세팅할 다이나믹 npc 그룹 이름
---@param npc Character 등록할 다이나믹 npc 그룹 이름
function local_class:set_cached_dynamic_npc(key, npc)
	if self.cached_dynamic_npc_list[key] == nil then
		self.cached_dynamic_npc_list[key] = {}
	end

	table.insert(self.cached_dynamic_npc_list[key], npc)
end

do
	local cleared_value = 'clear'

	---@param stage_data table 스테이지 내 그룹 데이터
	function character_place_group:init(controller, stage_data)
		self.controller = controller
		self.activated = false
		self.dynamic_npc_created = false

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		if stage_data ~= nil then
			self.condition_data = stage_data.condition
			self.member_infos = stage_data.member_infos

			if stage_data.script_type ~= nil then
				self.script_type = stage_data.script_type
			end

			--동적 생성할 NPC들 스펙 정보 가져오기
			self.dynamic_npc_data = stage_data.dynamic_npc_data
			self.dynamic_member_list = nil
		end
	end

	function character_place_group:dispose()
		self.controller = nil
		self.condition_data = nil
		self.member_infos = nil
		self.dynamic_member_list = nil
		self.dynamic_npc_data = nil
	end

	---현재 캐릭터 배치할 그룹의 상태 체크하여 배치를 진행할 것인지 하지 않을 것인지 확인
	--- @param selective_value { none:number, exist:number, absend:number }
	function character_place_group:check_condition(selective_value)
		--활성화 조건 존재 및 활성화 조건 중 활성화/비활성화 처리(progress보다 우선)
		if self.condition_data ~= nil then
			if self.condition_data.force_active == true then
				if self.script_type ~= 'section' then
					return selective_value.exist
				end
			elseif self.condition_data.force_active == false then
				return selective_value.absent
			end
		end

		local quest_info = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.condition_data.quest_id)

		local progress = -1
		local cleared = false

		if quest_info ~= nil then
			progress = quest_info.InnerProgress
			cleared = quest_info.IsComplete
		end

		for i = 1, #self.condition_data.progress_infos do
			local info = self.condition_data.progress_infos[i]

			if info.from == cleared_value then
				if cleared then
					return selective_value.exist
				end
			elseif info.to ~= nil then
				if info.to == cleared_value then
					if info.from <= progress or cleared then
						return selective_value.exist
					end
				elseif info.from <= progress and progress <= info.to and not cleared then
					return selective_value.exist
				end
			elseif info.to == nil then
				if info.from <= progress and not cleared then
					return selective_value.exist
				else
					return selective_value.absent
				end
			end
		end

		return selective_value.absent
	end

	--그룹 시작 단계
	function character_place_group:enter()
		if not self.dynamic_npc_created and self.dynamic_npc_data ~= nil then
			self:create_dynamic_npcs()
		end

		-- 조건에 맞는 캐릭터들 배치
		self:place_characters()
	end

	--그룹 시작 단계
	function character_place_group:create_dynamic_npcs()
		-- specs의 내용물을 보고 load에 있으면 미리 들고 있고 테이블에서 제외한다.
		local pooled_dynamic_npc_list = {}
		local is_table_set = false

		local copy_specs = deep_copy(self.dynamic_npc_data.specs)
		local prefix = self.dynamic_npc_data.npc_name_prefix

		-- 스팩들을 순회 돌아보고
		for key, spec in pairs(self.dynamic_npc_data.specs) do
			-- 풀에 남는 npc가 존재하면 이미 로드된 npc 스팩을 넣고 specs의 key 내용은 비움
			local cached_npc = self.controller:get_cached_dynamic_npc(spec)

			if cached_npc ~= nil then
				local new_key = key

				if self.dynamic_npc_data.npc_name_prefix ~= nil then
					new_key = 'dynamic_' .. prefix .. key
				end

				-- 풀에서 가져온 npc 이름 변경 및 테이블에 넣어줌
				cached_npc.Name = new_key
				pooled_dynamic_npc_list[key] = cached_npc

				-- 복사한 spec쪽 비워줌
				copy_specs[key] = nil

				is_table_set = true
			end
		end

		-- 동적 NPC 로드
		if self.dynamic_npc_data.npc_name_prefix ~= nil then
			self.dynamic_member_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_with_prefix_async(self.dynamic_npc_data.npc_name_prefix, copy_specs)
		else
			self.dynamic_member_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(copy_specs)
		end

		-- 추가로 동적 로드된 npc들은 컨트롤러에 캐싱한다
		for _, npc in pairs(self.dynamic_member_list) do
			self.controller:set_cached_dynamic_npc(npc.SpriteName, npc)
		end

		-- 이후 캐싱해둔 npc가 존재하면 테이블에 넣어준다.
		if is_table_set then
			table_util.add_range_map(self.dynamic_member_list, pooled_dynamic_npc_list)
		end

		self.dynamic_npc_created = true
	end

	--전체적인 캐릭터 배치
	function character_place_group:place_characters()
		-- NPC 셋팅 함수
		local set_npc_info = function(npc_info, create_dyn_npc)
			-- 배치될 리더, 일반 혹은 동적 생성 NPC 반환
			local get_placement_npc = function()
				-- 파티 리더와 기사, 페이, 메이 처리
				if npc_info.name == 'leader' then
					return get_party_leader()
				elseif npc_info.name == 'knight' then
					return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
				elseif npc_info.name == 'china_hero' then
					return user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
				end

				if create_dyn_npc == false then
					return get_character(npc_info.name)
				end

				return self.dynamic_member_list[npc_info.name]
			end

			local npc = get_placement_npc()

			if npc_info.pre_callback ~= nil then
				npc_info.pre_callback(npc, npc_info)
			end

			self:set_base_info(npc, npc_info)

			if npc_info.post_callback ~= nil then
				npc_info.post_callback(npc, npc_info)
			end
		end

		--일반 타일맵 NPC 셋팅
		if self.member_infos ~= nil then
			linq(self.member_infos):foreach(function(name, npc_info)
				set_npc_info(npc_info, false)
			end)
		end

		--동적 생성 NPC 셋팅
		if self.dynamic_npc_data ~= nil and self.dynamic_npc_data.dynamic_member_infos ~= nil then
			local dyn_mem_info_list = self.dynamic_npc_data.dynamic_member_infos

			linq(dyn_mem_info_list):foreach(function(name, npc_info)
				set_npc_info(npc_info, true)
			end)
		end
	end

	--- 각 캐릭터 셋팅 처리 함수
	---@param npc character 배치할 캐릭터 객체
	---@param npc_info table 각 챕터 데이터에서 읽어온 데이터의 배치할 캐릭터 그룹 셋팅 정보
	function character_place_group:set_base_info(npc, npc_info)
		if npc_info.remove_lv_ui ~= nil and npc_info.remove_lv_ui == true then
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		local state = active_state_type.enabled
		if npc_info.active_state ~= nil then
			state = npc_info.active_state
		end

		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, state)

		-- 위치 셋팅
		if npc_info.position ~= nil then
			local isFlying = false

			if npc_info.fly ~= nil and npc_info.fly == true then
				isFlying = true
			end

			local position = get_position(npc_info.position)

			character_util.set_position(npc, position, isFlying)
		end

		if npc_info.direction ~= nil then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, npc_info.direction)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		if npc_info.emotion ~= nil then
			if npc_info.emotion == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_info.emotion)
			end
		end

		if npc_info.anim_info ~= nil then
			if npc_info.anim_info == 'idle' then
				character_util.remove_anim(npc)
			else
				if type_util.is_table(npc_info.anim_info) then
					-- 애니 사운드 재생되지 않는 옵션 추가
					npc_info.anim_info.one_shot_sfx = false

					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_info.anim_info)
				elseif type_util.is_string(npc_info.anim_info) then
					scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_info.anim_info, one_shot_sfx = false })
				end
			end
		end

		if npc_info.anim_time_scale ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, npc_info.anim_time_scale)
		end

		if npc_info.alpha_value ~= nil then
			local alpha_duration = 0

			if npc_info.alpha_duration ~= nil then
				alpha_duration = npc_info.alpha_duration
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, npc_info.alpha_value, alpha_duration)
		end

		if npc_info.keep_shake_magnitude ~= nil then
			character_util.shake(npc, npc_info.keep_shake_magnitude, 99999)
		end

		if npc_info.sorting_layer ~= nil then
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(npc, 'Default', npc_info.sorting_layer)
		end

		if npc_info.active_shadow ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_shadow(npc, npc_info.active_shadow)
		end

		if npc_info.tint ~= nil then
			local tint_color_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_info.tint.color_magnitude, 1)

			character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, npc_info.tint.color, tint_color_magnitude, 0.1)
		end

		if npc_info.talk ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_info.talk) then
			if not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()

				logger_util.log(npc.Name .. ' Interactable changed NPCInteractable')
			end

			npc.Interactable.Talk = npc_info.talk
		end

		if npc_info.talk_sfx ~= nil and type_util.is_string(npc_info.talk_sfx) then
			npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = npc_info.talk_sfx
		end

		if npc_info.equip_item ~= nil then
			local slot

			if npc_info.equip_item.item_1_name ~= nil then
				slot = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_info.equip_item.item_1_slot, 'item1')

				character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, slot, npc_info.equip_item.item_1_name)
			end

			if npc_info.equip_item.item_2_name ~= nil then
				slot = lua_helper.get_or_default(npc_info.equip_item.item_2_slot, 'item2')

				character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, slot, npc_info.equip_item.item_2_name)
			end
		end

		npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	end

	-- 파라메터로 받은 이름과 같은 그룹 내 동적 생성 멤버(NPC) 반환
	---@param member_name string 동적 생성 NPC 이름
	function character_place_group:get_dynamic_member(member_name)
		if not self.activated then
			return nil
		end

		while not self.dynamic_npc_created do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		local dynamic_npc = self.dynamic_member_list[member_name]

		if dynamic_npc then
			return dynamic_npc
		end

		return nil
	end

	-- 그룹 종료 처리 - 일반 캐릭터 비활성 및 동적 캐릭터 해제
	function character_place_group:exit()
		local function reset_npc_state(npc)
			-- 애니 스케일 값 초기화
			character_util.set_anim_time_scale(npc, 1)

			-- 애니, 이모션 초기화
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

			-- 알파 초가화
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(npc, 1, 0)

			-- 컬러 초기화
			character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.Name, 0)

			-- shake 초기화
			character_util.stop_shake(npc)

			-- attachment 장비 해제
			character_util.spine_remove_attachment(npc, 'item1')
			character_util.spine_remove_attachment(npc, 'item2')

			-- 회전 값, 스케일 값 초기화
			character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_scale(npc, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)

			-- Interactable 관련 초기화
			if lua_helper.type_compare(npc.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
				if npc.Interactable.Talk ~= nil then
					npc.Interactable.Talk = nil
				end

				if npc.Interactable.TalkSfx ~= nil then
					npc.Interactable.TalkSfx = nil
				end
			end

			npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

			-- 비활성화
			field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.disabled)
			npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		linq(self.member_infos):foreach(function(_, npc_info)
			local get_placement_npc = function()
				-- 파티 리더와 기사, 페이, 메이 처리
				if npc_info.name == 'leader' then
					return get_party_leader()
				elseif npc_info.name == 'knight' then
					return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
				elseif npc_info.name == 'china_hero' then
					return user_util.get_china_hero_character('china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl')
				end

				return get_character(npc_info.name)
			end

			local npc = get_placement_npc()

			if npc == nil then
				logger_util.log(string.format('[CharacterPlaceController] character_place_group:exit - Deactive Group Failed [Name : %s].', npc_info.name))
			end

			reset_npc_state(npc)
		end)

		-- 동적 생성 NPC disabled
		if self.dynamic_member_list ~= nil then
			for _, npc in pairs(self.dynamic_member_list) do
				reset_npc_state(npc)
			end

			self.dynamic_member_list = nil
			self.dynamic_npc_created = false
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local event_group_base = newclass('OneLineEventGroupBase')
local M = {}

local cleared_value = 'clear'

local dispose_actions = {
	speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end
}

local get_position = function(data)
	if type_util.is_table(data) then
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data.pivot) + data.offset
	else
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(data)
	end
end

function event_group_base:init(npc_pooling_system, constants)
	---@type LuaNpcPoolingSystem
	self.npc_pooling_system = npc_pooling_system

	---@type table<string, LuaNpcPoolHandler>
	self.pooled_npc_handlers = {}

	self.cached_item_list = {}

	self.activated = false

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	if constants ~= nil then
		self.condition_data = constants.condition
		self.member_infos = constants.members
		self.item_infos = constants.items
	end
end

function event_group_base:dispose()
	self.npc_pooling_system = nil
	self.condition_data = nil
	self.member_infos = nil
	self.item_infos = nil
	self.cached_item_list = nil
end

function event_group_base:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)
	if self.condition_data == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.condition_data.progress_infos do
		local info = self.condition_data.progress_infos[i]

		if info.from == cleared_value then
			if cleared then
				return true
			end
		elseif info.to == cleared_value then
			if info.from <= progress or cleared then
				return true
			end
		elseif info.from <= progress and progress <= info.to and not cleared then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

---@return LuaNpcPoolHandler
function event_group_base:get_handler(name)
	return self.pooled_npc_handlers[name]
end

function event_group_base:get_item_handler(name)
	return self.cached_item_list[name]
end

function event_group_base:wait_for_sec(duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration

	while self.activated and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function event_group_base:enter()
	if self.member_infos ~= nil then
		for npc_name, npc_info in pairs(self.member_infos) do
			local position = get_position(npc_info.position)
			local is_fly = type_util.is_table(npc_info.position) and npc_info.position.is_fly or false
			local handler = self.npc_pooling_system:get_npc_handler(npc_info.key, position, npc_info.direction, is_fly)

			if npc_info.set_attachment ~= nil then
				handler:set_attachment(npc_info.set_attachment)
			end

			if npc_info.skin ~= nil then
				handler:change_skin(npc_info.skin)
			end

			if npc_info.anim ~= nil then
				handler:set_anim(self, npc_info.anim)
			end

			if npc_info.emotion ~= nil then
				handler:set_emotion(self, npc_info.emotion)
			end

			if npc_info.talk ~= nil then
				if type_util.is_table(npc_info.talk) then
					local talk_table = npc_info.talk
					handler:set_one_line(talk_table.key, talk_table.sfx, talk_table.talk_scale, talk_table.bubble_type)
				else
					handler:set_one_line(npc_info.talk)
				end
			elseif npc_info.emoticon ~= nil then
				if type_util.is_table(npc_info.emoticon) then
					handler:set_emoticon(npc_info.emoticon.key, npc_info.emoticon.sfx)
				else
					handler:set_emoticon(npc_info.emoticon)
				end
			end

			if npc_info.shake ~= nil and npc_info.shake > 0 then
				handler:set_shake(npc_info.shake)
			end

			self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = handler
		end
	end

	if self.item_infos ~= nil then
		for key, item in pairs(self.item_infos) do
			if item.item_id > 0 then
				-- 혹시 키가 겹치는 아이템이 있다면 해당 아이템 dispose 하고 새로 세팅
				if self.cached_item_list[key] ~= nil then
					quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.cached_item_list[key])
				end

				local item_obj = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item.item_id,
					pos = get_position(item.position),
					spr_scale = item.scale,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
				})

				self.cached_item_list[key] = item_obj
			end
		end
	end
end

function event_group_base:exit()
	for npc_name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
		handler:dispose()

		self.pooled_npc_handlers[npc_name] = nil
	end

	for key, item in pairs(self.cached_item_list) do
		if item ~= nil then
			quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.cached_item_list[key])
			self.cached_item_list[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

---@param action fun(name:string, handler:LuaNpcPoolHandler, npc:ICharacter)
function event_group_base:foreach(action)
	if not self.activated then
		return
	end

	for name, handler in pairs(self.pooled_npc_handlers) do
		action(name, handler, handler:get_npc())
	end
end

---@param handler LuaNpcPoolHandler
function event_group_base:show_stoppable_speech_async(handler, key, data)
	local talker = handler:get_npc()

	if talker == nil then
		return
	end

	if data == nil then
		data = {}
	end

	data.key = key

	handler:add_dispose_action('speech', dispose_actions.speech)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, data)

	if self.activated then
		handler:add_dispose_action('speech', nil)
	end
end

function M.make_event_group(name)
	return newclass('OneLineEventGroup' .. name, event_group_base)
end

function M.get_base_event_group()
	return event_group_base
end

return M

---@class QuestOneLineController
local local_class = newclass('QuestOneLineController')

local event_group_creator = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Etc/QuestOneLineController/OneLineEventGroup')

local always_active_group_name = 'always_active'

function local_class:init()
	self.event_groups = {}

	self.target_quest_id = -1

	self.cur_zone_name = ''

	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:initialize(target_quest_id, custom_event_groups, constants_path)
	self.target_quest_id = target_quest_id

	-- NpcPoolingSystem 세팅
	local _, npc_pooling_system = global_table_util.try_create_npc_pooling_system()

	local init_event_groups = function(constants)
		for zone_name, group_constants in pairs(constants) do
			self.event_groups[zone_name] = {}

			for group_name, v in pairs(group_constants) do
				-- 커스텀 이벤트 그룹 찾아보기
				local custom_group_data = custom_event_groups[group_name]

				-- 커스텀 그룹 정보가 있다면 그걸로 세팅 아니면 베이스 그룹으로 세팅
				local creator = custom_group_data or event_group_creator.get_base_event_group()

				-- 그룹 생성
				local group = creator(npc_pooling_system, v)

				-- 등록
				self.event_groups[zone_name][group_name] = group
			end
		end
	end

	-- Constant 정보에 맞게 등록
	local constants = get_or_create_global_variable(constants_path)
	npc_pooling_system:init_pools(constants.pools)
	init_event_groups(constants.groups)

	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_quest_cleared_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent), 'on_quest_progressed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestProgressedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_groups()
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	self:reset_group()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		return false
	end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if self.cur_zone_name == zone_name then
		return false
	end

	if not table_util.contain_key(self.event_groups, zone_name) then
		return false
	end

	local is_contain_zone = false

	for key, _ in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		if self:is_in_zone(key, zone_name) then
			is_contain_zone = true
			break
		end
	end

	if not is_contain_zone then
		return false
	end

	self.cur_zone_name = zone_name
	self:reset_group()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_in_zone(cur_key, cur_zone_name)
	local function string_contains()
		return cur_key:find(always_active_group_name, 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	return string_contains() or (cur_key == cur_zone_name)
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self:dispose_groups()
end

function local_class:on_quest_progressed_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.target_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:reset_group()
end

function local_class:on_quest_cleared_event(e)
	if e.QuestId ~= self.target_quest_id then
		return false
	end

	return self:reset_group()
end

function local_class:reset_group(overriden_progress, overriden_cleared)
	if self.is_pause then
		return
	end

	local main_quest = quest_util.get_started_quest(self.target_quest_id)

	local progress = -1
	local cleared = false

	if main_quest ~= nil then
		progress = main_quest.InnerProgress
		cleared = main_quest.IsComplete
	end

	if overriden_progress ~= nil then
		progress = overriden_progress
	end

	if overriden_cleared ~= nil then
		cleared = overriden_cleared
	end

	local groups_to_init = {}
	local groups_to_dispose = {}

	for zone_name, groups in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for _, group in pairs(groups) do
			local is_activated = group.activated
			local is_valid = self:is_in_zone(zone_name, self.cur_zone_name) and group:is_valid_condition(progress, cleared)

			if not is_activated and is_valid then
				groups_to_init[#groups_to_init + 1] = group
			elseif is_activated and not is_valid then
				groups_to_dispose[#groups_to_dispose + 1] = group
			end
		end
	end

	for _, group in ipairs(groups_to_dispose) do
		self:deactivate_group(group)
	end

	for _, group in ipairs(groups_to_init) do
		self:activate_group(group)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:activate_group(group)
	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()
end

function local_class:deactivate_group(group)
	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false
end

function local_class:activate_group_for_name(zone_name, group_name)
	local zone_groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if zone_groups == nil then
		return
	end

	local group = zone_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or group.activated then
		return
	end

	group.activated = true
	group:enter()
end

function local_class:deactivate_group_for_name(zone_name, group_name)
	local zone_groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if zone_groups == nil then
		return
	end

	local group = zone_groups[group_name]

	if group == nil or not group.activated then
		return
	end

	group:exit()
	group.activated = false
end

function local_class:get_group(zone_name, group_name)
	local groups = self.event_groups[zone_name]

	if groups == nil then
		return nil
	end

	for key, group in pairs(groups) do
		if key == group_name and group ~= nil and group.activated then
			return group
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:dispose_groups()
	if self.event_groups == nil then
		return
	end

	for key, v in pairs(self.event_groups) do
		for _, group in pairs(v) do
			self:deactivate_group(group)
			group:dispose()
		end

		self.event_groups[key] = nil
	end

	self.event_groups = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end,
}

---@class IStreamingUI
---@field load_async fun(self:self)
---@field speech fun(self:self, talker_name : string, string_key : string, skip : boolean):string, string, boolean
---@field speech_async fun(self:self, talker_name : string, string_key : string, skip : boolean):string, string, boolean
---@field show fun(self:self, duration : number):number
---@field hide fun(self:self, duration : number):number

---@class StreamingUI : IStreamingUI
local local_class = newclass('StreamingUI')

function local_class:init()
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.is_load_complete = false

	-- ui 프리팹 번들이름 에셋이름
	self.bundle_name = 'ondemand/memorial_magical_girl/ui'
	self.asset_name = 'StreamingUI'

	-- 캐릭터 일러스트 번들이름 / 에셋 이름
	self.illust_bundle_name = nil
	self.illust_asset_name = nil

	-- c# 컴포넌트
	self.ui_obj = nil
	self.cs_streaming_ui = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(self.ui_obj) then
		self.cs_streaming_ui:Dispose()
		self.cs_streaming_ui = nil

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ui_obj)
		self.ui_obj = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.is_load_complete = false
end

function local_class:load_async(ui_bundle_name, ui_aseet_name, illust_bundle_name, illust_asset_name)
	if self.is_load_complete then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, ui_bundle_name, ui_aseet_name, function(prefab)
				self.ui_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.cs_streaming_ui = self.ui_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.StreamingUI))
			end)

	yield_return_func(self.cs_streaming_ui.Load, self.cs_streaming_ui, illust_bundle_name, illust_asset_name)

	local contents = self.cs_streaming_ui.SubtitleContents
	contents.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.is_load_complete = true
end

function local_class:show(duration)
	local contents = self.cs_streaming_ui.SubtitleContents

	contents.localScale = vector(1, 0, 1)
	contents.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local time_passed = 0
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.5)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutBack(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
		contents.localScale = vector(1, 1 * progress, 1)

		-- 앵커 업데이트
		self.cs_streaming_ui:UpdateAnchors()
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	contents.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	self.cs_streaming_ui:UpdateAnchors()
end

function local_class:speech(talker_name, string_key, skip)
	skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true)
	start_coroutine(self.cs_streaming_ui.ShowText, self.cs_streaming_ui, talker_name, string_key, skip)
end

function local_class:speech_async(talker_name, string_key, skip)
	skip = lua_helper.get_or_default(skip, true)
	yield_return_func(self.cs_streaming_ui.ShowText, self.cs_streaming_ui, talker_name, string_key, skip)
end

function local_class:hide(duration)
	local contents = self.cs_streaming_ui.SubtitleContents
	contents.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	local time_passed = 0
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.5)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInBack(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
		contents.localScale = vector(1, 1 - (1 * progress), 1)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	contents.localScale = vector(1, 0, 1)
	contents.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:radio_password_scene()
	local password = { 0, 4, 2, 1 }
	local success_count = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')

	--라디오에서 희미한 소리가 들린다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_narration_16' })

	--사… 군… 것….다…
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_narration_16_2' })

	do
		--선택지
		--주파수를 맞춘다.(회색)
		--떠난다.(회색)
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_1', 'normal' },
			{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_2', 'normal' },
		})

		if result == 2 then
			return false
		end
	end

	do
		for idx = 1, #password do
			--선택지
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_3', 'normal' },
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_4', 'normal' },
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_5', 'normal' },
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_6', 'normal' },
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_7', 'normal' },
				{ 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_choose_8', 'normal' },
			})

			if result - 1 == password[idx] then
				success_count = success_count + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if success_count == #password then
		--나레이션 박스 출력
		--지지직…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_narration_16_3' })

		--우리 사울은 강력한 군사를 바탕으로 그 누구에게도 굴복하지 않게 나아갈 것입니다!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_narration_16_4' })


		--성공 시
		self:puzzle_clear_scene()

		self.get_second_item(16).Position = self.wait_pos

		self.is_clear = true
	else
		--실패 시  아래와 같이 나레이션 박스 출력
		--아무 소리도 나지 않는다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_agit_s1_second_room_narration_16_1' })
	end
end

function local_class:puzzle_clear_scene()
	--도어 쪽으로 카메라 포커스 되며 오픈 연출
	local camera_pos = self.get_door_pos()

	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s1_door_1', false))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		interacted_bro = 2,
		clear = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_young_bro = function() return get_character('brotherhood_young_bro') end

	self.get_police = function() return get_character('brotherhood_police') end

	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	self.letter_id = 21085

	self.ended_setting = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_young_bro()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interacted_bro
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.talk_to_young_bro_scene, self, true)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.interacted_bro then
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.talk_to_young_bro_scene, self, false)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 's11_start' then
		self:set_young_bro_oneline()
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 's12_start' then
		self:set_young_bro_event()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(357)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = main_quest_progress.InnerProgress

	if main_quest_inner_progress == 10 then
		self:set_young_bro_oneline()
	elseif main_quest_inner_progress > 10 then
		self:set_young_bro_event()
	end
end

function local_class:set_young_bro()
	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()
	local police = self.get_police()
	local police_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('brotherhood_police_pos')

	self.controller:set_young_bro()
	character_util.set_direction(young_bro, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(young_bro, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired'})

	character_util.set_active_state(police, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(police, police_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(police, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(police, { name = 'cross_arm' })
end

function local_class:set_young_bro_oneline()
	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()
	local police = self.get_police()

	self:set_young_bro()
	-- 전 이제 어떻게 되나요…?
	young_bro.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_brotherhood_pre_1'
	-- 항복하신 분들은 몇가지 절차만 거치신 후에 민간으로 돌아가시게 될 거에요.
	police.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_brotherhood_pre_2'
end

function local_class:set_young_bro_event()
	if self.ended_setting then
		return
	end
	self.ended_setting = true

	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()
	local police = self.get_police()

	self:set_young_bro()

	young_bro.Interactable.Talk = ''
	police.Interactable.Talk = ''

	self.star_piece_effect = self.controller.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(young_bro.Position)

function local_class:talk_to_young_bro_scene(first_talk)

	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local police = self.get_police()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(young_bro, self.controller)

	wp_util.move_async(knight, young_bro.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	if first_talk then
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(knight, '01_small_jump_01')

		-- 여기 잠입한 사울 병사가 있다!
		-- 죽여주마! 사울 쥐새끼!

			{ 'cw_brotherhood_pre_3', 'forced' },
			{ 'cw_brotherhood_pre_4', 'brutal' },
		})

		character_util.remove_anim(police)
		character_util.set_direction(young_bro, 'left')
		scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, 'cast')
		scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'surprise')

		if result == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'embarrassed', sfx_name= nil})
			--scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, {name = 'embarrassed', sfx_name = false })
			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'scared')

			scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'shoot')

			scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'mad')
			wait_for_sec(1)
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)

		scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'tired')
		-- 오, 오해에요…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'relase', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_5')
		-- 저는 항복한 포로라고요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_6')

		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 애초에 억지로 끌려온 거… 항복하면 바로 민간으로 돌려보내 준다길래 바로 항복했어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_7')
		-- 몇가지 서류만 작성하시고 나면 바로 돌려보내 드릴거에요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(police, self, nil, { name = 'nod', count = 2 }, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_8')
		-- 저… 혹시 괜찮으시면 부탁 하나 드려도 될까요?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_9')

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 사실 제가 징집될 때 저희 형도 같이 징집됐었는데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_10')
		-- 항복할 때 경황이 없어서 형한테 제대로 말도 못하고 와버렸어요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_11')
		-- 형은 아마 제가 잡혀갔거나… 죽은 줄 알고 많이 걱정하고 있을 거에요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'shoot', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_12')
		-- 그래서 무사히 잘 있다는 편지를 보내려고 하는데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_13')
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, 'sing')
	-- 혹시 사울에 가시게 된다면 이 편지를 저희 형한테 전달해주실 수 있을까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_14')

	-- 맡겨만 두라고!
	-- 급한 일이 있어서…
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'cw_brotherhood_pre_15', 'mercy' },
		{ 'cw_brotherhood_pre_16', 'normal' },
	})

	if result == 1 then
		scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, 'push')
		scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'smile')

		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'victory_get')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'smile')
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		character_util.remove_anim(knight)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		character_util.remove_anim(young_bro)

		local letter = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = young_bro.Position,
			                                         target = knight.Position + vector(0.5, 0 , 0),
			                                         itemid = self.letter_id, notforinven = true,
													 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })

		scene_util.set_anim_async(young_bro, self, { name = 'release', count = 1,sfx_name = '01_throw_01'})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		letter.ConsumeTarget = knight
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 감사합니다. 부탁드릴게요…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'sing', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_17')

		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'bomb_idle')
		scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')

		character_util.remove_anim(young_bro)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		-- 혹시 마음 바뀌시면 다시 말씀해 주세요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_pre_18')

		character_util.add_listener(young_bro, self.controller)

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarBrotherhoodSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarBrotherhood @
		Comment = CivilWarBrotherhood 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	---@type CivilWarBrotherhood
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = { 'civilwar_2', 'civilwar_5' }

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		entered_door_open_zone = 2,
		entered_brother_zone = 3,
		clear_battle = 4,
		read_diary = 5,
		clear = 6,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_young_bro = function() return get_character('brotherhood_young_bro') end

	self.get_brother = function() return get_character('brotherhood_brother') end

	self.diary_id = 21086

	self.stage_ended = false

	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	self.star_piece_name = 'brotherhood_star_piece_2'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	if stage.Name == 'civilwar_5' then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_brother()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.clear_battle then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.read_diary
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.read_diary_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, 'brotherhood_door_open_event') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_door_open_zone
		start_coroutine(self.open_door_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, 'brotherhood_brother_event') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.entered_door_open_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_brother_zone
		start_coroutine(self.brother_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_brother()) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.entered_brother_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear_battle
		start_coroutine(self.clear_brother_battle, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.stage_ended = true
	return true
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	if stage.Name == 'civilwar_2' then
		self:set_young_bro()
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
end

function local_class:set_young_bro()
	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()

	self.controller:set_young_bro()
	character_util.set_direction(young_bro, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(young_bro, { name = 'smile' })
	self.star_piece_effect = self.controller.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(young_bro.Position)

	young_bro.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_brotherhood_pre_17'
end

function local_class:open_door_scene()
	local soldier_1 = get_character('brotherhood_soldier_1')
	local soldier_2 = get_character('brotherhood_soldier_2')
	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('brotherhood_soldier_pos')

	local brother = self.get_brother()
	character_util.set_position(brother, field_util.get_marker_pos('brotherhood_brother_pos'))
	character_util.set_direction(brother, 'left')

	character_util.set_position(soldier_1, pos)
	character_util.set_position(soldier_2, pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, { name = 'tired' })

	wp_util.move(soldier_1, soldier_1.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), nil, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(soldier_2, soldier_2.Position + vector(4, 0, 0), nil, 1)

	character_util.set_direction(soldier_1, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_1, self, 'embarrassed')
	scene_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, self, 'damaged')
	-- 어후… 난 못 보고 있겠다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_1' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_1, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(soldier_1, self, 'tired')
	-- 아무리 적군이라지만 저건 좀 심하지 않아?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_2' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_1, self, 'release')
	-- 멀쩡하던 사람이 갑자기 왜 저러는거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_3' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)
	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_2, self, 'release')
	-- 너 몰라? 지난번 전투에서 동생이 실종됐다잖아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_2, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_4' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_2, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.set_emotion(soldier_2, self, 'tired')
	-- 저 인간이 평소에 동생을 얼마나 아꼈는데… 하루아침에 가족을 잃었으니 완전히 돌아버린거지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_2, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_5' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_2)
	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_1, self, 'release')
	-- 아무리 그래도 그렇지 사람이 저렇게 180도 바뀐다고?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_1, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_6' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(soldier_1)
	scene_util.set_anim(soldier_2, self, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	-- 그렇다니까… 아무튼 우린 잠깐 빠져 있자고. 괜히 근처에 있다가 불똥 튈라.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(soldier_2, { key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_7' })

	if self.stage_ended then
		return
	end

	wp_util.move_async(soldier_1, soldier_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), nil, 1, { last_direction = 'left' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('brotherhood_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('brotherhood_door_2', false))
end

function local_class:brother_scene()
	self.controller.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local brother = self.get_brother()

	-- 리리스의 졸개 놈들…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(brother, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s1_12')

	scene_util.set_anim(brother, self, {name = 'attack', sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01'})

	camera_util.move_async(brother.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(brother, 'right')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.1)

function local_class:clear_brother_battle()
	local brother = self.get_brother()

	self.controller.cw_util:set_windpot_active(true)

	character_util.set_side_direction(brother)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('brotherhood_battle_gate_1', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('brotherhood_battle_gate_2', true))

	character_util.convert_to_npc(brother)
	character_util.set_anim(brother, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	character_util.add_color(brother, brother.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.8, 2)
	character_util.add_listener(brother, self.controller)

	self.star_piece_effect = self.controller.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(brother.Position)
end

function local_class:read_diary_scene()

	local brother = self.get_brother()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('brotherhood_brother_pos')
	local align_offset = vector(1, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(brother, self.controller)

	-- 몬스터의 위치가 랜덤이니 중앙 기준 왼쪽일 경우 오른쪽 정렬, 오른쪽일 경우 왼쪽 정렬
	if brother.Position.x > center_pos.x then
		align_offset = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	local move_key = 'party_align'
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(user_party[i], brother.Position + (align_offset * (i+1)),
				nil, 1, self, move_key, {
			end_callback = function()
				character_util.look_at(user_party[i], brother)
			end
		})
	end
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	local diary = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = brother.Position,
		                                         target = brother.Position + (align_offset * 0.5),
		                                         itemid = self.diary_id, notforinven = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	diary.ConsumeTarget = knight
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 첫번째 페이지
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_19' })
	-- 동생과 함께 사울 정규군에 강제로 징집되었다. 곧 주지사님께서 전쟁을 일으키신다나 뭐라나…
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_20' })
	-- 난 정치 같은건 잘 모른다. 그저 동생이랑 내가 무사히 집에 돌아갈 수만 있었으면 좋겠다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_21' })
	-- 두번째 페이지
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_22' })
	-- 흥미로운 이야기를 들었다. 뛰어난 전공을 세워 훈장을 받으면 보상으로 전역할 수 있다는 것이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_23' })
	-- 희망이 보인다. 동생아… 넌 내가 꼭 돌려보내줄게.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_24' })
	-- 세번째 페이지
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_25' })
	-- 동생이 보이지 않는다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_26' })
	-- 시야에서 놓쳐선 안됐는데. 전장 깊숙히 들어가면 안됐는데. 후방으로 빠져 있었어야 했는데. 옆에 계속 붙어있었어야 했는데.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_27' })
	-- 나 때문이야. 괜히 훈장 같은걸 받겠다고 설쳐가지고…
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_28' })
	-- ……
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_29' })
	-- …더러운 리리스의 졸개 자식들.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_30' })
	-- 한놈도 빠짐없이 전부 죽여주마.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_31' })
	-- 이후의 내용들은 글자를 알아볼 수 없다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s1_32' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, brother.Position, center_pos)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	brother.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarBrotherhoodSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarBrotherhood @
		Comment = CivilWarBrotherhood 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	---@type CivilWarBrotherhood
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_2'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		interacted_bro = 2,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.get_young_bro = function() return get_character('brotherhood_young_bro') end

	self.star_piece_effect = nil
	self.star_piece_effect_parent = nil

	self.star_piece_name = 'brotherhood_star_piece'

	self.diary_id = 21086
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self:set_young_bro_event()
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect.transform.parent = self.star_piece_effect_parent
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
		self.star_piece_effect_parent = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_young_bro()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interacted_bro
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.talk_to_young_bro_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_young_bro_event()
	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()

	self.controller:set_young_bro()
	character_util.set_direction(young_bro, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(young_bro, { name = 'smile' })

	self.star_piece_effect = self.controller.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(young_bro.Position)
	self.star_piece_effect_parent = self.star_piece_effect.transform.parent
	self.star_piece_effect.transform.parent = young_bro.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	character_util.add_listener(young_bro, self.controller)
end

function local_class:talk_to_young_bro_scene()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local young_bro = self.get_young_bro()
	local knight = get_party_leader()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(young_bro, self.controller)

	wp_util.move_async(knight, young_bro.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	scene_util.set_emotion(knight, self, 'tired')

	-- 돌아오셨군요! 저희 형은 만나고 오셨나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_1')

	choose_util.play_choose_event({{ 'cw_brotherhood_s2_2', 'normal' }})

	local diary = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = knight.Position,
		                                         target = young_bro.Position + vector(-0.5, 0 , 0),
		                                         itemid = self.diary_id, notforinven = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	diary.ConsumeTarget = young_bro
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 음? 이건…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_3')

	scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, 'cross_arm')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 아, 이건 저희 형의 일기장이군요!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_4')
	-- 형은 예전부터 매일 일기를 쓰는 습관이 있었거든요…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_5')

	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(young_bro, 0.5)
	-- …잠깐. 이거 내용이…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, 'tired', 'cw_brotherhood_s2_6')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(young_bro, 0.2)
	scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'scared')
	-- …오, 이런 젠장.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_7')

	character_util.set_anim_time_scale(young_bro, 1)
	-- 대체 저희 형한테 무슨 일이 벌어진거죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_8')

	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'cw_brotherhood_s2_9', 'mercy' },
		{ 'cw_brotherhood_s2_10', 'intellect' },
	})

	scene_util.set_anim_async(knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

	scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'tired')
	-- 아… 역시…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_11')

	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'sing' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)

	-- 아니에요. 전쟁에서 사람들이 죽어 나가는건 당연한 거니까…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_12')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 형은…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_heroic_moment', state = 'event', mix = 2, volume = 0.5, })
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_13')
	-- 정말 가족들을 위해 살아왔던 사람이에요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_14')
	-- 없는 살림에도 절 대학에 보내겠다고… 어린 나이부터 궂은 일을 도맡아 하며 제 등록금을 벌어다 줬었죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_15')

	character_util.shake(young_bro, 0.03, 0.3)
	-- 이젠 내가 형 호강 시켜줄 차례였는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_16')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(young_bro, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, 'hurt')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'cry')
	-- 같이 무사히 돌아가자고 약속 했었잖아…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_17')
	-- 왜 그런거야… 나 여기 살아 있단 말이야…!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_18')
	-- 이제 행복할 일만 남았는데 이렇게 가버리면 어떡하냐고…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_19')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 내 잘못이야... 내가 여기 잡혀 오지만 않았어도...
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_20')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(young_bro, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(young_bro, 0.03, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.remove_anim(young_bro)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wp_util.move_async(young_bro, young_bro.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.25)
	scene_util.set_anim(young_bro, self, { name = 'push' })

	-- 살려 내...!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_21')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	-- 우리 형 살려 내라고...!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil,
			{ key = 'cw_brotherhood_s2_22', scale = 1.3, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	scene_util.set_emotion(young_bro, self, 'tired')
	character_util.set_position(young_bro, young_bro.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.remove_anim(young_bro)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- ...죄송해요. 안 좋은 모습을 보여드렸네요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_23')
	-- ……
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_24')
	-- 어쩔 수 없는 상황이었다는 것도, 당신에게 뭐라 할 수 없다는 것도 알지만...
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'release', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_25')
	-- ...아직은 생각을 정리할 시간이 필요할 것 같네요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, nil, 'cast', nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_26')

	self.star_piece_effect.transform.parent = self.star_piece_effect_parent
	self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
	self.star_piece_effect = nil
	self.star_piece_effect_parent = nil

	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, young_bro.Position, young_bro.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 이걸 받고... 이만 돌아가 주세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(young_bro, self, 'right', nil, nil, 'cw_brotherhood_s2_27')

	young_bro.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_brotherhood_s2_26'
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 1 })

	quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_init()

		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section4')
	}
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	-- ObjectPool PreLoad가 필요할 때 뒤에 인자로 주르륵 넣는다
	-- ex) yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'bla1', 'bla2')
	--yield_return_func(quest_util.load_pool_resource,'')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:load_progress()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_progress, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.pre_section_paper ~= nil then
		self.pre_section_paper:ConsumeComplete()
		self.pre_section_paper = nil
	end

	if self.pre_section_later ~= nil then
		self.pre_section_later:ConsumeComplete()
		self.pre_section_later = nil
	end
	
	if quest_util.is_available_section(self.current_section) then
		self.current_section:exit()
	end

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.sections = nil
	self.inter_section_params = nil
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

function local_class:start_scene()

	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_2')

	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_3')

	-- 프리실라(down,attack,idle): 이번 안건은 무엇보다 데몬샤이어의 명예가 걸린 일이니까.

	-- 비서(right,idle,nod2회): 그 동안 회의전에 서류를 한번 더 검토 해보시죠.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_secretary, self, 'right', 'nod', nil
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_6')

	-- 프리실라(down,idle,nod2회): 알겠어, 멜리사.

function local_class:vampire_captain_stops_half_vampire()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

function local_class:show_paper(index)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	if self.check_read_paper[index] == false then
		self.check_read_paper[index] = true
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.sub_quest_marker_name .. index)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

	if index == 1 then
		-- 리리스 정부는 현재 인베이더의 습격으로 많이 쇠퇴되어 있습니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_1_1' })

		-- 저희측에서 지원을 보낸다 하더라도 승리를 장담하기 힘든 상황입니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_1_2' })

		-- 만약 리리스 정부와 함께 패배한다면 그 결과는 감당할 수 없을겁니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_1_3' })
	elseif index == 2 then
		-- 클로드 님이 사라지고 도시가 복구된지 얼마되지 않았습니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_2_1' })

		-- 프리실라 님께서 주지사의 자리에 오른지 얼마 안되는 지금
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_2_2' })

		-- 무리하게 전쟁에 참전하는 것은 민심에 큰 타격이 갈 것입니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_2_3' })

	else
		-- 정부가 큰 타격을 입은 후 제 3 종족인 수인들의 세력이 커지고 있습니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_3_1' })

		-- 클로드 님께서 수인들의 과격한 시위를 한번 제압한 후 조용해졌지만…
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_3_2' })

		-- 얼마 없는 병력마저 전쟁에 투입된다면 그들이 어떤 자세로 나올지 모릅니다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_interact_3_3' })
	end

	local is_all_paper_read = true

	for i = 1, #self.check_read_paper do
		if self.check_read_paper[i] == false then
			is_all_paper_read = false
			break
		end
	end

	if is_all_paper_read == false then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		sp_util.exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
		return
	end

	self:directing_start_discussion()

function local_class:directing_start_discussion()

	-- 발렌시아(down,attack,idle): 조용! 아직 프리실라 님의 말씀이 끝나지 않았다!

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npcs['half_vampire'], half_vampire.Position - vector(0, 0, 1.5)

	-- 프리실라(down,tired,idle): 이번 사안은 그런 소극적인 태도로 해결될 일이 아닙니다.

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs['half_vampire'], 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_120')

	-- 프리실라(down,attack,idle): 내일까지 저희는 수인들을 종용해 병력에 합류시킬 겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'down', nil
	, 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_121')

	-- 프리실라(down,sleep_deep,idle): 그렇게 한다면 여러분들도 참전에 동의하시겠습니까?

	-- (1)(right,tired,question): 수인들이… 전쟁에 합류한다면…

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_1'], self, 'right', 'question'

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs['noble_4'], 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_124')

	-- (2)(right,attack,idle): 하지만 그 말씀은…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs['noble_2'], 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_125')
