	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'sleep_deep')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(npcs['half_vampire'], nil, 'silence')

	-- 프리실라(down,attack,idle): 물론입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'down', nil
	, 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_127')

	for i = 1, noble_count do

	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_3'], self, 'left', 'nod'
	, 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_128')

	-- 프리실라(left,idle,idle): 멜리사, 마계 정부에 곧 합류하겠다는 전보를 부탁해.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'left', nil
	, nil, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_128_1')

	-- 비서(right,sleep_deep,nod 끝에 정지): 알겠습니다.
	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs['vampire_secretary'], self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(npcs['vampire_secretary'], self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)
	npcs['vampire_secretary'].SpineController.TimeScale = 0

	npcs['vampire_secretary'].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs['vampire_secretary'])

	-- 프리실라(down,idle,idle): 발렌시아… 따라오세요.
	scene_util.set_direction(npcs['half_vampire'], 'down')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs['half_vampire'], 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_129')

	-- 발렌시아(left,sleep_deep,nod 끝에 정지): 알겠습니다.
	scene_util.set_direction(npcs['vampire_captain'], 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(npcs['vampire_captain'], self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(npcs['vampire_captain'], self, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(npcs['vampire_captain'], 'nod')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)
	npcs['vampire_captain'].SpineController.TimeScale = 0

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npcs['vampire_captain'], 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_130')
	npcs['vampire_captain'].SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs['vampire_captain'])

	-- 프리실라 발렌시아 (idle) 표정으로 (4)속도로 경로따라 이동한다.
	wp_util.move_async(npcs['vampire_captain'], npcs['vampire_captain'].Position - vector(1.5, 0, 0)
	, 2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	-- 동시에 (1)(2)는 (left)방향으로 속도 4 로 한칸 이동 (3)(4)는 (right)방향으로 속도 4로 한칸 이동 (보는 방향 고정으로 뒷걸음질로 이동한다.)
	for i = 1, noble_count do
		local noble = npcs['noble_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_emotion(noble)

		local is_left = i <= 2
		local target_pos = noble.Position + vector(is_left and -0.5 or 0.5, 0, 0)
		local lock_dir = is_left and 'right' or 'left'

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(noble, target_pos
		, 2, nil, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = lock_dir })
	end

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npcs['half_vampire'], npcs['half_vampire'].Position - vector(0, 0, 10)
	, 2, nil, self, move_end_key)

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npcs['vampire_captain'], npcs['vampire_captain'].Position - vector(0, 0, 10)
	, 2, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_pos = camera_pos - vector(0, 0, 6)
	camera_util.move(camera_pos, 3)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 발렌시아 파티멤버로 영입
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(npcs['vampire_captain'], user_party, true)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

	local function directing_game_over()
		-- 이때 프리실라 (down,surprise,idle)(jump1회) 1초
		scene_util.set_emotion(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(npcs['half_vampire'], true)

		-- (1)(right,mad,release): 지금 저희와 장난하시는 겁니까?!
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_1'], self, 'right', 'release'
		, 'mad', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_131')

		-- 이 후 프리실라 (tired) 표정
		scene_util.set_emotion(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'tired')

		-- (3)(left,tired,bomb_idle): 정말 무례하기 짝이 없군요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_03')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_3'], self, 'left', 'bomb_idle'
		, 'tired', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_132')

		-- (2)(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm): 이런 자리에서 같은 실수를 반복하다니… 어이가 없네요.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_2'], self, 'right', 'cross_arm'
		, 'sleep_deep', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_133')

		-- (4)(left,tired,nod2회): 시간낭비였군요. 저흰 이런 지휘관을 따를 수 없습니다.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_4'], self, 'left', 'nod'
		, 'tired', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_134')

		-- 프리실라(down,scared,release): 자, 잠시만 기다려주세요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'down', 'release'
		, { name = 'scared', keep = true }, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_135')
		scene_util.set_anim(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'cast')

		-- (1)(2)(right) 0.5칸 이동 (3)(4)(left) 0.5칸 이동 속도 4 하단으로 이동 속도 4
		local move_end_key = 'move_end'
		local noble_count = 4
		for i = 1, noble_count do
			local noble = npcs['noble_' .. i]

			local target_x = i <= 2 and 0.5 or -0.5
			wp_util.move_with_end_callback(noble, {
				noble.Position + vector(target_x, 0, 0),
				noble.Position + vector(target_x, 0, -6),
			}, 4, nil, self, move_end_key)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

		-- 서큘러 페이드 아웃 한 후 첫 선택지로 돌아온다. ( 영웅. / 예쁘잖아.)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs['half_vampire'])

		for i = 1, noble_count do
			local noble = npcs['noble_' .. i]
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(noble)
			scene_util.set_direction(noble, i <= 2 and 'right' or 'left', false)
			character_util.set_position(noble, field_util.get_marker_pos('s1_noble_pos_' .. i))
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		-- 발렌시아(left,idle,idle): 왜 그러십니까? 프리실라님.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['vampire_captain'], self, 'left', nil
		, nil, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_136')

		-- 프리실라(down,tired,idle): 흠…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'down', nil
		, { name = 'tired', keep = true }, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_137')

		-- 프리실라(down,tired,question): 뭔가 익숙한 기분이 드네요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['half_vampire'], self, 'down'
		, { name = 'question', keep = true }, nil, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_138')

		-- (1)(right,idle,release): 빨리 이번 사안을 결정해야하는 이유를 설명해주시죠!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npcs['noble_1'], self, 'right'
		, 'release', nil, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s1_139')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npcs['half_vampire'])
		scene_util.set_direction(npcs['vampire_captain'], 'down', false)
	end

	local answer_count = 1

	-- 이미 고른 선택지 제외하고 나올 선택지 리스트
	local branch_data_list = {}

	-- 클리어 했는지 여부
	local is_clear = false

	-- 실패 카운트
	local fail_count = 0

	-- 최대 실패 카운트 (까지 가면 실패 연출)
	local max_fail_count = 4

	while not self.is_stage_end and not is_clear do
		-- 실패 카운트가 4이상 됬다면 게임오버 연출 후 답변 카운트 1로 초기화
		if fail_count >= max_fail_count then
			directing_game_over()

			fail_count = 0
			answer_count = 1
		end

		local cur_answer_data = answer_data_list[answer_count]

		-- 선택지 세팅
		branch_data_list = {}
		for i = 1, #cur_answer_data do
			local answer = cur_answer_data[i]
			if answer.is_answer or answer.is_selected == false then
				table.insert(branch_data_list, { answer.key, answer.type })
			end
		end

		-- 선택지 출력
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branch_data_list)

		-- 선택한 값에 따라 choose_result 보정
		for i = 1, #cur_answer_data do
			local answer = cur_answer_data[i]
			if not answer.is_answer and answer.is_selected and choose_result >= i then
				choose_result = choose_result + 1
			end
		end

		-- 선택한 선택지데이터 선택했었다고 변경
		cur_answer_data[choose_result].is_selected = true

		-- 선택한 값에 따라 연출 보여줌
		self:directing_answer_result(answer_count, npcs, choose_result)

		-- 선택한 값이 정답이라면 answer_count + 1
		if cur_answer_data[choose_result].is_answer then
			answer_count = answer_count + 1

			-- 선택지 다 보았다면 탈출
			if answer_count > #answer_data_list then
				is_clear = true
				break
			end
		else
			-- 실패했다면 fail_count + 1
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 각 선택지별 결과 연출 세팅하는 함수
function local_class:directing_answer_result(index, npcs, choose_result)
	if index == 1 then
		self:first_answer_result(npcs, choose_result)
	elseif index == 2 then
		self:second_answer_result(npcs, choose_result)
	elseif index == 3 then
		self:third_answer_result(npcs, choose_result)
	elseif index == 4 then
		self:last_answer_result(npcs, choose_result)
	end
end

	-- 수인 병사 다이나믹 npc
	self.dynamic_npc_list = nil

end

	self.get_fx_last_hit()
end

function local_class:enter()
	for i = 1, self.max_one_line_count do
		local beast = self.get_one_line_beast(i)
		beast.Interactable.Talk = nil
	end

	self.dynamic_npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
		beast_soldier_1 = 'cw_werebeast_soldier_male',
		beast_soldier_2 = 'cw_werebeast_soldier_female',
	})

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.start_scene(self.start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_dynamic_npc_list()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.none and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_auto_event_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_first_auto_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_first_auto_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.enter_first_auto_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_auto_event_2') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_second_auto_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_second_auto_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.enter_second_auto_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_auto_event_3') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_third_auto_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_third_auto_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state <= self.section_state.enter_third_auto_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_enter_confined_area_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.enter_confined_area
		sp_util.start_scene(self.enter_confined_area, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.enter_confined_area and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_the_way_prison_zone_1') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.follow_sheep_girl_1
		sp_util.start_scene(self.first_follow_sheep_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.follow_sheep_girl_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's2_the_way_prison_zone_2') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.follow_sheep_girl_2
		sp_util.start_scene(self.last_scene_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	local half_vampire = self.get_half_vampire()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress >= 1 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.5 })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')

	local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(half_vampire)
	character_util.set_position(half_vampire, start_pos - vector(5, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(half_vampire, 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(vampire_captain)
	character_util.set_position(vampire_captain, start_pos - vector(4, 0, 0))
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'right', false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-23.11, 0, -64.5), 0)

	local move_end_key = 'move_end'
	local target_pos = start_pos + vector(3, 0, 0)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(half_vampire, target_pos - vector(1, 0, 0)
	, 3, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, target_pos
	, 3, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 해당 위치까지 이동 끝난 후
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 이때 발렌시아(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(vampire_captain, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(vampire_captain, true)

	-- 프리실라(right,tired,nod 0.2 속도로 1회): 후우… 
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, { name = 'nod', scale = 0.5, count = 1 }, { name = 'tired', keep = true }
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_1')

	-- 발렌시아(left,attack,release): 괜찮으십니까? 프리실라 님!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'left'
	, 'release', 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_2')

	-- 프리실라(right,tired,idle): 걱정마 발렌시아 긴장을 좀 많이 해서 그래…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(half_vampire, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_3')

	-- 프리실라(right,tired,seat): 한꺼번에 이렇게 많은 일들이 겹쳐서 조금 지친거야…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, { name = 'seat', keep = true, one_shot_sfx = '01_rustle_01' }
	, nil, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_4')

	-- 프리실라(right,sleep_deep,seat): 후우…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, nil, 'sleep_deep', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_5')

	-- 프리실라(right,smile,seat): 어땠어 발렌시아…? 나 괜찮았어?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, nil, 'smile', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_6')

	-- 발렌시아(left,attack,cast2): 그럼요! 마치 클로드 님을 보는 듯한 위엄이였습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'left'
	, 'cast2', 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_7')

	-- 프리실라(right,smile,seat): 고마워… 발렌시아.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, nil, 'smile', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_8')

	-- 프리실라(right,damaged,idle 0.2속도)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(half_vampire, 0.02, 1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(half_vampire, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(half_vampire, self, { name = 'idle', mix_duration = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(1.15)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(half_vampire)

	-- 발렌시아(right,attack,release): 가시죠 이 앞이 수인들의 본거지입니다!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, { dir = 'right', sfx = false }
	, 'release', 'attack', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_9')

	-- 프리실라(right,attack,cast): 좋아! 그럼 힘내서 가자!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right'
	, 'nod', 'smile', 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_10')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.05)

	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_sheep_girl_landing_pos_1') }
	}, nil, nil, true)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

-- 제한 구역에 들어왔을 때
function local_class:enter_confined_area()
	local half_vampire = self.get_half_vampire()
	local vampire_captain = self.get_vampire_captain()
	local sheep_girl = self.get_sheep_girl()

	local soldiers = {}
	local soldier_count = 2
	for i = 1, soldier_count do
		local soldier = self.dynamic_npc_list['beast_soldier_' .. i]
		scene_util.set_direction(soldier, 'left', false)
		scene_util.set_anim(soldier, self, 'get')
		character_util.set_position(soldier, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_ninja_beast_pos_' .. i))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldier, 0, 0)
		soldier.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

		character_util.set_active_state(soldier, 'enabled')
		table.insert(soldiers, soldier)
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('main_quest')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	-- 프리실라 발렌시아 해당 대열로 정렬 속도 4
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_align_pos_1')

	local move_end_key = 'move_end'

	-- 프리실라, 발렌시아 정렬
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(half_vampire, target_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 0.5)
	, 2.5, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, target_pos + vector(-2.5, 0, -0.5)
	, 2.5, nil, self, move_end_key, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 둘이 앞으로 같이 걸어감
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(half_vampire, target_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	, 2.5, nil, self, move_end_key)
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, target_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	, 2.5, nil, self, move_end_key)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- (1)(2)(left,idle,get)상태로 오브젝트에서 부터 y축 0.5높이 점프로 알파페이드로 해당 정렬로 나오게 된다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldiers[1], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(soldiers[1], 'left')
	character_util.jump_move(soldiers[1]
	, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_ninja_beast_pos_1') - vector(0, 0, 3)
	, 5, 1.5, false, 'left')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(soldiers[2], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(soldiers[2], 'left')
	character_util.jump_move(soldiers[2]
	, field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_ninja_beast_pos_2') + vector(0, 0, 3)
	, 5, 1.5, false, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 정렬 끝날때 (1)(2) 중앙 지점(x 1 / z -74.5) 지점에 fx_lasthit
	-- 화면 shake0.1 / 0.3 초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.15)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(1.25, 0.1, 0.1))

	-- 프리실라 발렌시아 (right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_emotion(half_vampire, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.normal_jump(half_vampire, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(vampire_captain, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		character_util.set_locked_dir(soldiers[i], 'none')
		character_util.remove_anim(soldiers[i])
	end

	-- 해당 (1)(2)가 정렬이 끝났다면 프리실라 발렌시아 (attack)표정으로 0.5칸을 속도1로 뒷걸음질 이동한다.
	scene_util.set_emotion(half_vampire, self, 'attack')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(half_vampire, half_vampire.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, 1, nil, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, self, 'attack')
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, vampire_captain.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, 1, nil, self, move_end_key, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	-- 이동 끝난 후
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- 프리실라(right,tired,cross_arm): 무슨일이죠?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right', 'cross_arm', 'tired'
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_17')

	-- (1)(left,idle,cross_arm): 이 앞은 수인들의 구역입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldiers[1], self, 'left', 'cross_arm', nil
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_18')

	-- (2)(left,idle,release): 다른 종족은 출입을 금하고 있습니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldiers[2], self, 'left', 'release', nil
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_19')

	-- 발렌시아(right,mad,release): 무엄하다! 감히 졸개 주제에 프리실라 님의 앞을 막다니!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'right', 'release', 'mad'
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_20')

	-- 이때 (1)(2)(scared)표정 (jump1회)
	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		local soldier = soldiers[i]
		scene_util.set_emotion(soldier, self, 'scared')
		character_util.normal_jump(soldier, true)
	end

	-- 이때 cwp_vampirecaptain 장착
	character_util.hide_weapon(vampire_captain, false)
	vampire_captain.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'sword_idle'
	vampire_captain.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'sword_walk'
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(vampire_captain, '[base]weapon1', 'cwp_vampirecaptain')
	-- 0.5칸 우측으로 이동
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(vampire_captain, vampire_captain.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, 0.5, nil, self, move_end_key)

	-- 발렌시아(right,attack,sword_idle): 정녕 피를 봐야 정신을 차릴 셈이냐?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sword_02')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(vampire_captain, self, 'right', nil
	, { name = 'attack', keep = true }, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_21')

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, move_end_key)

	-- (1)(left,scared,release): 자, 잠시만 저희도 그냥 보내드릴 순 없습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(soldiers[1], self, 'left', 'release', nil
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_22')

	-- 이때 발렌시아 (left,idle,sword_idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_captain)

	-- 프리실라(right,tired,idle): 발렌시아, 진정하세요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right', nil, 'tired'
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_23')

	-- 발렌시아(sleep_deep)표정 0.5초
	scene_util.set_emotion(vampire_captain, self, 'sleep_deep')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 발렌시아(right,idle,idle) 알겠습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(vampire_captain)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(vampire_captain, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_24')

	for i = 1, #soldiers do
		character_util.remove_emotion(soldiers[i])
	end

	-- 이때 cwp_vampirecaptain 장착 해제
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_sword_short_01')
	character_util.hide_weapon(vampire_captain, true)
	vampire_captain.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'nil'
	vampire_captain.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'nil'
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(vampire_captain, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	wp_util.move_async(vampire_captain, vampire_captain.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, 1, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	-- 프리실라(right,sleep_deep,nod2회) :저희는 이곳에 싸움이나 경고를 하기 위해 온 것이 아닙니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(half_vampire, self, 'right', 'nod', 'sleep_deep'
	, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_25')

	-- 프리실라(right,idle,idle): 여러분들의 리더와 이야기를 나누고 싶습니다.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(half_vampire, 'cw_sub_demon_shire_s2_26')

	-- (1)(down,idle,idle)(2)(up,idle,idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(soldiers[1], 'down')
	scene_util.set_direction(soldiers[2], 'up', false)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #soldiers do

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarDemonShireSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CivilWarDemonShire @
		Comment = 특수 감옥에 있는 양 수인 구출 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이 섹션이 유효한 스테이지 이름. 여러 스테이지에서 처리가 필요하다면 스트링 테이블로 넣을 것
	-- 지정하지 않는 경우(nil일 때)에는 현재 스테이지와 관계없이 항상 유효한 것으로 판단
	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_substage_demonshire'

	self.event_zone_name = 's3_special_prison_zone'

	-- character
	self.get_half_vampire = function() return get_character('half_vampire') end
	self.get_vampire_captain = function() return get_character('vampire_captain') end
	self.get_sheep_girl = function() return get_character('sheep_girl') end
	self.get_goat_girl = function() return get_character('goat_girl') end

	-- effect
	self.get_fx_explosion = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_vampirelord_clone_explosion') end
	self.get_fx_priscilla_buff_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_priscilla_buff_loop') end
	self.get_fx_knock_wave_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_vampirelord_knockwave') end

	self.is_ending = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_explosion()
	self.get_fx_priscilla_buff_effect()
	self.get_fx_knock_wave_effect()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local goat_girl = self.get_goat_girl()

	scene_util.set_emotion(goat_girl, self, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim(goat_girl, self, 'prostrate')
	scene_util.set_direction(goat_girl, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(goat_girl, field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_goat_pos_1'))
	character_util.set_active_state(goat_girl, 'enabled')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.add_auto_control('main_quest', {
		{ zone = 'main_field', target = get_field_object('prison_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'prison_field', target = get_field_object('special_prison_inner_1') },
		{ zone = 'special_prison_field', target = self.get_goat_girl() },
	}, nil, nil, true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_ending and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.event_zone_name) then

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()

	if self.is_directing_quest_clear == false then
		self:dispose_dynamic_npc_list()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_event_exit()) then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.ending_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local shoot_npc_event = newclass('CivilWarShootNpcEvent')
local hit_bullet_event = newclass('CivilWarHitBulletEvent')

--region shoot

function shoot_npc_event:init(controller, shoot_time, one_action_shoot_count)
	self.controller = controller

	self.npc_data_list = nil

	-- 한번 액션에 총 몇발 쏜것인지?
	self.one_action_shoot_count = one_action_shoot_count

	-- 총알 한방당 쏘는 시간
	self.shoot_time = shoot_time / one_action_shoot_count

	-- 현재 상태
	self.state = {
		shooting = 1,
		wait = 2,
		reload = 3,
	}

	self.bullet_volume = 0.3
end

function shoot_npc_event:enter(data_list)
	self.npc_data_list = data_list

	for _, data in pairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		data.cur_state = self.state.wait
		data.cur_shoot_bullet_count = 0
		data.time_passed = 0
		data.cur_shoot_count = 0
	end
end

function shoot_npc_event:update_frame(dt)
	for _, data in pairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		if data.cur_state == self.state.shooting then
			if data.time_passed >= self.shoot_time then
				data.time_passed = 0
				data.cur_shoot_bullet_count = data.cur_shoot_bullet_count + 1

				-- 총 발사
				if data.shoot_sfx_name then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = data.shoot_sfx_name, parent = data.shooter
					, volume = self.bullet_volume, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default' })
				end

				data.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(data.shooter.Bounds.center + data.dir * 10,
						vector(data.dir.x * 0.35, 0, 0.1), -1)

				if data.cur_shoot_bullet_count >= self.one_action_shoot_count then
					data.cur_shoot_count = data.cur_shoot_count + 1

					if data.cur_shoot_count >= 2 then
						data.cur_state = self.state.reload
						data.cur_shoot_count = 0
						if data.reload_sfx_name then
							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03', 0.3)
						end

						character_util.set_anim(data.shooter, {
							name = 'rifle_reload',
							loop = false,
							next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
					else
						data.cur_state = self.state.wait
						character_util.set_anim(data.shooter, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
					end
				end
			end
		elseif data.cur_state == self.state.wait then
			if data.time_passed >= 1 + data.start_delay then
				data.time_passed = 0
				data.cur_shoot_bullet_count = 0
				data.cur_state = self.state.shooting

				character_util.set_anim(data.shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot' })
			end
		elseif data.cur_state == self.state.reload then
			if data.time_passed >= 1.75 then
				data.time_passed = 0
				data.cur_shoot_bullet_count = 0
				data.cur_state = self.state.shooting
				character_util.set_anim(data.shooter, { name = 'rifle_shoot' })
			end
		end
	end
end

function shoot_npc_event:exit()
	self.npc_data_list = nil
end

function shoot_npc_event:dispose()
	self.npc_data_list = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

--endregion

function hit_bullet_event:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.state = {
		wait = 0,
		shoot = 1,
	}

	self.wait_time = 1

	self.speed = 13
end

function hit_bullet_event:enter(data_list)
	self.bullet_data_list = data_list

	for _, data in pairs(self.bullet_data_list) do
		data.time_passed = self.wait_time
		data.cur_state = self.state.wait

		local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(data.end_pos - data.start_pos, 0).magnitude
		data.duration = dist / self.speed
	end
end

function hit_bullet_event:update_frame(dt)
	for _, data in pairs(self.bullet_data_list) do
		data.time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

		if data.cur_state == self.state.wait then
			if data.time_passed >= self.wait_time + data.start_delay then
				data.time_passed = 0
				data.start_delay = 0
				data.cur_state = self.state.shoot
			end
		elseif data.cur_state == self.state.shoot then
			local progress = 1 - ((data.duration - data.time_passed) / data.duration)
			local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(data.start_pos, data.end_pos, progress)
			data.bullet.transform.position = current_pos

			if data.time_passed >= data.duration then
				data.cur_state = self.state.wait
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(data.end_pos + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
				data.bullet.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end
	end
end

function hit_bullet_event:exit()
	self.bullet_data_list = nil
end

function hit_bullet_event:dispose()
	self.bullet_data_list = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	shoot_npc_event = shoot_npc_event,
	hit_bullet_event = hit_bullet_event,
}

local mana_cannon = newclass('CivilWarManaCannon')

function mana_cannon:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- 마나 캐논 이팩트
	self.get_explosion_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj_explosion') end
	self.get_explosion_effect()

	self.get_missile_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_mana_canon_red_missile_proj') end
	self.get_missile_effect()

	self.state = {
		charging = 1, -- 차지
		aiming = 2, -- 조준
		fire_waiting = 3, -- 발사 대기
		fire = 4, -- 발사
		reload = 5, -- 재장전
		wait = 6, -- 대기
	}
	self.cur_state = self.state.wait

	self.missile_state = {
		set = 1, -- 미사일 세팅
		fallen = 2, -- 낙하
		bomb = 3, -- 폭발
	}
	self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.set

	-- 대기 시간
	self.wait_duration = 2

	-- 충전 시간
	self.charging_duration = 1

	-- 조준 시간
	self.aiming_duration = 2.5

	-- 날라가는 시간
	self.fire_duration = 1

	-- 조준 완료 후 대기시간
	self.reload_duration = 1

	-- 쏠 때 영역 체크 딜레이 시간
	self.shoot_checking_delay = 0.15

	-- 어택레인지 반지름
	self.attack_range_radius = 2

	-- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero
	, self.attack_range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	-- show 한번 해줘야지 생성됌
	self.attack_range:Show()

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.origin_attack_range_parent = self.attack_range.transform.parent

	-- 미사일 이팩트
	self.missile_effect = nil

	-- 미사일 떨어지는 시작 지점, 도착 지점
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil

	-- 애니메이터 캐싱
	self.cached_mana_cannon_animator = {}

	-- 루틴 리퀘스트 id
	self.request_id = 0
	self.max_request_id = 10

	-- activate 되었는지 여부
	self.is_activate = false

	-- stage end 가 불렸는지 여부
	self.is_stage_end = false

	-- util
	self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	-- 미사일을 쏘고 있는지 여부
	self.is_shoot_missile = false

	-- 효과음 세팅 data
	self.sfx_data_dict = {
		sfx_cannon_charge_1 = {
			sfx_name = '01_cannon_charge_01',
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object',
			loop = false,
		},
		sfx_cannon_charge_2 = {
			sfx_name = '01_cannon_charge_02',
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object',
			loop = false,
		},
		sfx_cannon_fire = {
			sfx_name = '01_cannon_fire_01',
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object',
			loop = false,
		},
		sfx_cannon_fire_2 = {
			sfx_name = '01_cannon_fire_02',
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object',
			loop = false,
		},
		sfx_cannon_move = {
			sfx_name = '01_cannon_move_01',
			type_priority = 'gimmick',
			player_priority = 'object',
			loop = false,
		},
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_animation_event')
end

function mana_cannon:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self:dispose_missile_effect()

	self.sfx_dict = nil
	self.mana_cannon_list = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

-- 애니메이션에서 sfx 재생할 타이밍 보내주면 재생 처리 하는 함수
function mana_cannon:on_animation_event(e)
	local sfx_data = self.sfx_data_dict[e.EventName]
	if sfx_data ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_data)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 마나대포 활성화
function mana_cannon:activate(mana_cannon_fo, data)
	local handle_name = mana_cannon_fo.Name
	local cur_cached_animator = self.cached_mana_cannon_animator[handle_name]

	if cur_cached_animator == nil then
		cur_cached_animator = mana_cannon_fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		self.cached_mana_cannon_animator[handle_name] = cur_cached_animator
	end

	-- 마나대포 캐싱
	local cannon_animator = cur_cached_animator
	cannon_animator:Play('idle')

	-- 쏘는 npc
	local shooter = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'shooter', nil)

	-- 바위 정보
	local rock_list = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'rock_list', nil)

	-- 데미지 타입
	local damage_type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'damage_type', 'true_damage')

	-- 연출로 게임오버 됬을 때 갈 좌표 마커
	local reset_marker = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'reset_marker', nil)

	-- 데미지 다는 비율
	local damage_rate = 0.4

	-- 타겟
	local target = get_party_leader()

	-- sfx data의 효과음 재생 parent 변경
	self:set_sfx_parent(mana_cannon_fo)

	-- activate
	self.is_activate = true

	-- 캐논 루틴 시작
	start_coroutine(self.cannon_routine, self, cannon_animator, shooter
	, target, damage_type, damage_rate, reset_marker, rock_list)
end

-- 마나대포 sfx 부모 지정
function mana_cannon:set_sfx_parent(mana_cannon_fo)
	for _, sfx_data in pairs(self.sfx_data_dict) do
		sfx_data.parent = mana_cannon_fo
	end
end

-- 로직 비활성화
function mana_cannon:deactivate()
	self.is_activate = false

	if self.cur_state ~= self.state.fire then
		-- 어택레인지 비활성화
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

	self.cur_state = self.state.wait
end

-- 마나대포 루틴
function mana_cannon:cannon_routine(cannon_animator, shooter, target, damage_type, damage_rate, reset_marker, rock_list)
	-- 미사일 다 쏴질 때까지 대기
	while not self.is_stage_end and self.is_shoot_missile do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 리퀘스트 아이디 세팅
	self:set_request_id()
	local cur_request_id = self.request_id

	-- 미사일 루틴
	start_coroutine(self.shoot_routine, self, cur_request_id, shooter, target
	, damage_type, damage_rate, reset_marker, rock_list)

	local time_passed = self.wait_duration
	self.cur_state = self.state.wait

	while not self.is_stage_end and self.is_activate and
			cur_request_id == self.request_id do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.cur_state == self.state.charging then
			if time_passed >= self.charging_duration then
				time_passed = 0
				self.cur_state = self.state.aiming

				-- 어택 레인지 활성화
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bombard_range_01', loop = false })

				attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, target.Position, 0.05)
				attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.aiming_duration)

				self.attack_range.transform:SetParent(target.Transform)

				-- charge 애니메이션 재생
				cannon_animator:Play('ready_45')
			end
		elseif self.cur_state == self.state.aiming then
			-- 에이밍 시간의 70퍼센트 찰 때까지 따라다니다가 좌표 세팅
			if time_passed >= self.aiming_duration * 0.7 then
				time_passed = 0
				self.cur_state = self.state.fire_waiting

				-- 미사일 시작/도착 지점 세팅
				self.end_pos = target.Position
				self.start_pos = self.end_pos + vector(0, 12.5, 0)
				self.attack_range.transform:SetParent(self.origin_attack_range_parent)

			end
		elseif self.cur_state == self.state.fire_waiting then
			-- 에이밍 시간 다 되었을 때 미사일 이팩트 생성
			if time_passed >= self.aiming_duration * 0.3 then
				time_passed = 0

				-- fire 애니메이션 재생
				cannon_animator:Play('shoot_45')

				-- 미사일 낙하 시작
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lockon_01', loop = false, play_pos = self.end_pos })
				self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.set
				self.is_shoot_missile = true

				self.cur_state = self.state.fire
			end
		elseif self.state.fire == self.cur_state then
			-- 1초간 미사일 내려옴
			-- 미사일 내려오는 것은 다른 루틴에서 처리
			if time_passed >= self.fire_duration then
				time_passed = 0
				self.cur_state = self.state.reload

				-- down 애니메이션 재생
				cannon_animator:Play('end_45')
			end
		elseif self.state.reload == self.cur_state then
			-- 장전 애니메이션 재생중
			if time_passed >= self.reload_duration then
				time_passed = 0
				self.cur_state = self.state.wait
			end
		elseif self.state.wait == self.cur_state then
			-- 아무 행동 안함
			-- 타겟이 죽은 상태면 대기
			if target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead == false and
					time_passed >= self.wait_duration then
				time_passed = 0
				self.cur_state = self.state.charging

				-- up 애니메이션 재생
				cannon_animator:Play('on_45')

				-- 슈터 attack 애니메이션 재생
				scene_util.set_anim(shooter, self.controller, { name = 'attack', count = 1
				, sfx_name = '01_clang_01' })
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	cannon_animator:Play('end_45')
end

function mana_cannon:shoot_routine(cur_request_id, shooter, target, damage_type, damage_rate, reset_marker, rock_list)
	-- 미사일 이팩트 좌표
	local cur_start_pos
	local cur_end_pos

	-- 미사일 sfx
	local missile_drop_sfx = nil

	local function stop_missile_drop_sfx()
		if missile_drop_sfx ~= nil then
			missile_drop_sfx:Stop()
			missile_drop_sfx = nil
		end
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while not self.is_stage_end and cur_request_id == self.request_id do
		if self.is_shoot_missile then
			if self.missile_state.set == self.cur_missile_state then
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if time_passed >= 0.2 then
					time_passed = 0
					self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.fallen

					cur_start_pos = self.start_pos
					cur_end_pos = self.end_pos

					stop_missile_drop_sfx()
					missile_drop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01'
					, loop = true, play_pos = self.end_pos })

					self.missile_effect = self.get_missile_effect():Instantiate(cur_start_pos)
				end
			elseif self.missile_state.fallen == self.cur_missile_state then
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if time_passed >= self.fire_duration then
					self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.bomb
					stop_missile_drop_sfx()
				else
					-- fire_duration 간 포탄 end_pos로 이동
					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / self.fire_duration)
					self.missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(cur_start_pos, cur_end_pos, progress)
				end
			elseif self.missile_state.bomb == self.cur_missile_state then
				time_passed = 0

				-- 카메라 쉐이크
				camera_util.shake(0.04, 0.5)

				-- 미사일 비활성화
				self:dispose_missile_effect()

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_fire_explosion_03'
				, loop = false, play_pos = self.end_pos })

				-- 폭발 이팩트 재생
				self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(cur_end_pos)

				-- 주변에 부숴질 바위가 있는지 체크
				self:check_break_block(rock_list)

				-- 타겟이 영역 안에 있으면 게임 오버라 true 리턴
				if attack_range_util.is_contains_attack_range(self.attack_range, target, 0.85) then
					-- 데미지 타입에 따라 바로 게임오버 인지 아닌지 체크
					if damage_type == 'true_damage' then
						-- 실제 데미지를 준다.
						self:damaged_target(shooter, target, damage_rate)
					else
						-- 연출 사망
						self.is_activate = false
						self:directing_game_over(reset_marker, rock_list)
					end
				end

				-- 따라 다니던 어택 레인지 비활성화
				self.attack_range:Hide()

				self.cur_missile_state = self.missile_state.set
				self.is_shoot_missile = false
			end
		else
			-- 미사일 쏘는 상태가 아닐 때 캐논이 활성화 상태가 아니라면 break
			if self.is_activate == false then
				break
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	stop_missile_drop_sfx()
end

-- 리퀘스트 id 세팅
function mana_cannon:set_request_id()
	self.request_id = self.request_id + 1

	if self.request_id >= self.max_request_id then
		self.request_id = 0
	end
end

-- 바위 부서질 거 있나 체크하고 부서지도록 데미지 보내줌
function mana_cannon:check_break_block(rock_list)
	table_util.for_each(rock_list, function(_, rock)
		if rock.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and
				attack_range_util.is_contains_attack_range(self.attack_range, rock, 0.75) then

			-- 영역 안에 있다면 바위 부숨
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
			damage_info.sender = rock
			damage_info.target = rock
			damage_info.damage = 100

			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(rock.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end)
end

-- 바위 리셋
function mana_cannon:reset_rock_list(rock_list)
	table_util.for_each(rock_list, function(_, rock)
		if rock.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			-- 부숴진 바위가 있다면 다시 활성화
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = rock
			heal_info.target = rock
			heal_info.skipEffect = true

			local cmd = CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(rock.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end)
end

-- 연출로 사망 처리 함수
function mana_cannon:directing_game_over(reset_marker, rock_list)
	self.cw_util:enter_scene(nil)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		if direction_util.is_side(member.Direction) == false then
			scene_util.set_direction(member, 'left', false)
		end

		scene_util.set_emotion(member, self.controller, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(member, self.controller, 'dead')
	end

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.cur_state = self.state.wait

	field_util.get_marker_pos()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.align_party(reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, 0)

	self:reset_rock_list(rock_list)
	self:deactivate()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.cw_util:exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
end

function mana_cannon:damaged_target(shooter, target, damage_rate)
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = shooter
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_rate)
	damage_info.noCritical = true
	damage_info.notMortal = false

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function mana_cannon:dispose_missile_effect()
	if self.missile_effect ~= nil then
		self.missile_effect:Dispose()
		self.missile_effect = nil
	end
end

return {
	mana_cannon = mana_cannon
}

---@class CivilWarCustomBackgroundController
local local_class = newclass('CivilWarCustomBackgroundController')

function local_class:init()
	self.states = {
		none = 1,
		wait_request = 2,
		scrolling = 3,
		fixed = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	---@type CivilWarCustomBackgroundConstants
	local constants = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/CustomBackgroundConstants')

	local function preset_bg(fo, order)
		fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		fo.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)

		local sorting_group = fo.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Rendering.SortingGroup))

		sorting_group.sortingOrder = order
		sorting_group.sortingLayerName = constants.sorting_layer
	end

	local function create_bg_group(name, count, order)
		local container = {}
		local center_index = (count + 1) / 2

		for i = 1, count do
			local fo = get_field_object(name .. i)

			preset_bg(fo, order)

			container[i] = {
				fo = fo,
				x_offset = (i - center_index) * constants.x_cycle
			}
		end

		return container
	end

	local normal_unit_count = constants.normal_unit_counts[stage.Name]

	---@return CivilWarCustomBackgroundInfo
	local function create_background_info(type)
		local type_const = constants.types[type]
		local name = type_const.name
		local move_ratio = type_const.move_ratio
		local yz_offset = type_const.from_border_yz_offset
		local sorting_order = type_const.order

		local x_cycle = constants.x_cycle

		---@class CivilWarCustomBackgroundInfo
		local info = {
			fo_group = create_bg_group(name, normal_unit_count, sorting_order),

			move_ratio = move_ratio,

			auto_scroll_speed = type_const.auto_scroll_speed,

			x_cycle = x_cycle,

			yz_offset = yz_offset,

			set_world_pos = function(this, target_x, border_yz)
				for i = 1, #this.fo_group do
					local info = this.fo_group[i]

					info.fo.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(border_yz + this.yz_offset, target_x + info.x_offset)
				end
			end,

			move = function(this, x_diff, screen_min_x, screen_max_x)
				local changed_x_diff = x_diff * this.move_ratio

				this:force_move(changed_x_diff)

				local first_fo = this.fo_group[1].fo
				local last_fo = this.fo_group[#this.fo_group].fo

				local bounds_min_x = first_fo.Bounds.min.x
				local bounds_max_x = last_fo.Bounds.max.x

				-- FIXME :  만약 최악의 프레임 환경에서 x_diff가 너무 커지는 바람에 x_cycle로 커버가 불가능하면,
				--여러 프레임에 걸쳐 해결되는 문제가 있음
				if bounds_min_x > screen_min_x then
					this:force_move(-this.x_cycle)
				elseif bounds_max_x < screen_max_x then
					this:force_move(this.x_cycle)
				end
			end,

			force_move = function(this, x_diff)
				for i = 1, #this.fo_group do
					local fo = this.fo_group[i].fo

					fo.Position = fo.Position + x_diff * unity_class.vector3.right
				end
			end,

			set_active = function(this, active)
				local target_active_state = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
						active,
						active_state('visible'),
						active_state('disabled')
				)

				for i = 1, #this.fo_group do
					local fo = this.fo_group[i].fo

					fo.ActiveState = target_active_state
				end
			end
		}

		return info
	end

	local flower_const = constants.types.flower

	local flower_fos = {}

	local flower_fo_names = flower_const.name[stage.Name]

	for key, name in pairs(flower_fo_names) do
		local fo = get_field_object(name)

		preset_bg(fo, flower_const.order)

		fo.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * flower_const.scale

		flower_fos[key] = fo
	end

	self.backgrounds = {
		sky = create_background_info('sky'),
		floor = create_background_info('floor'),
		building_back = create_background_info('building_back'),
		building_front = create_background_info('building_front'),
		fog = create_background_info('fog'),
		rock = create_background_info('rock'),
		flower = {
			fos = flower_fos,
			state = 'open',

			yz_offset = flower_const.from_border_yz_offset,
			move_ratio = flower_const.move_ratio,
			origin_scale = flower_const.scale,

			get_fo = function(this)
				return this.fos[this.state]
			end,

			set_world_pos = function(this, target_x, border_yz)
				local fo = this:get_fo()

				fo.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(border_yz + this.yz_offset, target_x)
			end,

			move = function(this, x_diff)
				local changed_x_diff = x_diff * this.move_ratio

				this:force_move(changed_x_diff)
			end,

			force_move = function(this, x_diff)
				local fo = this:get_fo()

				fo.Position = fo.Position + x_diff * unity_class.vector3.right
			end,

			set_active = function(this, active)
				local fo = this:get_fo()
				local target_active_state = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
						active,
						active_state('visible'),
						active_state('disabled')
				)

				fo.ActiveState = target_active_state
			end
		},
	}

	-- { key = string, border_yz = vector3, flower_center_cam_x = float, flower_state = string }
	self.requests = {}

	self.prev_camera_x = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.requests = nil

	self.backgrounds = nil
end

function local_class:update_background(force_move_x_diff)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.scrolling then
		return
	end

	local cur_camera_x = stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x
	local view_x_diff = 0

	view_x_diff = cur_camera_x - self.prev_camera_x

	-- 만약 루프 연출 도중 루프 사이클링이 발생했다면 시각 diff를 조정해줌
	if force_move_x_diff ~= nil then
		view_x_diff = view_x_diff - force_move_x_diff
		self:execute_to_normal_bgs('force_move', force_move_x_diff)
		self.backgrounds.flower:force_move(force_move_x_diff)
	end

	-- 여유 공간 2만큼 줌
	local half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth + 2
	local screen_min_x = stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x - half_width
	local screen_max_x = stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x + half_width

	do
		local fog_auto_move_diff = unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.backgrounds.fog.auto_scroll_speed

		self.backgrounds.fog:force_move(fog_auto_move_diff)
	end

	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('move', view_x_diff, screen_min_x, screen_max_x)
	self.backgrounds.flower:move(view_x_diff)

	self.prev_camera_x = cur_camera_x
end

function local_class:activate_scrolling(border_yz, flower_center_cam_x, flower_state)
	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('set_active', true)
	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('set_world_pos', stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x, border_yz)

	-- 꽃은 대략적인 위치를 맞춰주기 위해, 가운데에 있을 위치를 미리 잡아둠
	self.backgrounds.flower.state = flower_state
	self.backgrounds.flower:set_active(true)
	self.backgrounds.flower:set_world_pos(flower_center_cam_x, border_yz)
	self.backgrounds.flower:move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x - flower_center_cam_x)

	self.prev_camera_x = stage_camera.LookAtPosition.x
end

function local_class:deactivate_scrolling()
	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('set_active', false)

	self.backgrounds.flower:set_active(false)
end

function local_class:request_activate(key, border_yz, flower_center_cam_x, flower_state)
	if self.current_state == self.states.none or self.current_state == self.states.fixed then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.requests do
		if self.requests[i].key == key then
			return
		end
	end

	-- scrolling인 경우는 요청을 쌓아두기만 함
	table.insert(self.requests, {
		key = key,
		border_yz = border_yz,
		flower_center_cam_x = flower_center_cam_x,
		flower_state = flower_state
	})

	if self.current_state == self.states.wait_request then
		self:activate_scrolling(border_yz, flower_center_cam_x, flower_state)

		self.current_state = self.states.scrolling
	end
end

function local_class:request_deactivate(key)
	if self.current_state ~= self.states.scrolling then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.requests do
		if self.requests[i].key == key then
			table.remove(self.requests, i)
			break
		end
	end

	-- 스테이트 변경 시 이전 오브젝트 비활성화
	self:deactivate_scrolling()

	if #self.requests == 0 then
		self.current_state = self.states.wait_request
	else
		-- 다음 요청 데이터를 기반으로 동작하도록 함
		self:activate_scrolling(
				self.requests[1].border_yz,
				self.requests[1].flower_center_cam_x,
				self.requests[1].flower_state
		)
	end
end

function local_class:execute_to_normal_bgs(func_name, ...)
	self.backgrounds.sky[func_name](self.backgrounds.sky, ...)
	self.backgrounds.floor[func_name](self.backgrounds.floor, ...)
	self.backgrounds.building_back[func_name](self.backgrounds.building_back, ...)
	self.backgrounds.building_front[func_name](self.backgrounds.building_front, ...)
	self.backgrounds.fog[func_name](self.backgrounds.fog, ...)
	self.backgrounds.rock[func_name](self.backgrounds.rock, ...)
end

function local_class:request_turn_on()
	if self.current_state == self.states.none then
		self.current_state = self.states.wait_request
	end
end

--- 이전 요청은 전부 지워버리고 꺼둠
function local_class:request_turn_off()
	self.current_state = self.states.none

	self.requests = {}

	self:deactivate_scrolling()
end

--- 배경 세팅
function local_class:just_set_background(border_yz, flower_center_cam_x, flower_state)
	self:request_turn_off()

	self.current_state = self.states.fixed

	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('set_active', true)
	self:execute_to_normal_bgs('set_world_pos', flower_center_cam_x, border_yz)

	-- 꽃은 대략적인 위치를 맞춰주기 위해, 가운데에 있을 위치를 미리 잡아둠
	self.backgrounds.flower.state = flower_state
	self.backgrounds.flower:set_active(true)
	self.backgrounds.flower:set_world_pos(flower_center_cam_x, border_yz)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarCustomTelescope')

function local_class:init()
	self.telescope_name = 'telescope'

	self.states = {
		none = 0,
		idle = 1,
		interacting = 2,
		wait_touch = 3,
		touched = 4,
	}

	self.current_state = self.states.none

	---@type CivilWarUtil
	self.cw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.on_show = nil
	self.on_hide = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	self.on_show = nil
	self.on_hide = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.idle and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self:get_telescope()) then
		self.current_state = self.states.interacting

		start_coroutine(self.show_async, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.wait_touch and e.TouchEventType == touch_event_type.tap then
		self.current_state = self.states.touched

		start_coroutine(self.hide_async, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.states.wait_touch and
			(e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
			e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown) then
		self.current_state = self.states.touched

		start_coroutine(self.hide_async, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:initialize(telescope_name, on_show, on_hide)
	self.telescope_name = telescope_name
	self.on_show = on_show
	self.on_hide = on_hide

	self.current_state = self.states.idle
end

function local_class:get_telescope()
	return get_field_object(self.telescope_name)
end

function local_class:show_async()
	self.cw_util:enter_scene({ hide_weapon = false })

	self.on_show()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	-- 시작 시점에서만 컨트롤러 연결을 체크함. 이 시점 이후 컨트롤러를 꼽아도 동작하지 않을 것임
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	end

	self.current_state = self.states.wait_touch
end

function local_class:hide_async()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	self.on_hide()

	--컨트롤 돌려줌.
	self.cw_util:exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

	self.current_state = self.states.idle
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class IOperatorUI
---@field load_async fun(self:self)
---@field speech fun(self:self, portrait_name : string, key : string, data : table):string, string, table
---@field speech_async fun(self:self, portrait_name : string, key : string, data : table):string, string, table
---@field set_active fun(self:self, active : boolean):boolean
---@field shake fun(self:self, magnitude : number, duration : number, sfx_name : string, can_skip : boolean):number, number, string, boolean
---@field stop fun(self:self)

---@class OperatorUI : IOperatorUI
local local_class = newclass('OperatorUI')

function local_class:init()
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.default_operator_ui_bundle_name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/ui'
	self.default_operator_ui_asset_name = 'QueenShipOperatorUI'

	self.current_portrait_name = ''
	self.current_character_sprite_name = ''
	self.operator_ui_obj = nil
	self.operator_ui_controller = nil

	-- 캐릭터마다 별도 color 출력을 위한 table
	self.operator_type_table = { 'demon_engineer', 'teatan_hero', 'maiden', 'china_hero_boy', 'china_hero_girl', 'character_sprite', 'none' }

	-- 현재는 비네트 전용인데 나중에 추가될 경우 변경 필요
	self.demon_engineer_ui_obj = nil

	self.is_load = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(self.operator_ui_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.operator_ui_obj)
		self.operator_ui_obj = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.demon_engineer_ui_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.demon_engineer_ui_obj)
		self.demon_engineer_ui_obj = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_async(bundle_name, asset_name)
	if self.is_load then
		return
	end

	self.is_load = true

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	bundle_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(bundle_name, self.default_operator_ui_bundle_name)
	asset_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(asset_name, self.default_operator_ui_asset_name)

	--region 오퍼레이터UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bundle_name, asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.operator_ui_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.operator_ui_controller = self.operator_ui_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipOperatorUI))
				-- GT-1333 아랍어 대응
				if game_string.IsRTL and self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale.x > 0 then
					local scale = self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale
					scale.x = -scale.x

					self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale = scale
					self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.alignment = CS.TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.TopRight
				end
				self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(false)
			end)
end

function local_class:speech(portrait_name, key, data)
	self:init_portrait(portrait_name)

	self:set_operator_type(portrait_name)

	self:set_active(true)

	self:set_label_key(key, data)
end

function local_class:speech_async(portrait_name, key, data)
	self:init_portrait(portrait_name)

	self:set_operator_type(portrait_name)

	self:set_active(true)

	self:set_label_key_async(key, data)
end

function local_class:speech_sprite_async(character_name, key, data)
	local spec_id = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'visual_spec_id', -1)

	self:init_character_sprite(character_name, spec_id)

	self:set_operator_type('character_sprite')

	self:set_active(true)

	self:set_label_key_async(key, data)
end

function local_class:set_active(active)
	self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(active)
end

function local_class:init_portrait(portrait_name)
	if self.current_portrait_name == portrait_name then
		return
	end

	self.current_portrait_name = portrait_name

	if portrait_name == 'demon_engineer' then
		-- 현재는 비네트 전용인데 추후 특수UI가 증가할 경우 다시 작업 필요
		coroutine.yield(self:demon_engineer_ui_load())
	else
		yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.InitPortrait, self.operator_ui_controller, self.current_portrait_name)
	end
end

function local_class:init_character_sprite(character_name, spec_id)
	if self.current_character_sprite_name == character_name then
		return
	end

	self.current_character_sprite_name = character_name

	self.operator_ui_controller:InitCharacterSprite(self.current_character_sprite_name, spec_id)
end

function local_class:set_operator_type(portrait_name)
	if table_util.contain_value(self.operator_type_table, portrait_name) then
		self.operator_ui_controller:SetOperatorType(portrait_name)
		return
	end

	self.operator_ui_controller:SetOperatorType('default')
end

function local_class:demon_engineer_ui_load()
	if self.demon_engineer_ui_obj ~= nil then
		self.operator_ui_controller:CharacterVisible(true)
		return
	end

	-- 현재는 비네트 전용인데 나중에 추가될 경우 변경 필요
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/ui', 'ch18_sound_wave', function(prefab)
				self.demon_engineer_ui_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab, self.operator_ui_controller.characterParent)
				self.operator_ui_controller:CharacterVisible(true)
			end)
end

function local_class:set_label_key_async(key, data)
	local font_size = lua_helper.get_value(data, "font_size", -1)

function local_class:init()
	self.request = {
		id = 0,
		progress = function(this)

			return this.id
		end,
		is_valid = function(this, id)

	end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local dog = self.get_dog()

	--스파인 및 표정
	--14(kid_boy, smile)
	scene_util.set_emotion(kid, self, 'smile')
	character_util.set_active_state(kid, 'visible')

	--15(dog_corgi,smile)
	scene_util.set_emotion(dog, self, 'smile')
	character_util.set_active_state(dog, 'visible')

	start_coroutine(self.runner_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.request:progress()

	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local dog = self.get_dog()

	character_util.remove_emotion(kid)
	character_util.stop(kid)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kid)
	character_util.set_active_state(kid, 'disabled')

	character_util.remove_emotion(dog)
	character_util.stop(dog)
	character_util.set_active_state(dog, 'disabled')

	if self.dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.dash_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:runner_routine()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	local dog = self.get_dog()

	--둘 다 속도 5로
	local speed = 5

	local req_id = self.request:progress()
	local speech_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_world_runner_speech').x

	local waypoints = {
		[kid] = {
			start = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_world_runner_kid_start'),
			target = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_world_runner_kid_end'),
		},
		[dog] = {
			start = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_world_runner_dog_start'),
			target = field_util.get_marker_pos('princess_world_runner_dog_end'),
		}
	}

	local move_done_count = 0

	local move_done_cb = function()
		move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
	end

	--오른쪽에서 왼쪽으로 그리드 밖에서 그리드 너머까지 이동한다.

	while self.request:is_valid(req_id) do
		move_done_count = 0

		character_util.set_position(kid, waypoints[kid].start)
		character_util.set_position(dog, waypoints[dog].start)

		wp_util.move(kid, waypoints[kid].target, speed, nil, {
			run = true,
			end_callback = move_done_cb
		})

		wp_util.move(dog, waypoints[dog].target, speed, nil, {
			run = true,
			end_callback = move_done_cb
		})

		--뛰어가던 중 붉은색 원 위치에 도달하면 14번 npc 대사
		while kid.Position.x > speech_x and self.request:is_valid(req_id) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if not self.request:is_valid(req_id) then
			break
		end

		-- 리더는 캐싱하지 않음. 변경 가능성이 존재하기 때문
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(get_party_leader().FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) then
			--14(kid_boy, smile) : 우하하!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kid, {
				key = 'cw_princess_world_runner_kid',
				skip = false,
				type_speed = 0,
				keep_display = true
			})
		end

		while move_done_count < 2 and self.request:is_valid(req_id) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if not self.request:is_valid(req_id) then
			break
		end

		--1초 대기하는 사이에 대사 말풍선 제거해놓는다.
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kid)

		--한번 왼쪽 그리드 너머로 이동하면 1초 대기한 후
		local duration = 1
		local start_time = unity_class.time.time

		while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration and self.request:is_valid(req_id) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_dash_sfx()
	local kid = self.get_kid()
	if self.dash_sfx == nil then
		self.dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true, parent = kid, volume = 0.6, max_distance = 3
		})
	end
end

function local_class:remove_dash_sfx()
	if self.dash_sfx ~= nil then
		self.dash_sfx:Stop()
		self.dash_sfx = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:init()
	self.charging_object_list = {}
	self.timer_bar = nil
end

-- 코루틴을 불렀던 리스트를 전부 돌면서 강제적으로 꺼주기
function local_class:dispose()
	if table_util.is_empty(self.charging_object_list) == false then
		for _,fo in pairs(self.charging_object_list) do
			if fo ~= nil then
				fo.object.Electrocutable.IsPoweredOn = false

				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fo.object, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
				fo.timer.timer_bar = nil

				fo = nil

			end
		end
		self.charging_object_list = nil
	end
end

-- 전기가 연결되어 있어야하는 오브젝트와 연결 체크할 시간 을 가져와서 코루틴 실행
function local_class:start_charge(fo, duration)
	--- 차지 게이지 UI 갱신
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tesla_charge_routine, self, fo, duration))
end

-- 해당 오브젝트가  일정 시간동안 지속적으로 전기를 공급받는 지  확인 후, 커스텀 스테이트를 통해
-- charging_complete 와 차징이 되지 않았을 때 charging_incomplete를 오브젝트 네임과 함께 보내줌
function local_class:tesla_charge_routine(fo, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local name = fo.Name

	local ui_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	local timer_bar = ui_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, duration);
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

	if self.charging_object_list[name] ~= nil then
		return false
	end

	self.charging_object_list[name] = {
		object = fo,
		timer = timer_bar
	}

	while fo.Electrocutable.IsPoweredOn and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(time_passed, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.charging_object_list[name] = nil
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	self.timer_bar = nil

	if time_passed > duration then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {'charging_complete', name}))
		return true
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {'charging_incomplete', name}))
	return false
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarThroneSceneUtil')

function local_class:init()
	self.view_states = {
		idle = 1,
		throne = 2,
	}

	self.current_view_state = self.view_states.idle

	self.throne_cam_x_rot = 25
	self.throne_cam_rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.throne_cam_x_rot, unity_class.vector3.right)
	self.item_shadow_x_rot = 90
	self.item_shadow_rot =  unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.item_shadow_x_rot, unity_class.vector3.right)

	self.origin_view_data = {
		cached = false,
		x_rot = nil,
		orthographic = nil,
		near_clip_plane = nil,
		field_of_view = nil,
	}

	self.shear_manager = get_or_create_global_table('utils/Shear/ShearManager')
	self.shear_handle_name = self.shear_manager.shear_controller.handle_name
	self.shear_request_key = 'throne_scene_shear'
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.throne_cam_rot = nil
	self.origin_view_data = nil
end

function local_class:change_to_throne_view()
	-- 이미 throne state라면 무시
	if self.current_view_state == self.view_states.throne then
		return
	end

	-- 시어 제거
	if get_field_object(self.shear_handle_name) ~= nil then
		self.shear_manager:request_off(self.shear_request_key)
	end

	self.current_view_state = self.view_states.throne

	local camera = stage_camera.Camera

	if not self.origin_view_data.cached then
		self.origin_view_data.x_rot = camera.transform.parent.localEulerAngles.x
		self.origin_view_data.orthographic = camera.orthographic
		self.origin_view_data.near_clip_plane = camera.nearClipPlane
		self.origin_view_data.field_of_view = camera.fieldOfView

		self.origin_view_data.cached = true
	end

	camera.transform.parent.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot
	camera.orthographic = false
	camera.nearClipPlane = 0.01
	camera.fieldOfView = 45
end

function local_class:change_to_normal_view()
	-- 이미 idle state라면 무시
	if self.current_view_state == self.view_states.idle then
		return
	end

	-- 시어 원복
	if get_field_object(self.shear_handle_name) ~= nil then
		self.shear_manager:request_on(self.shear_request_key)
	end

	self.current_view_state = self.view_states.idle

	local camera = stage_camera.Camera

	camera.transform.parent.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(self.origin_view_data.x_rot, 0, 0)
	camera.orthographic = self.origin_view_data.orthographic
	camera.nearClipPlane = self.origin_view_data.near_clip_plane
	camera.fieldOfView = self.origin_view_data.field_of_view
end

function local_class:show_emoticon_async(character, emoticon_name)
	local emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon(character, nil, emoticon_name)

	emoticon.transform.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot

	wait_for_sec(2.5)
end

function local_class:play_speech_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_args)
	scene_util.play_custom_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, function()
		self:show_speech_bubble_async(character, speech_args)
	end)
end

function local_class:show_speech_bubble_async(character, speech_args)
	local args = self:modify_speech_bubble_args(speech_args)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, args)
end

function local_class:show_speech_bubble(character, speech_args)
	local args = self:modify_speech_bubble_args(speech_args)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character, args)
end

function local_class:modify_speech_bubble_args(speech_args)
	if type_util.is_string(speech_args) then
		speech_args = {
			key = speech_args,
			skip = true,
		}
	end

	if speech_args.offset == nil then
		speech_args.offset = vector(2, 1.85, 0)
	end

	speech_args.scale = 1.7
	speech_args.euler_angle = vector(self.throne_cam_x_rot, 0, 0)
	speech_args.ignore_orthographic_size = true

	return speech_args
end

function local_class:create_item(item_id, scale, start_pos, target_pos)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = start_pos,
		sprscale = scale,
		itemid = item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true
	})

	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot
	item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot

	local ground_offset = 0.225
	local drop_start_offset = 0.5
	local initial_velocity = 11
	local initial_acceleration = 28
	local rotation_num = 3

	local drop_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall()

	drop_calculator:SetParameters(initial_velocity, initial_acceleration,
			field:GetTileInfoAt(start_pos):GetHeightAt(start_pos) + drop_start_offset, 0)
	drop_calculator:ScaleTime(1.2)

	item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = item.ShadowTransform.localPosition + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

	while not drop_calculator:IsDone() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local drop_progress = drop_calculator:GetProgress()
		local progress = math.min(1, drop_progress)

		local cur_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress

		local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(cur_pos):GetHeightAt(cur_pos) + ground_offset
		drop_calculator:Proceed(dt, floor_height)

		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, unity_class.mathf.Max(drop_calculator:GetDistance()/2, floor_height), 0)

		local rotate_progress = math.min(1, drop_progress)
		local cur_rotation = rotate_progress * 360 * rotation_num

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = self.item_shadow_rot *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = self.throne_cam_rot
	item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = self.item_shadow_rot

	return item
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:start_scene(func, ...)
	local args = { ... }

	local routine = function()
		-- 이전 리더에 대한 정보를 미리 캐싱해둬야 해제가 가능함
		local cached_leader = get_party_leader()

		self:enter_scene(nil)

		self:exit_scene(nil, cached_leader)
	end

	if disable_wind_pot then
		CS.Oak.WindPotManager.SetActive(false)
	end

	if option ~= nil then
		-- 혹시라도 공용으로 포함되었을 때를 대비해 사용한 데이터는 비워줌
		option.disable_wind_pot = nil
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene(option)
end

function local_class:exit_scene(option, cached_leader)
	local enable_wind_pot = lua_helper.get_value(option, 'enable_wind_pot',  true)

	if enable_wind_pot then
		CS.Oak.WindPotManager.SetActive(true)
	end

	if option ~= nil then
		-- 혹시라도 공용으로 포함되었을 때를 대비해 사용한 데이터는 비워줌

end

--region directional_light
-- control_directional_light 활성화
function local_class:activate_control_directional_light(data)
	self.directional_light_data = data

	-- 활성화 당시 위치 기준 존 체크해서 세팅
	for zone,light_name in pairs(self.directional_light_data) do
		if zone_util.contains_fo(zone, get_party_leader()) then
			self:set_directinal_light(light_name)
		end
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'light_on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'light_on_stage_end_event')
end

-- control_directional_light 비활성화
function local_class:deactivate_control_directional_light()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.directional_light_data = {}
end

function local_class:activate_manual_directional_light(data)
	self.directional_light_data = data
end

function local_class:deactivate_manual_directional_light()
	self.directional_light_data = {}
end

function local_class:light_on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and
			self.directional_light_data[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil then
		self:set_directinal_light(self.directional_light_data[e.Zone.Name])
	end
end

function local_class:light_on_stage_end_event()
	self:deactivate_control_directional_light()
end

-- directinal_light 세팅
function local_class:set_directinal_light(cur_light_name)
	for _,light_name in pairs(self.directional_light_data) do
		local active = light_name == cur_light_name and 'enabled' or 'disabled'
		get_field_object(light_name).ActiveState = active_state(active)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarConcertSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	--state
	self.section_state = {
		before_concert_enter = 1,
		before_add_request = 2,

	end

	self.get_demon_actor = function()

	end

	self.rolling_number = nil

	self.fx = {
		dead = function()

		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	--길 건너기 액팅용 스테이트
	self.npc_state = {
		move_start = 1,
		move = 2,

		done = 99,

	self.npc_manager = {

function local_class:on_pre_load()

end

function local_class:enter()

	self.rolling_number = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/SaulPointManager')
	self.rolling_number:pre_load()

	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.cross_line_loop, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	if self.concert_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.concert_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.concert_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.util = nil
	self.rolling_number = nil

	self.current_state = self.section_state.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_add_request or
			self.current_state == self.section_state.clear_interview and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_concert_npc(11)) then
		start_coroutine(self.request_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_concert_enter and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's14_concert_enter_zone') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.before_add_request
		self.util:start_scene(self.concert_enter_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.is_first and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's14_concert_start_enter_zone') then
		self.is_first = false
		start_coroutine(self.event_start_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's14_concert_cross_line_grid') then
		self.current_update_state = self.update_state.playing
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 's14_concert_cross_line_grid') then
		self.current_update_state = self.update_state.pause
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--이벤트 유도 이벤트

	local npc_1 = self.get_concert_start_npc(1)
	local npc_2 = self.get_concert_start_npc(2)

	--오늘 한다는 공연 왜이렇게 늦는거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_1, 'cw_main_s14_start_oneline_1')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_2, 'cw_main_s14_start_oneline_2')

	npc_1.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_main_s14_start_oneline_1'
	npc_1.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_angry_01'

	npc_2.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_main_s14_start_oneline_2'
	npc_2.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'

function local_class:concert_enter_scene()
