	local npc_5 = self.get_concert_npc(12)
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_sub_concert_marker_pos')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

	--(4)(right,attack,idle)(jump1회): 뭐라고?! 도망쳤다고?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(npc_4, false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_1')

	--(5)(left,tired,nod2회): 네…
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_5, self, nil,
			'nod', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_2')

	--(5)(left,tired,release): 아무리 무명이라도 그런 역을 맡는 건 싫다고 해서…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_5, self, nil,
			'release', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_3')

	--(4)(left,damaged,idle)(shake0.03): 으… 당일에 도망치는 건 무슨 심보야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.shake(npc_4, 0.03, 99999)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			nil, 'damaged', 'cw_main_s14_concert_4')
	character_util.stop_shake(npc_4)

	--(4)(right,tired,question): 이미 투자비는 다 받아버렸는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			'question', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_5')

	--(5)(left,tired,bomb_idle): 그걸 투자라고 부를 수 있나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_5, self, nil,
			'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_6')

	--(4)(right,mad,release): 그럼 뭐 어쩌라는 거야?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			'release', 'mad', 'cw_main_s14_concert_7')

	--(4)(right,tired,idle): 곧 있으면 공연시작인데… 배우를 언제 구하지.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	npc_4.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	character_util.add_listener(npc_4, self.controller)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.quest_marker_name, self.controller.quest_id, true, npc_4)

function local_class:request_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local npc_4 = self.get_concert_npc(11)
	local npc_5 = self.get_concert_npc(12)

	self.util:enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	--(4)에게 인터랙트 시 좌측에 가디언 정렬
	party_util.align_party(npc_4.Position, 'left', 0.5)

	--채용 시험
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.before_add_request then
		--(4)(left,idle,idle): 자네는 누구지?
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, 'left',
				nil, nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_9')

		--선택지
		--돈을 어디서 받으셨나요? (빨강)
		--혹시 배우 찾으시나요? (초록)
		--제가 완벽한 궁극의 배우입니다! (노랑)
		do
			local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_1', 'brutal' },
				{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_2', 'mercy' },
				{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_3', 'intellect' }
			})

			if result == 1 then
				--가디언(right,smile,sing) 1초
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
				scene_util.play_wait_action(leader, self, 'right', 'sing', 'smile', 1)

				--(4)(left,tired,bomb_idle): 헛소리 할 시간 없네.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
						'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_10')
				scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right', false)

				self.util:exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())
				return
			elseif result == 2 then
				--가디언(right,smile,victory_get)
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			elseif result == 3 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
				--가디언(right,smile,staff_shoot 0.75속도 끝에 정지) 1초
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'staff_shoot', scale = 0.75, keep_anim = true, loop = false })
				wait_for_sec(1)

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			end
		end

		--(4)(left,smile,idle)(jump1회): 자네, 지금 당장 연기할 수 있겠나?
		character_util.normal_jump(npc_4, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				nil, 'smile', 'cw_main_s14_concert_11')

		--(5)(left,tired,bomb_idle): 저기, 아무리 그래도 검증된 배우를 쓰셔야…
		--이때 (4)(right,idle,idle)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'right', false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_5, self, nil,
				'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_12')

		--(4)(right,mad,release2회): 조용히 해!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				{ name = 'release', count = 2 }, 'mad', 'cw_main_s14_concert_13')

		--(4)(right,attack,bomb_idle): 그 쪽에서 받은 돈을 그냥 날렸다간 어떻게 되는 지 알잖아.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				'bomb_idle', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_14')

		--이 후 (5)(left,tired,idle)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_5, self, 'tired')

		--(4)(left,idle,bomb_idle): 좋아, 자네 마계 주민이면 리리스 여왕 알고있지?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, 'left',
				'bomb_idle', nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_15')

		--(4)(left,attack,release): 자네가 그 리리스 여왕역을 맡아주면 되네!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_16')

		--(4)(left,idle,release): 좋아 그럼 가볍게 맞는 연기를 테스트해보겠네!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				'release', nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_18')

		--QTE
		do
			local clear_count = 0
			local qte_info = { 'up', 'left' }

			local qte_fail_func = function()
				scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
				wait_for_sec(0.25)

				--(4) 모션에 맞춰 가디언(right,damaged,damaged) 피격효과(빨간 틴트+눌림) + fx_hit
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
				self.fx.hit():Instantiate(leader.Bounds.center)

				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'damaged')

				wait_for_sec(0.7)
				character_util.remove_anim(leader)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
				scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'tired')
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'tired')
				wait_for_sec(0.7)

				--(4)0.5칸 우측으로 이동 (left)방향 고정된채로 뒷걸음질
				wp_util.move_async(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2, nil,
						{ locked_dir = 'left' })

				--(4)(left,tired,release): 다시 한번 해보지.
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
						'release', nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_19')

				character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
				character_util.remove_emotion(npc_4)
			end

			while clear_count ~= #qte_info do
				--(4)0.5칸 좌측으로 이동
				wp_util.move_async(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 2)

				clear_count = 0
				for i = 1, #qte_info do
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
					local qte_result = qte_util.swipe(qte_info[i], 2)

					if qte_result then
						clear_count = clear_count + 1
						if clear_count == #qte_info then
							break
						end
					else
						qte_fail_func()
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		--QTE(UP),(LEFT) 모두 입력 성공시

		--(4)(left,idle,attack) 모션
		scene_util.set_anim(npc_4, self, { name = 'attack', sfx_name = '02_hit_critical_01', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		--(4) 모션 에 맞춰 가디언 (right,damaged,dead2) 재생
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'dead2', sfx_name = '02_hit_critical_02', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--(4)(left,smile,idle)(jump1회)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc_4)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc_4, self, 'smile')
		character_util.normal_jump_async(npc_4, '01_jump_01')

		--(4)(left,smile,clap): 좋아! 아주 훌륭하군!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				'clap', 'smile', 'cw_main_s14_concert_20')

		--가디언 마리오 점프로 기상
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'right', 2, 'idle', true)

		--(4)우측으로 0.5칸 이동
		wp_util.move_async(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 2)

		--(4)(right,attack,release): 이 친구한테 그 의상 하나 내줘.

		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
		--(5)(left,idle,eat): 알겠습니다.
		character_util.remove_emotion(npc_5)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_5, self, nil,
				'eat', nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_22')

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		eat_sfx = nil

		--(5)캐릭터 경로대로 가디언 아래로 이동
		--이동 시작하면 (4)(left,idle,idle) 상태
		scene_util.set_direction(npc_4, 'left', false)
		wp_util.move_async(npc_5, {
			npc_5.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
			npc_5.Position + vector(-2, 0, -1),
		}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

		--이동 끝나면 가디언 (down,idle,idle) 상태
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)

		--(5)(up,idle,push)상태로 손에 임시 리소스(worker_costume)을 들고 0.5칸 (up) 방향 이동 후 가디언에게 습득 되고 바로 0.5칸 (down)으로 이동 후 (5)경로대로 원래자리 복귀
		do
			scene_util.set_anim(npc_5, self, 'push')
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(npc_5, vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.4, 0.3)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			--리리스 코스튬
			local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = npc_5.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
				itemid = 21033,
				notforinven = true,
				sprscale = 0.5,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				showoncharacter = false
			})

			drop_item_util.move_item_async(item, npc_5.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.7))

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			item.ConsumeTarget = leader
			item:Fly()
			character_util.remove_anim(npc_5)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		--get items events
		--subtitle - 남성도 입을 수 있게 개조됐습니다.
		--maintitle - 리리스 코스프레 복장
		--설명란- 내가 마계의 여왕이다!
		screen_util.item_get_event(
				'cw_lilith_costume',
				'cw_main_s14_lilith_costume_title',
				'cw_main_s14_lilith_costume_sub',
				'cw_main_s14_lilith_costume_desc'
		)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--이때부터 5번 기존경로대로 원래있던 곳 복귀 (left,idle,idle)
		wp_util.move_async(npc_5, {
			npc_5.Position + vector(2, 0, 0),
			npc_5.Position + vector(2, 0, 1),
		}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc_5)

		--(4)(left,idle,idle): 이번 공연은 이번 전쟁이 간단히 끝난다는 걸 부각시키는 거네!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				nil, nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_23')

		--(4)(left,attack,release): 그러니 자네는 리리스를 연기하며 바보같이 맞아주기만 하면되네!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
				'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_24')

		self.current_state = self.section_state.clear_interview
	end

	--(4)(left,idle,idle) : 어떤가 지금 시작할건가?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(npc_4, self, nil,
			nil, nil, 'cw_main_s14_concert_26')

	--선택지
	--네.(초록)
	--아니요. (빨강)
	do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_4', 'mercy' },
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_5', 'brutal' },
		})

		if result == 1 then
			--공연장 사운드 제거
			self.concert_loop_sfx:Stop()
			self.concert_loop_sfx = nil

			local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })

			--가디언 (right,smile,eat) 1초
			scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'eat')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			eat_sfx:Stop()
			eat_sfx = nil

			--fx_dead와 함께 리리스 복장 가디언으로
			camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0)

			--스파인 바뀌는 연출
			local queen_knight = self.get_demon_queen_knight()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

			self.fx:dead():Instantiate(leader.Position)
			queen_knight.Position = leader.Position
			leader.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

			--가디언(right,smile,victory_get)
			scene_util.set_direction(queen_knight, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(queen_knight, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self.current_state = self.section_state.start_concert

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

			--페이드 인 페이드 아웃 후 연극 장면으로 시작
			self:concert_scene()
		elseif result == 2 then
			self.util:exit_scene(nil, get_party_leader())

			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end
	end
end

			for key, data in pairs(this.npc_data) do

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_3, npc_3.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { locked_dir = 'up' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	-- 3칸 우측으로 이동 후 (1)(2)(3)(4)(left,idle,idle) 상태로 고정
	do
		local wp_key = 'npc_move'
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_1, npc_1.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_2, npc_2.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_3, npc_3.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc_4, npc_4.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				2, nil, self, wp_key, { last_direction = 'left' })

		wait_for_sec(1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--모리안과 카메라가 가디언앞까지 이동한다.
	character_util.remove_anim(actor)
	wp_util.move_async(actor, {
		actor.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		actor.Position + vector(0, -1, -2),
		actor.Position + vector(0, -1, -6.5),
	}, 4)

	--배우(left,attack,release): 리리스! 이미 너의 부대는 사울의 기술력과 힘에 압도당했다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(queen_knight, 'right', false)
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, 'left',
			'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_35')

	--배우(left,attack,idle): 얌전히 항복하고 최후를 맞이해라!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, 'left',
			nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_36')


	--선택지
	--오! 완전 전장을 뒤집어 놓으셨다.(노랑)
	--입 닥쳐, 모리안! (빨강)
	--한 번만 봐주세요. (초록)
	do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_9', 'intellect' },
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_10', 'brutal' },
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_11', 'mercy' }
		})

		if result == 1 then
			--가디언(right,smile,sing) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(queen_knight, self,
					nil,
					'sing',
					'smile',
					1)
		elseif result == 2 then
			--이때 배우(left,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
			character_util.normal_jump(actor, '01_player_jump_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'surprise')

			--가디언(right,mad,release2회)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'mad')
			scene_util.set_anim_async(queen_knight, self, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			character_util.remove_emotion(queen_knight)

			--배우(left,tired,bomb_idle): 어… 이건 대본에 없었는데.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, nil,
					'bomb_idle', 'tired', 'cw_main_s14_concert_37')

			--배우(left,attack,idle)(jump1회): 이, 입만 살았구나. 리리스!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, nil,
					nil, 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_38')
		elseif result == 3 then
			--가디언(right,tired,sing) 1초
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			scene_util.play_wait_action(queen_knight, self,
					nil, 'sing', 'tired', 1)
		end
	end

	--배우(left,attack,release): 네가 희생시킨 모두를 생각하며 참회해라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, nil,
			'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_39')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	--배우(left,attack,boong_attack_ready_loop)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')

	--좌상단 말풍선 : 오, 이제 뭐 시작한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_40',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.7),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1,
	})

	--우하단 말풍선: 이겨라 모리안!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_41',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.3),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1,
	})

	--선택지
	--맞아준다. (초록)
	--반격한다. (빨강)
	do
		local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_12', 'mercy' },
			{ 'cw_main_s14_concert_choose_13', 'brutal' },
		})

		if result == 1 then
			self:attacked_scene()

		elseif result == 2 then
			self:counter_attack_scene()
		end
	end

	--엑스트라 (1)~(4)(left,smile,clap) 유지
	local extra_group = { npc_1, npc_2, npc_3, npc_4 }
	scene_util.set_group_anim(extra_group, self, 'clap')
	scene_util.set_group_emotion(extra_group, self, 'smile')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_03')

	--배우(down,smile,success): 사, 사울의 승리다!
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'success')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(actor, 'cw_main_s14_concert_42')

	--배우(right,smile,victory_get): 사울을 더 위대하게!
	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(actor, 'cw_main_s14_concert_43')

	--주변 관객들 (success)이모션으로 변경 화살표 표시된 관객은 반박자 늦게
	local available = true
	local group_a = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_a()
	local group_b = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_b()

	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(group_a, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_group_anim(group_a, self, 'success')
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		if available then
			scene_util.set_group_emotion(group_b, self, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_group_anim(group_b, self, 'success')
		end
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	--좌측 상단 [shout] 와아아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_44',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.7),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1,
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	--우측 하단 [shout] 끝내주는데!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_45',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.3),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1,
	})

	--npc 두명 퇴장
	do
		local gray_5 = self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_gray_5')
		local red_3 = self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_red_3')
		local camera_pos = gray_5.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		local wp_key = 'npc_move'
		local outside_pos_1 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', gray_5.Position)
		local outside_pos_2 = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', red_3.Position)

		--초록색 표시해둔 두 NPC(success)모션 정지
		--(1)(right,idle,idle)(2)(left,idle,idle)
		available = false
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gray_5)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(red_3)
		scene_util.set_direction(gray_5, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(red_3, 'left', false)

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

		--(1)(2)(nod2회) 후
		scene_util.set_anim(gray_5, self, 'nod')
		scene_util.set_anim(red_3, self, 'nod')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--(right)방향으로 걸어가기 시작하면서 카메라 페이드 아웃
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(gray_5, outside_pos_1, 4, nil, self, wp_key)
		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(red_3, outside_pos_2, 4, nil, self, wp_key)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	end

	--연출 종료 세팅
	self.dynamic_npc:dispose()

	queen_knight.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	for i = 22, 25 do
		local npc = self.get_concert_npc(i)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	local actor_end_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_sub_concert_actor_end_pos')
	character_util.set_position(actor, actor_end_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'sing')

	self:ending_scene()
end

function local_class:attacked_scene()
	local queen_knight = self.get_demon_queen_knight()
	local actor = self.get_demon_actor()

	local group_a = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_a()
	local group_b = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_b()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	--QTE(LEFT) 발생 (실패X)
	qte_util.swipe('left')

	--배우(left,attack,boong_attack)으로 모션으로 바뀐다.
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, { name = 'boong_attack', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'bgm_colosseum', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 0.5 })

	--(boong_attack) 모션에 맞춰 fx_hit 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(queen_knight.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

	--화면 shake0.1/0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)

	--가디언 (right,damaged,damaged)로 바뀌면서 +피격효과 (빨간틴트 눌림) 동시에 3.5칸 좌측으로 속도 8로 밀린다.
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(queen_knight, self, 'damaged')
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(queen_knight)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(queen_knight)

	wp_util.move_async(queen_knight,
			queen_knight.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0), 8, nil, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	--도착하면 fx_hit 출력
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(queen_knight.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))

	--화면 shake0.1/0.5초
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)

	--jump 높이로 떠오르면서 우측 1칸으로 이동 하고 착지했을 때
	character_util.normal_jump(queen_knight, false)
	wp_util.move_async(queen_knight, queen_knight.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

	--피격효과와 함께(right,damaged,prostrate)상태가 된다.
	self.fx:hit():Instantiate(queen_knight.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(queen_knight)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(queen_knight)
	scene_util.set_anim(queen_knight, self, 'prostrate')

	--배우(left,surprise,cast)(jump1화)
	character_util.normal_jump(actor, '03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'cast')

	--카메라 크기 6으로 빠지면서 주변 관객 NPC 모션 (success)로 변경
	--표정은 (smile)상태
	--노란색으로 표기해둔 NPC는 반박자 느리게
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(group_a, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_group_anim(group_a, self, 'success')
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		scene_util.set_group_emotion(group_b, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_group_anim(group_b, self, 'success')
	end)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(6, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')

	--우측 상단 [shout] : 이야! 모리안 멋있다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_46',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.7),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1.25,
	})

	--좌측 하단 [shout] : 리리스는 좀 맞아야지!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_47',
		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.3),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1.25,
	})

	--카메라 크기 다시 4로 변경
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)

	--관객 NPC 애니메이션 및 표정 (idle)로 변경
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(group_a)
	character_util.remove_group_anim_and_emotion(group_b)

	--배우(left,attack,release): 어… 그 맛이 어떠냐 리리스!
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(actor, self, nil,
			'release', 'attack', 'cw_main_s14_concert_48')

	--가디언 마리오 점프로 기상 (right,scared,cast)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(queen_knight, 'right')

	scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(queen_knight, self, 'cast')

	--배우(left)방향 2칸 이동
	wp_util.move_async(actor, actor.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0), 4)

	--배우(left,attack,dagger_idle): 이제 끝장을 내주마! 리리스!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'dagger_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(actor, 'cw_main_s14_concert_49')

	--이후 카메라 가디언을 포커스
	camera_util.move_async(queen_knight.Position, 0.5, { end_target = queen_knight })

	--포물선 좌우 타격
	do
		local hell_and_heaven_async = function(fo, dir, left_pos, right_pos, height, duration, rotate_count, half_cb)
			local start_pos = nil
			local target_pos = nil
			local rotate_dir = 0

			if dir == 'right' then
				start_pos = left_pos
				target_pos = right_pos
				rotate_dir = 1
			elseif dir == 'left' then
				start_pos = right_pos
				target_pos = left_pos
				rotate_dir = -1
			end

			scene_util.set_direction(fo, dir, false)
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'damaged')

			character_util.spine_rotate(queen_knight, rotate_dir * rotate_count * 360, 0.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

			coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, start_pos, target_pos, function(progress, cur_value)
				local h = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
				local lerp_pos = cur_value + vector(0, h, 0)

				fo.Position = lerp_pos

				if half_cb ~= nil and progress > 0.5 then
					half_cb()
					half_cb = nil
				end
			end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

			character_util.spine_rotate(fo, 0, 0)
			scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, 'prostrate')
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fo)

			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		end

		local left_pos = queen_knight.Position
		local right_pos = queen_knight.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
		local rotate_count = 2
		local height = 2
		local duration = 0.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

		--QTE(RIGHT)실패 X
		qte_util.swipe('right')

		--입력시
		--가디언 (right,damaged,damaged) 상태로
		scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'damaged')

		--왼 -> 오
		hell_and_heaven_async(queen_knight, 'right', left_pos, right_pos, height, duration, rotate_count, function()
			scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'right', false)
		end)

		--배우 (right,surprise)(jump1회)

		scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim(actor)
		character_util.normal_jump(actor, '01_jump_comic_01')
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

		--QTE(LEFT)실패X
		qte_util.swipe('left')

		local dir_table = { 'left', 'right', 'left', 'right' }

		--상단 연출 반복해 (우)(좌)(우) 로 이동 QTE는 하지않는다.
		for i = 1, #dir_table do
			hell_and_heaven_async(queen_knight, dir_table[i], left_pos, right_pos, height, duration, rotate_count, function()
				scene_util.set_direction(actor, dir_table[i], false)
			end)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end
	end

	--(shake0.03)0.5초 후 마리오 점프로 기상 (left,confused,idle) 상태
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(queen_knight, 0.02, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'confused')
	character_util.remove_anim(queen_knight)

	character_util.mario_jump_async(queen_knight, 'left')

	scene_util.set_direction(queen_knight, 'left', false)

	--배우(left,tired,idle) 1초
	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'tired')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--배우(right,tired,bomb_idle): 어… 그.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(actor, 'cw_main_s14_concert_50')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	--QTE(right)실패X
	qte_util.swipe('right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')

	--가디언(left,damaged,damaged)
	scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(queen_knight, self, 'damaged')

	--z축 4회 회전 하면서 속도 10으로 우측끝으로 이동
	character_util.spine_rotate(queen_knight, 1 * 4 * 360, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(queen_knight,
			queen_knight.Position + vector(5, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	character_util.spine_rotate(queen_knight, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
	--fx_common_smokescreen 가디언 위치에 출력 화면 shake0.1/ 1초
	self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(queen_knight.Position)
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언 (left,damaged,idle)(shake0.03) 상태
	character_util.remove_anim(queen_knight)
	character_util.shake(queen_knight, 0.03, 99999)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')

	character_util.stop_shake(queen_knight)
	scene_util.set_anim_async(queen_knight, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	--카메라 가디언에서 배우로 이동 (속도 4)
	local camera_move_duration = (actor.Position - queen_knight.Position).magnitude / 4

	camera_util.move_async(actor.Position, camera_move_duration)

	--배우(left,idle,idle)0.5초 배우 (down,idle,idle) 1초
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(actor)
	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'left', true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(actor)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(actor, 'down', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:counter_attack_scene()
	local queen_knight = self.get_demon_queen_knight()
	local actor = self.get_demon_actor()

	local group_a = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_a()
	local group_b = self.dynamic_npc:get_reaction_group_b()

	local npc_1 = self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_orange_1')
	local npc_2 = self.dynamic_npc:get('dynamic_red_2')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	--QTE(right)발생 실패X
	qte_util.swipe('right')

	--입력시

	--슬로우 모션 시작
	do
		local gauntlet_kick_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(
				queen_knight, 'gauntlet_kick')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

		local time_key = 'hit_action'
		time_util.mod(time_key, 0.1)

		--배우 표정 (surprise)로 바뀌면서 가디언 0.5칸 우측 이동
		scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'surprise')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(queen_knight)

		scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(queen_knight, self, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })
		wp_util.move(queen_knight, queen_knight.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil, 0.3)

		wait_for_sec(gauntlet_kick_duration - 0.1)

		----슬로우모션 풀림
		time_util.unmod(time_key)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({
			name = 'bgm_colosseum', state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 0.5 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
		self.fx.hit():Instantiate(queen_knight.Bounds.center)
		self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(queen_knight.Bounds.center)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		scene_util.set_direction(queen_knight, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion(queen_knight, self, 'attack')
		character_util.remove_anim(queen_knight)
	end

	--배우(left,damaged,damaged)
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'damaged')

	--z축 회전 2회 하면서 속도 4로 우측 2칸
	character_util.spine_rotate(actor, 2 * 360, 0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(actor,
			actor.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), nil, 0.5, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')

	-- 이동 후 (left,confused,prostrate)
	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'confused')
	scene_util.set_anim(actor, self, 'prostrate')

	--이후 카메라 2칸 아래로 내려가 초록색 표시된 관객을 보여준다.
	local camera_pos = npc_1.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true })

	--(1)(right,idle,idle): 뭐야? 리리스가 그냥 패버리는데?
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_2, 'left', false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_1, 'cw_main_s14_concert_51')

	--(2)(left,idle,bomb_idle): 몰라? 뭐가 더 있겠지.
	scene_util.set_anim(npc_2, self, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc_2, 'cw_main_s14_concert_52')

	scene_util.set_direction(npc_1, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(npc_2, 'up', false)
	character_util.remove_anim(npc_2)

	--우측 상단[shout]: 진짜 때리는 거 같잖아!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {

		skip = true,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.7),
		bubble_direction = 'none',

	--좌측 하단[shout]: 이기는 편이 우리편이지!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(actor, {
		key = 'cw_main_s14_concert_56',
		skip = true,

		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.3),
		bubble_direction = 'none',

	--카메라 사이즈 4로 복귀

	wait_for_sec(1)

	scene_util.set_emotion(actor, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(actor, 'cw_main_s14_concert_57')

	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:cross_line_loop()
	local sfx_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s14_cross_line_npc_pos_8')
	local staff_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02',
		loop = true,
		type_priority = 'loop',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		play_pos = sfx_pos
	})

	local dt = 0
	while self.current_state < self.section_state.start_concert do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		--스나이퍼 업데이트
		if self.current_update_state == self.update_state.playing then
			self.npc_manager:foreach(function(key, info)
				self:cross_line_npc_update(key, info, dt)
			end)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	staff_loop_sfx:Stop()
	staff_loop_sfx = nil

	--이벤트 종료 후 npc 초기화
	self.npc_manager:foreach(function(key, info)
		local npc = info.npc
		npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end)
end

function local_class:cross_line_npc_update(key, info, dt)
	local npc = info.npc
	local grid_pos_x = info.grid_pos_x
	local init_pos = info.init_pos
	local dir = info.dir
	local speed = info.speed
	local state = info.state
	local timer = info.timer

	if state == self.npc_state.move_start then
		--이동 시작
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'walk')
		state = self.npc_state.move
	elseif state == self.npc_state.move then
		--그리드 넘어갈 경우 초기화
		if dir.x > 0 and npc.Position.x > grid_pos_x then
			npc.Position = init_pos
		elseif dir.x < 0 and npc.Position.x < grid_pos_x then
			npc.Position = init_pos
		end

		--local move_result = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(npc, dir, speed * dt)
		npc.Position = npc.Position + (dir * speed * dt)
	elseif state == self.npc_state.stop then
		--이동 멈춤
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)

function local_class:death_flag_squad_camera_routine()
	start_coroutine(function()
		local squad_leader = get_character('death_flag_squad_leader')
		local rookie = get_character('death_flag_rookie')
		local senior = get_character('death_flag_senior')
		local squad_leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('death_flag_squad_leader_pos') + vector(-0.3, 0, 1)
		local senior_pos = squad_leader_pos + vector(1.3, 0, 0)
		local rookie_pos = squad_leader_pos + vector(2.6, 0, 0)
		local death_flag_camera = get_character('death_flag_camera')

		local take_pic_scene_data = {
			{
				{ npc = squad_leader, anim = 'cross_arm', emotion = 'idle', dir = 'right' },
				{ npc = senior, anim = 'cast2', emotion = 'smile', dir = 'left' },
				{ npc = rookie, anim = 'salute', emotion = 'idle', dir = 'down' },
			},
			{
				{ npc = squad_leader, anim = 'hold_loop', emotion = 'idle', dir = 'down' },
				{ npc = senior, anim = 'sing', emotion = 'smile', dir = 'right' },
				{ npc = rookie, anim = 'sing', emotion = 'smile', dir = 'left' },
			},
			{
				{ npc = squad_leader, anim = 'get', emotion = 'idle', dir = 'left' },
				{ npc = senior, anim = 'bomb_idle', emotion = 'doyagao', dir = 'down' },
				{ npc = rookie, anim = 'question', emotion = 'smile', dir = 'right' },
			},
		}

		squad_leader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		rookie.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		senior.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

		character_util.set_direction(rookie, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(senior, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim(rookie)
		character_util.remove_anim(senior)
		character_util.set_emotion(rookie, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_emotion(senior, { name = 'smile' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', parent = rookie })
		character_util.normal_jump(rookie)
		character_util.normal_jump(senior)

		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.2)
		character_util.set_direction(squad_leader, 'right')
		--얘들아! 카메라 찾았다! 사진 찍자!

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', parent = squad_leader })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(squad_leader,
				{ key = 'cw_death_flag_s1_32', bubble_tpye = 'shout', scale = 1.2 })

		if self.stage_ended then
			return
		end

		rookie.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		senior.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		squad_leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move(rookie, { vector(rookie.Position.x, 0, rookie_pos.z), rookie_pos },
				2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.move(senior, { vector(senior.Position.x, 0, senior_pos.z), senior_pos },
				2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

		wp_util.move_async(squad_leader, squad_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),
				2, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

		if self.stage_ended then
			return
		end

		local squad_leader_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = squad_leader, loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(squad_leader, { name = 'eat' })
		self:custom_wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.stage_ended then
			return
		end

		local camera_pos = squad_leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		self.fx:smoke():Instantiate(camera_pos)
		death_flag_camera.Position = camera_pos
		death_flag_camera.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance

		squad_leader_eat_sfx:Stop()
		squad_leader_eat_sfx = nil
		character_util.remove_anim(squad_leader)

		wp_util.move_async(squad_leader, squad_leader_pos,
				2, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

		squad_leader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		rookie.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		senior.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

		local index = 1
		while not self.stage_ended do
			--자… 하나~ 둘~
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(squad_leader,
					{ key = 'cw_death_flag_s1_33' })

			if self.stage_ended then
				return
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', loop = false, parent = squad_leader})
			character_util.normal_jump(squad_leader)
			character_util.normal_jump(senior)
			character_util.normal_jump(rookie)

			for i = 1, #take_pic_scene_data[index] do
				local data = take_pic_scene_data[index][i]

				character_util.set_direction(data.npc, data.dir)
				character_util.set_emotion(data.npc, { name = data.emotion })
				scene_util.set_anim(data.npc, self, { name = data.anim, one_shot_sfx = false, sfx_name = false })
			end

			if index >= #take_pic_scene_data then
				index = 1
			else
				index = index + 1
			end

			self:custom_wait_for_sec(5)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:custom_wait_for_sec(duration)
	local end_time = unity_class.time.time + duration
	while not self.stage_ended and unity_class.time.time < end_time do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	return not self.stage_ended
end
return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	end

end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_camera()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.entered_death_flag_squad_zone then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.got_camera
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.get_camera_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_squad_leader()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.got_camera then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.talk_to_squad_leader_scene, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, knight, 'death_flag_squad_zone') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.entered_death_flag_squad_zone
		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.death_flag_scene, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 's11_start' then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('death_flag_door_1', true))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('death_flag_door_2', true))

		self:set_death_flag_squad()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local main_quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(357)
	local main_quest_inner_progress = main_quest_progress.InnerProgress

	if main_quest_inner_progress >= 10 then
		self:set_death_flag_squad()

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarDeathFlagSection2')

		Comment = CivilWarDeathFlag 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @

		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	---@type CivilWarDeathFlag
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'civilwar_5'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		collect_remain_item = 2,
		clear = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.star_piece_effect = nil

	self.star_piece_name = 'death_flag_star_piece_2'

	self.get_squad_leader = function()
		return get_character('death_flag_squad_leader')
	end
	self.get_rookie = function()
		return get_character('death_flag_rookie')
	end
	self.get_senior = function()
		return get_character('death_flag_senior')
	end
	self.get_old_man = function()
		return get_character('death_flag_old_man')
	end

	self.custom_state = {
		talked_with_old_man = 1,
		cleared_rookie = 2,
		cleared_senior = 4,
		cleared_leader = 8,
	}
	self.current_custom_state = 0
	self.custom_state_key = 'death_flag_custom_state'

	self.remain_item_data = {
		{
			name = 'death_flag_rookie',
			item_id = self.controller.photo_id,
			text = 'cw_death_flag_s2_9',
			clear = false,
			twinkle_effect = nil,
			state_key = 'cleared_rookie'
		},
		{
			name = 'death_flag_senior',
			item_id = self.controller.locket_id,
			text = 'cw_death_flag_s2_10',
			clear = false,
			twinkle_effect = nil,
			state_key = 'cleared_senior'
		},
		{
			name = 'death_flag_squad_leader',
			item_id = self.controller.camera_id,
			text = 'cw_death_flag_s2_11',

			twinkle_effect = nil,

		}

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	start_coroutine(self.pre_setting, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
		self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
		self.star_piece_effect = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.remain_item_data do
		if self.remain_item_data[i].twinkle_effect ~= nil then
			self.remain_item_data[i].twinkle_effect:Dispose()
			self.remain_item_data[i].twinkle_effect = nil
		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_old_man()) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.collect_remain_item
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.old_man_request_scene, self)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.collect_remain_item then
			if self:check_collected_all_remain_item() then
				self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear
				self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.clear_quest_scene, self)
			else
				-- 꼭 좀 부탁드리겠습니다.
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_old_man(),
						{ key = 'cw_death_flag_s2_8' })
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, #self.remain_item_data do
		local npc = get_character(self.remain_item_data[i].name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, npc) and
				not self.remain_item_data[i].clear then
			self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.get_remain_item_scene, self, self.remain_item_data[i])
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 사전 세팅
function local_class:pre_setting()
	local old_man = self.get_old_man()

	self.current_custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_state_key)
	if self.current_custom_state == -1 then
		self.current_custom_state = 0
	end

	if self.current_custom_state & self.custom_state.talked_with_old_man == self.custom_state.talked_with_old_man then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.collect_remain_item
		self:set_death_flag_squad()
	end
	character_util.add_listener(old_man, self.controller)

	character_util.set_direction(old_man, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(old_man, field_util.get_marker_pos('death_flag_old_man_pos'))

	self.star_piece_effect = self.controller.fx:star_piece():Instantiate(old_man.Position)
end

	if self.current_custom_state & self.custom_state.cleared_rookie == self.custom_state.cleared_rookie then

	else

	character_util.set_direction(senior, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(senior, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.add_color(senior, senior.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 0)

	else

	character_util.set_anim(squad_leader, { name = 'dead4', loop = false })
	character_util.add_color(squad_leader, squad_leader.Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.5, 0)

	if self.current_custom_state & self.custom_state.cleared_leader == self.custom_state.cleared_leader then
		self.remain_item_data[3].clear = true
	else
		character_util.add_listener(squad_leader, self.controller)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.remain_item_data do
		if not self.remain_item_data[i].clear then
			self.remain_item_data[i].twinkle_effect = self.controller.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(effect_pos[i])
		end

	rookie.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	senior.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	squad_leader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

-- 아이템 얻는 연출
function local_class:get_remain_item_scene(data)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local npc = get_character(data.name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)

	data.clear = true

	data.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	data.twinkle_effect = nil

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	local remain_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = npc.Position,

													 itemid = data.item_id, notforinven = true,
													 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	remain_item.ConsumeTarget = knight
	wait_for_sec(1)

		end

	return true

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarDeletedRecordsSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute

	-- 책장

	-- 화로 오브젝트

	-- 스타피스

	-- 트윙클 이팩트
	self.get_fx_object_twinkle = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle') end

	-- 화로 갯수
	self.brazier_count = 4

	-- 트윙클 이팩트
	self.twinkle_effect_list = nil

	-- 상호작용 가능한 일반 책상 갯수
	self.normal_bookshelf_count = 6

	-- 화로에 불이 켜져 있는지
	self.on_brazier = { false, false, false, false }

	-- 자동 이벤트를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_one_line_event = false

	-- 스테이지 종료 됐는지?
	self.is_stage_end = false

	-- 시빌워용 유틸
	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_object_twinkle()
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/Util')

	-- 책장 길막 하도록 변경
	local secret_door = self.get_secret_door_bookshelf()
	secret_door.Position = secret_door.Position - vector(0, 0, 2)

	-- 해당섹션에서 컨트롤 가능 하도록 변경
	local damaged_bookshelf = self.get_damaged_bookshelf()
	damaged_bookshelf.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 상호작용 가능한 책장에 트윙클 이팩트 세팅
	self:set_twinkle_effect()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	self.util = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_damaged_bookshelf()) then
		-- 파손된 책상에 상호작용 하였을 때 연출
		self.util:start_scene(self.interact_damaged_bookshelf, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 자동 이벤트 봤으면 return false
	if self.is_show_one_line_event then
		return false
	end

	-- 자동 이벤트 존안에 들어왔을 때 연출 실행
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'deleted_records_one_line_zone') then
		self.is_show_one_line_event = true
		start_coroutine(self.show_one_line_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.brazier_count do
		--  화로 켜짐 체크
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BrazierObject, self.get_brazier(i)) then
			self.on_brazier[i] = true
			self:is_all_brazier_fire()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true
end

--endregion

-- 자동 원라인 연출 이벤트
function local_class:show_one_line_event()
	-- 군인1 (right, idle, release) : 잠깐 다른데 좀 둘러보고 오는 거 어때? 이런 데를 또 언제 와 보겠어! 
	local swat_1 = self.get_swat(1)
	scene_util.set_anim(swat_1, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat_1, 'cw_deleted_records_1', false)

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(swat_1)

	-- 군인2 (left, idle, jump 1회) : 큰일날 소릴! 경계 중 근무지 이탈은 중형인거 모르나?
	local swat_2 = self.get_swat(2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', loop = false, parent = swat_2
	, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.normal_jump(swat_2)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat_2, 'cw_deleted_records_2', false)

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 군인2 (left, idle, release) : 얌전히 이곳에서 대기하고 있자고!
	scene_util.set_anim(swat_2, self, 'release')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat_2, 'cw_deleted_records_3', false)

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(swat_2)

	-- 이후 군인 1,2 NPC의 마지막 대사는 원라인으로 처리.
	swat_1.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_deleted_records_1'
	swat_2.Interactable.Talk = 'cw_deleted_records_3'
end

-- 모든 화로가 켜졌는지 체크하고 켜졌으면 비밀문 오픈 연출
function local_class:is_all_brazier_fire()
	for i = 1, #self.on_brazier do
		if self.on_brazier[i] == false then
			return
		end
	end

	self.util:start_scene(self.open_secret_door, self)
end

-- 비밀문 열리는 연출
function local_class:open_secret_door()
	local secret_door = self.get_secret_door_bookshelf()

	-- 카메라가 비밀문 쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(secret_door.Bounds.center, 1)

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2
	local start_pos = secret_door.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)

	local move_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_wagon_01', loop = true })
	field_object_util.shake(secret_door, 0.03, duration)
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

		secret_door.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	move_sfx:Stop()
	secret_door.Position = end_pos
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 파손된 책상 상호작용
function local_class:interact_damaged_bookshelf()
	local damaged_bookshelf = self.get_damaged_bookshelf()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

	-- 『A.H. 56년, 제 262 마계 대회의록』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_1' })

	-- 『마계의 인재들이 학살 당하고, 헤븐홀드를 비롯한 막대한 물자와 기술력이 인간계의 손에 떨어지다.』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_2' })

	-- 『행방을 감춘 반역자를 감싸는 '리리스'의 진의와 권위가 의심 받았으며, 각 지의 지도자들이 독립을 위한 전쟁을 선언하다.』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_3' })

	-- 대기 0.5초
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 『기록서 안쪽에 빛나는 무언가가 숨겨져있다.』
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_5' })

	-- 트윙클 이팩트 제거
	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, damaged_bookshelf.Position
	, damaged_bookshelf.Position - vector(1.5, 0, 0))
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 나레이션 원복
	local narration_interactable = CS.Oak.NarrationInteractable()
	narration_interactable.StringKeys = {
		'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_1', 'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_2',
		'cw_deleted_records_bookshelf_7_3' }
	narration_interactable.InteractingSfx = '01_turn_page_01'
	damaged_bookshelf.Interactable = narration_interactable

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:set_twinkle_effect()
	self.twinkle_effect_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.normal_bookshelf_count do
		local bookshelf = self.get_bookshelf(i)
		local pos = bookshelf.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.25)
		local twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(pos)
		table.insert(self.twinkle_effect_list, twinkle_effect)
	end

	local damaged_bookshelf = self.get_damaged_bookshelf()
	local pos = damaged_bookshelf.Position + vector(0, 0.5, -0.25)
	local twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(pos)
	table.insert(self.twinkle_effect_list, twinkle_effect)
end

function local_class:dispose_twinkle_effect()
	if self.twinkle_effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.twinkle_effect_list do
			self.twinkle_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
		end

		self.twinkle_effect_list = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CompleteSwitchingPartyMemberEvent))
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CompleteSwitchingPartyMemberEvent), 'on_complete_party_event')

	self.get_fx_object_twinkle()
	self.get_star_piece_effect()

	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local name = e.Target.name

	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return
	end

	if self.interact_item_data[name] ~= nil then
		self.cw_util:start_scene(self.interact_item_event, self, self.interact_item_data[name])
		return
	end

	if self.quest_progress.IsComplete and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_android()) then
		self.cw_util:start_scene(function()
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_de_s4_102' })
			music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
		end)
		return
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_stair_bomb()) then
		start_coroutine(function()
			quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.save_stair_key, 1)
		end)

		self.get_stair_down().ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.get_stair_bomb().Position = vector(999,0,999)
		return
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return false
	end

	self:field_item_setting()
end

function local_class:on_complete_party_event()
	if stage.Name ~= self.sub_stage_name then
		return
	end
	self:stage_enter_event()
end
--endregion

function local_class:field_item_setting()
	for _, item_info in pairs(self.interact_item_data) do
		local offset_pos
		local item_object = get_field_object(item_info.name)

		if item_info.pos ~= nil then
			item_object.Position = item_info.pos
		end

		if item_info.y_offset ~= nil then
			offset_pos = item_object.Position + vector(0, item_info.y_offset, 0)
		else
			offset_pos = item_object.Position
		end

		if item_info.item_id ~= nil then
			item_info.item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{
						itemid = item_info.item_id,
						pos = offset_pos,
						notforinven = true,
						skip_text = true,
						lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
					})

			if item_info.invisible == true then
				drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item_info.item, 0, 0)
				item_object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			end
		end

		if item_info == self.interact_item_data['s4_wall_lab'] then
			item_info.fx = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(offset_pos + vector(0,1,-0.5))
		end

		item_info.fx = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(offset_pos)

		if item_info.scale ~= nil then
			item_info.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * item_info.scale
			item_info.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * item_info.scale
		end
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and (quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.save_stair_key) == -1) then
		self.get_stair_down().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		self.get_stair_bomb().Position = self.get_stair_down().Position + vector(0, -1.5, 0)
	end

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.star_piece_key) == 1 then
		--스타피스 세팅
		local star_piece = get_field_object('demon_engineer_star_piece')
		star_piece.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = false

		local s4_ring = {
			item_id = 21054,
			name = 's4_ring',
			pos = vector(-63, 0, 3),
			item = nil,
			fx = nil,
			key = { 'cw_de_s4_5', 'cw_de_s4_6' },
		}

		local object = get_field_object(s4_ring.name)
		object.Position = s4_ring.pos

		s4_ring.item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{
					itemid = s4_ring.item_id,
					pos = object.Position,
					notforinven = true,
					skip_text = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				})

		s4_ring.fx = self.get_fx_object_twinkle():Instantiate(object.Position)

		self.interact_item_data['s4_ring'] = s4_ring

		local item_size_offset = 0.5
		s4_ring.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one *	item_size_offset
		s4_ring.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * item_size_offset

		local item_info = self.interact_item_data['s4_box']
		object = get_field_object(item_info.name)
		local item = item_info.item
		object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
		item_info.fx:Dispose()
		item_info.fx = nil
	else
		self.star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(get_field_object('s4_box').Position)
	end

	if quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.save_ring_key) == 1 then
		self.is_get_ring = true

		local item_info = self.interact_item_data['s3_ring']
		local object = get_field_object(item_info.name)
		local item = item_info.item
		object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
		item_info.fx:Dispose()
		item_info.fx = nil
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 2 then
		self.is_get_fingerprint = true
	end

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		self.is_get_engineer_fingerprint = true
	end

	--피규어 서브 아이템 추가
	--두개가 하나의 아이템으로 취급되는 예외 사항으로 별도로 생성
	self.interact_item_data['s4_figure_1'].item_sub = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = 20774,
		pos = vector(-34.3, 0.7, 30),
		notforinven = true,
		skip_text = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})

	self.interact_item_data['s4_figure_1'].item_sub.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5
end

function local_class:interact_item_event(item_info)
	--인터렉트 후 메세지 표시와 동시에 BGM 볼륨 0.5로 조정, 믹스 디폴트 값
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	if item_info.key ~= nil then
		local key = item_info.key
		for i = 1, #key do
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = key[i] })
		end
	end

	if item_info.action ~= nil then
		item_info.action(self)
	end

	if item_info.fx ~= nil then
		item_info.fx:Dispose()
		item_info.fx = nil
	end

	if item_info.name ~= nil and item_info.volatility ~= nil then
		self:item_data_dispose(item_info)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)
end

function local_class:item_data_dispose(item_info)
	local object = get_field_object(item_info.name)
	local item = item_info.item

	object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	object.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if item ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end
end

function local_class:look_around(fo, dir_list, around_wait_time)
	dir_list = lua_helper.get_or_default(dir_list, { 'left', 'right' })
	around_wait_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(around_wait_time, 1)

	local around_count = #dir_list
	for i = 1, around_count do
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir_list[i])
		wait_for_sec(around_wait_time)
		if self.android_around_flag == false then
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:android_look_around(fo, duration)
	local around_list = { 'left', 'down', 'right', 'up' }
	--방에 들어오면 안드로이드는 제자리에 서서 left, down, right, up으로 방향전환 2초마다 반복하고 있는 상태.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		while self.android_around_flag do
			self:look_around(fo, around_list, duration)
		end
		self.android_around_flag = true
	end))
end

function local_class:stop_android_around()
	self.android_around_flag = false
end

function local_class:lab_block()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--만약 레니의 방에서 반지를 주워왔으면, 가디언 선택지 등장.
	if self.is_get_ring then
		self.interact_item_data['s4_box'].volatility = true

		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.star_piece_key, 1)

		--가디언 선택지
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'cw_de_s1_choose_1', 'mercy' } })

		--프로포즈용 반지를 틈에 끼워 넣는다.
		--기사 wall_lab_block의 오른쪽 0.5칸 거리에 선다.
		local block = get_field_object('s4_box')
		local leader_move_pos = block.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_move_pos, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

		--이후, 손에 dark_magic_ring_accessory를 bow_idle로 든다.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_select_item_01')
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'dark_magic_ring_accessory')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'bow_idle')
		--
		--1초 대기.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--기사 뒷걸음질 쳐 1칸 거리로 멀어진다.
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right, 4, nil, { locked_dir = 'left' })
		--자세 idle, 손에 반지 없는 상태로.

		--wall_lab_block shake 0.3초.
		field_object_util.shake(block, 0.03, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		--동시에 wall_lab_block 안에서 스타피스 하나와 반지 하나가 더 떨어진다. (이 반지에는 트윙클 X)
		local s4_ring = {
			item_id = 21054,
			name = 's4_ring',
			pos = vector(-63, 0, 3),
			item = nil,
			fx = nil,
			key = { 'cw_de_s4_5', 'cw_de_s4_6' },
		}

		local object = get_field_object(s4_ring.name)
		object.Position = s4_ring.pos

		s4_ring.item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{
					itemid = s4_ring.item_id,
					pos = block.Position,
					target = object.Position,
					notforinven = true,
					skip_text = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				})

		self.interact_item_data['s4_ring'] = s4_ring

		local item_size_offset = 0.5
		s4_ring.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one *	item_size_offset
		s4_ring.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * item_size_offset

		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
		local star_piece_pos = block.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)

		star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, star_piece_pos)

		if self.star_piece_effect ~= nil then
			self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
			self.star_piece_effect = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:elevator_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local elevator = self.get_elevator()

	local leader_pos = vector(-0.5, 0, 2)

	camera_util.cancel_move()

	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	local animator = elevator:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	--엘레베이터 불 점멸할 때	01_elevator_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
	animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0.7)

	local leader_move_pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -2)
	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader_move_pos, 3, nil)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'cw_de_pre_2' })
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)

	animator:Play('close')

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry,
			leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),

local local_class = newclass('CivilWarDemonEngineerPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = CivilWarDemonEngineer @
		Comment = CivilWarDemonEngineer civilwar_4 연구소 엘리베이터 인터렉트 씬
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.stage_name = 'civilwar_4'
	self.unlock_stage_name = 'civilwar_substage_heavenhold_1'

	self.get_elevator = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_de_elevator')
	end

	self.get_puzzle_brazier = function(number)
		return get_field_object('sub_de_puzzle_brazier_' .. number)
	end

	self.brazier_table = {
		sub_de_puzzle_brazier_2 = {
			is_turn_on = false
		},
		sub_de_puzzle_brazier_3 = {
			is_turn_on = false
		}
	}

	self.get_door_name = 'sub_de_puzzle_door_1'
	self.quest_marker_name = 'demon_engineer_sub_quest'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')

	local elevator = self.get_elevator()
	elevator.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.get_door_name, false))

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(elevator)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BrazierOnOffEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.stage_name == stage.Name and type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_elevator()) then
		quest_marker_util.remove_auto_control('demon_engineer_sub_quest')
		self.get_elevator().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		 sp_util.start_scene(self.interact_elevator, self)
		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
	local name = e.BrazierObject.Name
	if e.BrazierObject == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.brazier_table[name] ~= nil then
		self.brazier_table[name].is_turn_on = e.IsTurningOn

		for number = 1, table_util.get_size(self.brazier_table) do
			if self.brazier_table['sub_de_puzzle_brazier_' .. (number+1)].is_turn_on == false then
				return
			end
		end

		self.controller.cw_util:start_scene(self.open_door_event, self)
		return
	end
end
--endregion
function local_class:open_door_event()
	local door = get_field_object(self.get_door_name)
	camera_util.move_async(door.Position, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.get_door_name, false))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:interact_elevator()
	--엘리베이터에 인터랙트하면 서브 스테이지 오픈

	--서브 스테이지 오픈.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.unlock_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'cw_de_pre_1'
	})

	quest_icon_util.remove(self.get_elevator())

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

return local_class
